text.body:
śrīpāñcarātre paramasaṃhitā
āsīnam āśrame nānādrumavibhūṣite | mārkaṇḍeyaṃ mahāprājñaṃ devalas samupāgamat || 1.1 taṃ praṇamya yathānyāyaṃ tena cāpy abhinanditaḥ | praṣṭaṃ pracakrame vidvān paramajñānagocaraṃ || 1.2 adhītā bhagavan vedāḥ sāṅgopāṅgās savistarāḥ | śrutāni ca mayā'ṅgāni vākovākyaśrutāni ca || 1.3 na caiteṣu samasteṣu saṃśayena vinā kvacit | śreyomārgaṃ prapaśyāmi yena siddhir bhaviṣyati || 1.4 āgameṣu na caikasmin paśyāmi paramaṃ hitam | teṣām eva bahūnāṃ tu saṃśayo mama vardhate || 1.5 tatra me bhagavan brūhi saṃśayacchedakāraṇam | tvad anyaṃ na ca paśyāmi śreyomārgaviśāradam || 1.6 devalenaivamuktas tu mārkaṇḍeyo mahātapāḥ | devalaṃ pratyuvācedaṃ vismayena samāgataḥ || 1.7 dīrgham āyur mayā labdhaṃ na ca viproṣitā smṛtiḥ | pralayā bahavo dṛṣṭāḥ sargā manvantarāṇi ca || 1.8 ācāryā bahavo dṛṣṭāḥ śāstrāṇi ca sahasraśaḥ | nopalabdhaṃ mayā teṣu kiṃcid aikāntikaṃ hitam || 1.9 tato'haṃ bhṛśanirviṇṇas santaptahṛdayas tadā | sālagrāmaṃ samāsādya viṣṇum evābhyapūjayam || 1.10 samās sahasramaṣṭau ca svayam āgatanirṇayaḥ | śraddhābhaktisametena vidhinā yena kenacit || 1.11 tatas sa bhagavān devaḥ puṇḍarīkanibhekṣaṇaḥ | śyāmavarṇo mayā dṛṣṭaḥ prasanno bhaktavatsalaḥ || 1.12 prañipatya mayā stotraiḥ stūyamānaḥ sa devarāṭ | sānukampam idaṃ vākyama bravīn me tapodhana || 1.13 bhagavān mārkaṇḍeya prasanno'smi vidhinā vidhinā kṛtaiḥ | ārādhanair bhaktiyuktais tvayā cirataraṃ kṛtaiḥ || 1.14 varaṃ vṛṇiṣva bhadraṃ te yat te manasi vartate | āyur vijñānam aiśvaryaṃ yac cānyat tava suvrata || 1.15 ityukto'haṃ bhagavatā pratyavocaṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ | jñānaṃ bhavatu me śuddhaṃ nissaṃśayam anākulam || 1.16 ityukto devadevas tu prahasann idam abravīt | yadi te sammataṃ jñānaṃ śvetadvīpam ito vraja || 1.17 kṣīrasāgaramadhyasthaṃ yoginām ekam āspadam | tatra siddhān mahāprājñān upāsya vidhipūrvakam || 1.18 sarvāpavargaviṣayaṃ sādhaya jñānam īpsitam | avicchinnā ca deśeṣu gatis tava bhaviṣyati || 1.19 āyuṣyaṃ dīrghakālaṃ ca matprasādena suvrata | ity uktvā mām asau devaḥ tatraivādarśanaṃ gataḥ || 1.20 tato'haṃ vismito bhūtva śvetadvīpāya devala | prasthito'smi ciraṃ kālaṃ na kvacit prativāritaḥ |21 śailārṇavān samullaṅghya tad dvīpaṃ punar āsadam | tatra tejomayāḥ siddhā nivasanti caturbhujāḥ || 1.22 śaṅkhacakragadāpadmair aṅkitāḥ sveṣu pāṇiṣu | puruṣottamam evaikaṃ dhyāyantas tatparāyaṇāḥ || 1.23 ekāntino mudā yuktā nirdvandvā niṣparigrahāḥ | paripakvakaṣāyāś ca sarvadā dhyānatatparāḥ || 1.24 tān dṛṣṭvā vismayenāhaṃ praṇipatya yathā tatham | āśramaṃ sanakasyātha siddhasya samupāgatam || 1.25 tatra tatpūjayitvā'ham idaṃ vacanam abruvam | dvīpāntarād upāvṛttaṃ mārkaṇḍeyaṃ pratīhi mām || 1.26 jñānahetoḥ prapannaṃ tvāṃ śādhi māṃ jñānapāraga | evam ukto mayā vidvān sanakasya mahāmanāḥ || 1.27 vandamānaḥ paraṃ devam evam astv iti cābravīt | atha tena prasannena yat tantraṃ mama kīrtitam || 1.28 tena me saṃśayāś chinnā naṣṭaṃ ca hṛdaye tamaḥ | vyavasāyaś ca me dhātaḥ (jātaḥ?) prasannā cābhavan matiḥ || 1.29 dīrghacintā praṇaṣṭā ca sarvatroparatā spṛhā | pūrve manvantare labdhaṃ mayā tantraṃ ca devala || 1.30 tāvatā cirakālena na kasmaicid udahṛtam | tantram etad aśeṣeṇa granthabāhulyakāraṇāt || 1.31 ekadeśam upāśratya bahavas tāpasā gatāḥ | tatas tu bahudhā bhinnam idaṃ tantraṃ jagaty abhūt || 1.32 akṛtārtham asāraṃ ca viruddhaṃ ca parasparam | pañcarātram idaṃ proktaṃ yogatantram idaṃ param || 1.33 nirmitaṃ parameṇaiva puruṣeṇa tapodhana | satyārtham api (vi?) saṃvādī (di?) lokānāṃ paraṃ hitam || 1.34 sammataṃ yoginām etat vaiṣṇavānāṃ viśeṣataḥ | pramāṇam idam evaikaṃ āgameṣu vyavasthitam || 1.35 sarge sarge'py avicchinnaṃ devadevasya śāsanāt | ye tu jānanty aśeṣeṇa tantram etan manīṣiṇaḥ || 1.36 na teṣāṃ puṇyamārgeṣu saṃśayo jāyate kvacit | na teṣāṃ viphalaṃ janma na teṣām asti durlabham || 1.37 na śocanti na kupyanti nāvasidanti te kvacit | karmaṇāṃ phalasiddhiś ca jñānasya ca phalodayaḥ || 1.38 ubhayos sannipātaś ca tantre'smin parikīrtitaḥ | mahābhūtaguṇāḥ pañca rātrayo dehinaḥ smṛtāḥ || 1.39 tadyogād vinivṛtter vā pañcarātram iti smṛtam | bhūtamātrāṇi garvaś ca buddhir avyaktam eva ca || 1.40 rātrayaḥ puruṣasyoktāḥ pañcarātraṃ tataḥ smṛtam | yady etad akhilaṃ tantraṃ cā(sā?)vadhānena kenacit || 1.41 tasya śāstrāntarābhyāse kiṃcid eva prayojanam | yadi tvam api sandehaṃ puṇyamārgasamāśrayam || 1.42 hātum arhasyaśeṣeṇa tasmāt tantram idaṃ śruṇu | sarvataḥ saṃśayasthasya tantram etat paraṃ matam || 1.43 tvāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā tathābhūtaṃ vismayo me samutthitaḥ | śruṇu tasmāt tvam avyagraṃ pañcarātraṃ mayā śrutam || 1.44 devadevaprasādena sanakasya mukhāt purā | adhyāyalakṣam etat tu sṛṣṭisaṃhārasaṃyutam || 1.45 āścaryasiddhisaṃyuktaṃ vicitraiś ca kriyaphalaiḥ | na tv etad akhilaṃ tantraṃ śrotuṃ devala śakyate || 1.46 dīrgham āyur avāpyaiva mayā tantram idaṃ śrutam | mantrasāram upoddhṛtya tava vakṣyāmi devala || 1.47 upodghātaṃ puraskṛtya vaikuṇṭhacaritāśru(śri?)tam | āsīd idaṃ tamobhūtaṃ aprajñātam alakṣaṇam || 1.48 apratarkyam avijñeyaṃ prasuptam iva sarvataḥ | tatra yogamayīṃ nidrāṃ āsthāya paramaḥ pumān || 1.49 dīrghakāla (laṃ?) svayaṃjyotiḥ tataḥ sraṣṭuṃ mano dadhe | tatra yogamayaṃ rūpaṃ adiṣṭhāya punaḥ prabhuḥ || 1.50 lokabījaṃ sasarjāgre puṇḍarīkaṃ sitaprabham | sahasradalaparyastaṃ antaḥkesaramaṇḍalam || 1.51 madhyakarṇikayā yuktaṃ nābhīmaṇḍalasaṃbhavam | sraṣṭāram asṛjat tasmin vidhātāraṃ caturmukham || 1.52 prabhavaṃ sarvāvidyānāṃ bhāvitātmānam īśvaram | sa sṛṣṭvā pañcabhūtāni bhuvanāny asṛjat prabhuḥ || 1.53 bhūtair vyaktaiḥ samastaiś ca sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca | evaṃ sṛṣṭvā jagat sarvaṃ mahāyogī pitāmahaḥ || 1.54 niścalaṃ dhyānam ātiṣṭhat (n?) saṃyānta(yantu?)m upacakrame | tato'sya hṛdaye jātā vicikitsā samantataḥ || 1.55 tayā ca vihite jñāne manomahir avartata | athāpaśyat paraṃ devaṃ kṣīrasāgaraśāyinam || 1.56 anantabhogaśayyāyāṃ śayitaṃ paṅkajekṣaṇam | śaṅkhacakragadāpadmān dhārayantuṃ caturbhujam || 1.57 śriyā caraṇayor juṣṭaṃ śyāmalaṃ pītavāsasam | śrīvatsāṅkaṃ prasannābhaṃ kaustubhojvalavakṣasam || 1.58 sevitaṃ vainateyena saṃniviṣṭena pārśvataḥ | taṃ dṛṣṭvā puruṣaśreṣṭhaṃ rasya dhāracapadmayoḥ || 1.59 māvayā paramā............................ | na deśena paramātrā brahmabhūta iti sthitiḥ || 1.60 jaghantyāṃ tasya mātrāśu sthāvaratvam asat samam | saṃsāravāsanābhītaṃ vimuktaṃ karmabandhanaiḥ || 1.61 ātmatṛptam udāsīnaṃ nirvāṇam avagacchati | etad brūhi vibhāgena paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 1.62 paramaḥ jñānaṃ kriyeti dvividhaṃ ceṣṭitaṃ sarvadehinām | jñānādhikyād vimuktiḥ syāt jñānā(karmā?)dhikyāt tu saṃsṛtiḥ || 1.63 parimāṇānvitaṃ karma parimeyaphalaṃ matam | ādyantikaphalaṃ jñānaṃ parimāṇasya kāmanāt || 1.64 brahmā kathaṃ saṃsāriṇāṃ puṃsām indriyaśreyadarśinām | parimāṇāc ca vijñānaṃ yoginām api jāyate || 1.65 paramaḥ(?) naiva saṃsāriṇāṃ jñānaṃ vimuktau vartate kvacit | bandhacchedanimitteṣu tadupāyeṣu vartate || 1.66 tacchinneṣu nibaddheṣu kāryeṣu karaṇeṣu ca | svayam eva paro jñātā niṣpandam avatiṣṭhati || 1.67 brahmā(?) kena dharmeṇa bhidyante muktās tava śarīriṇaḥ | etad ācakṣva me deva guhyād guhyam idaṃ param || 1.68 paramaḥ aham eva bhavanty ete na bhedas tatra kaścana | yathā'haṃ viharāmy eva tathā muktāś ca dehinaḥ || 1.69 brahmā bandhahetūn samācakṣva dehināṃ puruṣottama | kena rūpeṇa badhnanti puruṣaṃ bandhahetavaḥ || 1.70 paramaḥ tribhir eva guṇair brahman samāsavyāsavṛttibhiḥ | tri dvidhā kriyate nidrā badhyante puruṣās tayā || 1.71 satvā sukhamayī nidrā rajasaḥ karmasaṅkulam | tamasaḥ sambhṛtākārā saṃbandhas trividhaḥ smṛtaḥ || 1.72 brahmā tribhir eva guṇair yogaḥ puruṣasyāvatiṣṭhate | kathaṃ vā viprayogaḥ syāt muktikāmasya yoginaḥ || 1.73 paramaḥ puruṣasya guṇā naite trayo'pi kamalāsana | viṣayasya vaśād ete bhavanti na bhavanti ca || 1.74 ko'sau viṣaya ity uktaḥ puruṣāṇāṃ surottama | yasya yogād bhavanty ete na bhavanti ca guṇāḥ || 1.75 paramaḥ prakṛtis triguṇā jñeyā dehino viṣayasthitā | tayā yuktās tu badhyante mucyante rahitās tayā || 1.76 jānāti puruṣo nityaṃ triguṇāṃ prakṛtisthitām | sā ca prasūte satataṃ nidrām asya pṛthag vidhām || 1.77 kāntām eva bhajān nidrāṃ svatantram iva saṃsthitām | surucaṃ vismaraty eṣaṃ saṃbandhaḥ puṃsa iṣyate || 1.78 brahmā prakṛtyā tasya saṃyogo jāyate kena hetunā | etad ācakṣva me deva guhyam etat paraṃ matam || 1.79 paramaḥ māyaiva kāraṇaṃ tasya purastād vihitā mayā | bhūyaḥ karmavaśād eva māyāmagneva tiṣṭhati || 1.80 matkṛtāyās tu māyāyā matprasādād vinā kvacit | na virāmosti loke'smin nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 1.81 yāvad eva na māyeyaṃ matprasādena hīyate | tāvat puṃsas tu saṃsāro muktir asya viparyaye || 1.82 brahmā paripūrṇasya te deva prasādaḥ kiṃnibandhanaḥ | na jāne kāraṇaṃ tasya tad brūhi puruṣottama || 1.83 paramaḥ śraddhā bhakti samādhiś ca mayi praṇihitā janaiḥ | śubham eva vivicyante tat prasādam avaihi me || 1.84 śāstrāgamavihīnā ca bhaktir mayi samarpitā | śubham evāvahet puṃso mūrkhasyapi na saṃśayaḥ || 1.85 tasmāt saṃsāriṇāṃ puṃsāṃ matprasādād vinā kvacit | niḥśreyasakaraṃ nānyat datve(danve)ṣṭavyaṃ pitāmaha || 1.86
iti śrīpāñcarātre paramasaṃhitāyāṃ praśnaprativacanaṃ nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ
atha dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||
brahmā bhagavan deva deveśa puṇḍarīkanibhekṣaṇa | sarvam etad vrataṃ manye tvam eva jagatāṃ patiḥ || 2.1 tvām upāsitum icchanti ye janā vidhipūrvakam | teṣām upāyam ācakṣvety eṣṭeyur yatra te tadā || 2.2 paramaḥ yeṣu bhāveṣu me krīḍā sarge saṃhāra eva ca | tān bhavān ānupūrvyeṇa bhaktiyuktas sadā smara || 2.3 pradhanamūlam eteṣāṃ prakṛtir dravyam eva ca | avyākṛtam avidyā ca tad eva vyaktam ucyate || 2.4 avyaktabuddhyahaṃkārabhūtamātrāś ca pañca ca | indriyāṇi daśaikaṃ ca mahābhūtāni pañca ca || 2.5 sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ dvidhā kṣetraṃ kṣetrajñaś ca tathā paraḥ | iti tattvāny aśeṣāṇi kīrtitāni tavānagha || 2.6 tribhir eva guṇair ete prakṛtisthais samanvitāḥ | sarve bhāvā bhavanty ete śreṣṭhā madhyās tathā'dhamāḥ || 2.7 śreṣṭhās tu sattvabhūyiṣṭhā madhyamās tu rajomayāḥ | adhamās tāmasā jñeyāḥ teṣāṃ caryāsu tādṛśāḥ || 2.8 tatra sattvamayair bhāvair arcanā matprasādinī | rājasair bhogasiddhiḥ syāt tāmasair mohakāraṇam || 2.9 tasmān māṃ pratyupāsīnaṃ[naḥ ?] sarvabhāvānukramāt | kurvīta sāttvikenaiva nāśayitvā rajastamaḥ || 2.10 pralayakramam āsthāya kuryāt sarvatra nāśanam | nisargakramam āsthāya punar utpādanaṃ smṛtam || 2.11 tasmin nisarge saṃhāre vijñeyau māmupāśnutau | ānupūrvyeṇa bhāvānāṃ nānyathā siddhir iṣyate || 2.12 brahmā kutaḥ prasūtir bhāvānāṃ vināśo vā kva sammataḥ | kim antyakālam ubhayam etad bhavati cedvada || 2.13 paramaḥ prasūte prakṛtir bhāvān prakṛtir grasate punaḥ | brahmaṇaḥ saṃbhave sṛṣṭis tadapāye tu viplavaḥ || 2.14 sahasrayugamānaṃ tat dinaṃ brāhmaṃ niśāpi ca | tena mānena tasyāpi śataṃ varṣāṇi jīvitam || 2.15 evaṃ brāhmeṇa kālena sargasaṃhāra eva ca | satataṃ parivartete manniyogāt pitāmaha || 2.16 brahmā kiṃ rūpaṃ prakṛtes tasyāḥ kathaṃ sā ca prasūyate | saṃbandhaḥ kīdṛśas tasyāḥ puruṣasya parasya ca || 2.17 paramaḥ acetanā parārdhā ca nityā satatavikriyā | triguṇā karmiṇāṃ kṣetraṃ prakṛterūpam ucyate || 2.18 vyāptirūpeṇa saṃbandhaḥ tasyāś ca puruṣasya ca | sa hy anādir anantaś ca paramārthena tiṣṭhati || 2.19 yathākāśam idaṃ sarvaṃ prāpya śabdo vyavasthitaḥ | tathaivapyā[vya?] kṛtaṃ prāpya parāmatmā vyavasthitaḥ || 2.20 yathā vā payasi snehaḥ yathā ca salile rasaḥ | gamane tadvad atrāpi vyāpya vyāpakateṣyate || 2.21 tatra yad vyāpakaṃ rūpaṃ paras sa viṣayī pumān | bhaty avyākṛtaṃ vyāpya parasya viṣayo'param || 2.22 yathā sato'sato nānyāḥ śakyā darśayituṃ pṛthak | tathā vyāpakatā nānyā sarvasmāt vyāpya tatsmṛtā || 2.23 acid avyākṛtaṃ tatra cid asmāt paramo mataḥ | ubhayan tv etad anyaṃ tadabhinnam iva tiṣṭhati || 2.24 brahmā katham asmād idaṃ sarvaṃ babhūva bhuvanatrayam | kīdṛśāḥ puruṣāś caivaṃ saṃsāro'smin vyavasthitāḥ || 2.25 paramaḥ parasya puruṣasyaiva niyogāt prakṛtis sadā | utpādayati lokāṃś ca saṃharaty api cāntataḥ || 2.26 acetanā tu prakṛtirnānyathā saṃprasūyate | tenemau sargasaṃhārau karoti puruṣaḥ paraḥ || 2.27 tatra sṛṣṭim imāṃ pūrvaṃ śruṇu brahman samāhitaḥ | sthitiṃ ca pralayaṃ cāpi kathayiṣyāmi te punaḥ || 2.28 śaktayaḥ pañca vikhyātāḥ parasya paramātmanaḥ | yābhir eva paro devaḥ paramavyomni tiṣṭhati || 2.29 parameṣṭhī pumān viśvo nivṛttiḥ sarvasaṃjñitaḥ | śaktayaḥ pañca tasyoktāḥ pañcopaniṣad ākhyayā || 2.30 pañcaśaktimayo devaḥ paramātmā jagatprabhuḥ | pañcendriyasamāyogaḥ pañcadhā jñānam aśnute || 2.31 parameṣṭhī smṛtaś śabde sparśe tu puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ | pañcā [viśvā]tmā tejasi prokto nivṛttā [ttyā]tmā rase smṛtaḥ || 2.32 sarvātmā kathito gandhe viṣayo[yī?] puruṣaḥ paraḥ | pañcātmānaḥ smṛtā hy ete sūkṣmarūpā vyavasthitāḥ || 2.33 saṃsāraviṣayātītā yogagamyāḥ sanātanāḥ | etat sūkṣmaśarīraṃ tu kathitaṃ muktikāraṇam || 2.34 tena tu prakṛter yogāt jñātāḥ pañcadaśa kramāt | pañca pañca samāsena śaktayo guṇayonayaḥ || 2.35 jyeṣṭhā vidyā ca kāntiś ca śāntiḥ śraddhā ca pañcamī | nirmalāś śaktayaḥ pañca jātāḥ satvasya kāraṇam || 2.36 vāgīśvarī kriyā kīrtir lakṣmīḥ sṛṣṭiś ca pañcamī | sā jāna[sāmalā?] kiṃcid evaikā[tā?] rajasaḥ kāraṇaṃ matam || 2.37 mohinī prathamā cāsām avidyā'tha tamovatī | mṛtyur māyā ca malinā yonayas tamasas tv imāḥ || 2.38 tatra prakāśakaṃ sattvaṃ rajo viddhi kriyātmakam | tamas tv āvaraṇaṃ jñeyam ity etad guṇalakṣaṇam || 2.39 ebhir eva guṇair etaṃ jagat sthāvarajaṅgamam | vaicitryaṃ vividhaṃ prāptaṃ saṃsargavyatirekataḥ || 2.40 buddhir aṣṭavidhā jātā guṇebhyas triguṇātmikā | sattvāt sukhātmikā jātā rajaso duḥkhasaṃyutā || 2.41 tamaso mohasaṃsṛṣṭā tatra bhedān imān śruṇu | sāttvikāni ca catvāri rūpam eta(kaṃ)t tu rājasam || 2.42 tāmasāni punas trīṇi yāni vakṣyāmi nāmataḥ | dharmaṃ jñānaṃ ca vairāgyam aiśvaryam iti ta(sā)ttvataḥ || 2.43 vairāgye viparītaṃ tu rūpaṃ rājasam iṣyate | dharmādi viparītāni tāmasānīti dhāraya || 2.44 jāto buddher ahaṃkāras trividhas triguṇātmakaḥ | yena jantur anātmānam ātmānam iti manyate || 2.45 vaikārikaṃ sattvikākhyāt rājasāt taijasaḥ smṛtaḥ | bhūtādis tāmasād rūpād ahaṃkāras tridhā bhavet || 2.46 vaikārikād ahaṃkārāt pañca buddhīndriyāṇi tu | samutpannāni yair jñānaṃ puruṣasyeha siddhyati || 2.47 karmendriyāṇi pañcaiva karmāraṃbhāṇi taijasāt | manojātadvirūpaṃca tatas saṅkalpasādhanam || 2.48 kālaś ca taijasād eva jātas tu yadi[kṛta?]lakṣaṇaḥ | kālād diśaś ca saṃbhūtāḥ pūrvādyāḥ kramaśaḥ sthitāḥ || 2.49 bhūtādevaṃ[va] ca jātāni tanmātrāṇi yathākramam | prathamaṃ śabdatanmātraṃ dvitīyaṃ sparśapūrvakam || 2.50 rūpamātraṃ tṛtīyaṃ tu rasamātraṃ caturthakam | pañcamaṃ gandhamātraṃ tu sūkṣmavigrahasiddhaye || 2.51 gandhamātrādikāḥ pañca diśaḥ kālo manas tathā | ahaṃkāraś ca buddhiś ca prakṛtir yogavigrahaḥ || 2.52 ity etā dvādaśa proktā mūrtayaḥ paramātmanaḥ | vāsudevam avasthāpya yajante siddhim īpsavaḥ || 2.53 tanmātrebhyas tu bhūtāni kramād jñānāni[jatāni?] pañca vai | paṃ[khaṃ]ca vāyuś ca tejaśca jalapṛthvī ca pañcamī || 2.54 ebhiḥ sthūlaśarīraṃ tu dehinām upajāyate | śrotraṃ ca cakṣuṣī[śrotratvakcakṣuṣī?] jihvā prā[ghrā]ṇa buddhīndriyāṇi ca || 2.55 karmendriyāṇi vākyāni [vākpāni] guhyaṃ pāyvaṅghrayaḥ smṛtāḥ | kāryaiś ca karaṇaiś caiva śarīraṃ sthūlam ucyate || 2.56 evaṃ sṛṣṭiḥ śarīrāntā sūkṣmasthūlavibhāgaśaḥ | kīrtitā te mayā brahman atha vakṣyāmi dehinām || 2.57 parasya puruṣasyaiva śaktayaḥ kośaśo'parāḥ | jātināmasvarūpāṇāṃ bhedādbhinnā iva sthitaḥ || 2.58 śarīraṃ bhautikaṃ prāpya karmabhiḥ svair upārjanaiḥ[rjitaiḥ?] | dīrghaṃ bhramanti saṃsāre te ca saṃsāriṇo janāḥ || 2.59 śuddhena karmaṇā yānti gatim ūrdhvamukhīṃ śubhām | aśuddhena karmaṇā yānti tathā gatim adhomukhīm || 2.60 pumāṃso'vyākṛte magnāś cidrūpā api te svataḥ | aśaktāḥ svaparaṃ jñātum āśrayasvān tamohitāḥ || 2.61 rāgadveṣādayas teṣāṃ doṣāḥ prakṛti saṃbhavāḥ | saṃsāragocarāme [e?] va kiṃ kurvanti dehinām || 2.62 guṇānāṃ tu samudrekāt karmabhiḥ svaiś śubhāśubhaiḥ | uttamām athamāṃ madhyāṃ gatiṃ gacchanti dehinaḥ || 2.63 teṣāṃ sattvaguṇodreke gatir devatvam iṣyate | mānuṣyaṃ rājasāt proktaṃ tiryaktvaṃ tamasas tathā || 2.64 evaṃ śarīriṇas sarve gacchanti vividhā gatim | kālacakraṃ samāruhya bhramanty ajñānamāyayā || 2.65 brahmā kiṃ kālacakram ity uktaṃ devadeva mama tvayā | tasya svarūpam icchāmi śrotuṃ śakyaṃ yadi prabho || 2.66 paramaḥ kālaḥ sṛjati bhūtāni kālaḥ saṃharati prajāḥ | kālaḥ sarveṣu jāgarti kālo hi duratikramaḥ || 2.67 kālo vibhajate sarvaṃ puruṣārthaṃ parāparam | bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyac ca sarvaṃ kālāt pravartate || 2.68 grahanakṣatrarāśīnāṃ gatir āvṛttilakṣaṇam | tayos tasya paricchedo bahudhā saṃpravartate || 2.69 tasyā[sya] dvādaśabhir bhedair vibhāgaḥ parikīrtitaḥ | ayane ṛtavo māsāḥ pakṣāṃś ca tithayas tathā || 2.70 savanāni tathā yāmā muhūrtā nāḍya eva ca | kalāś caiva vināḍyaś ca prājāś ca dvādaśasmṛtāḥ || 2.71 saṃvatsaraḥ patis teṣāṃ kālātmā taijasodbhavaḥ | tasya nemidvayaṃ prāhur yad uktam ayanadvayam || 2.72 savanāni punas trīṇi nābhitrayam udāhṛtam | arāṇi māsā vijñeyāḥ pakṣas tatvāni padmaja || 2.73 ṛtavaḥ ṣaḍvadaṅgāni pādādyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ | aṅgulyo hastapādeṣu muhūrtāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 2.74 nāḍyo nāḍyas tu tasyoktāḥ kalāḥ keśā vyavasthitāḥ | vinaḍyo romakūpās tu prāṇāni śvasitāni tu || 2.75 itīdaṃ cakram āruhya jagat sthāvarajaṅgamam | udayāstamayaṃ yānti[yāti] yathaiva grahatārakāḥ || 2.76 para eva pumān brahma kālo bhūtvā vyavasthitaḥ | lokasaṃvyavahārārthaṃ cakraṃ bhramayati dhruvam || 2.77 anenaiva jagat sarvaṃ bhramayad guṇamāyayā | āste kṛtiparo devaḥ krīḍann iva sanātanaḥ || 2.78 tasya yad dvādaśa proktā mūrtayaḥ kamalāsana | tābhya eva kramāj jātāḥ punar dvādaśaśaktayaḥ || 2.79 yogeśvarī sukhā caiva prajñā tuṣṭiḥ smṛtis tathā | dīptirāgā ca vāṅnītiḥ kāntiś caivāmṛtās tathā || 2.80 śaktis sarvātmikā ceti dvādaśaitāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | etā jagad idaṃ prāpya sarvakālam avasthitāḥ || 2.81 etābhyo mūrtipālāś ca dvādaśaivābhavan punaḥ | tathā tathaiva te śaktyā vikhyātā bhuvaneṣv iha || 2.82 māsānām adhipāṃś ca viddhi tān eva padmaja | viṣṇur ādyo madhau jñeyo mādhave madhusūdanaḥ || 2.83 śukre trivikramaḥ proktaḥ śucau māse tu vāmanaḥ | nabhasi śrīdharo jñeyo hṛṣīkeśo nabhasyapaḥ || 2.84 padmanābha iṣe brahman ūrje dāmodaraḥ prabhuḥ | keśavas sahasi proktaḥ sasye nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || 2.85 mādhavas tapasi jñeyo govindas tu tapasyapaḥ | iti dvādaśa māsendrā māsimāsi vyavasthitāḥ || 2.86 kīrtitās te yathāsaṃkhyaṃ mahāvīryā mahāguṇāḥ | sa eva bhagavān devaḥ paramātmā jagadguruḥ || 2.87 devatādivibhāgena vibhinno vyavatiṣṭhate | yathaiva bhinnavarṇānāṃ dravyāṇām āśraye sati || 2.88 sphāṭikasya maṇe rūpam anyac cānyac ca lakṣyate | tathā guṇamayair bhāvair eko hi puruṣaḥ paraḥ || 2.89 bhinnarūpo jagat yasmin baddho muktaś ca jāyate | sa eva caryāmanu syāt candramā candanād api || 2.90 yamanād yama ity uktaḥ śakanāt śakaity api | vāyur vānād asau jñeyo vahanād vahnir eva ca || 2.91 haraś ca haraṇenaiva brahmā brāhmaṇakarmaṇā | ity evaṃ devatā bhedā jñeyās tasyaiva śaktayaḥ || 2.92 na śaktayāḥ parisaṃkhyātuṃ vaiśvarūpyān mahātmanaḥ | trayas tatra pradhānāstu sarvalokeṣu viśrutāḥ || 2.93 puruṣāḥ kīrtitāḥ pūrvaṃ brahmā go viṣṇur ity api | tatrāpi tatsatvavṛtyā jagatāṃ cāpi rakṣaṇāt || 2.94 apavargataratvāc ca viṣṇur eva viśiṣyate | sarveṣāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ tu yasmād evaṃ viśiṣyate || 2.95 sarvaṃ kalyāṇahetutvāt tenāsau puruṣottamaḥ | nārāyaṇamayaṃ prāhur ubhau niśreyasodayau || 2.96 sa eva kuśalas tatra tena nārāyaṇas tu saḥ | vāsavo vasanād dehe sarva eva śarīriṇaḥ || 2.97 teṣāṃ sāmānyadevo'sau vāsudeva iti smṛtaḥ | yasmād vyāptaṃ jagat tena tasmād viṣṇur iti smṛtaḥ || 2.98 haraṇād eva duḥkhānāṃ harir ity abhidhīyate | sa tu devaś caturvyūho bhuvaneṣv adhitiṣṭhate || 2.99 dharmādiṣu parāṃ siddhim avāpya hitakāmyayā | vāsudevaḥ smṛto dharmo jñānaṃ saṅkarṣaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ || 2.100 tathā vimuktaḥ* pradyumno'niruddhas sakaleśvaraḥ | yatra vyaktās samastāś ca catvāras tu guṇā ime || 2.101 tatra devāḥ prasīdanti catvāro bhaktavatsalāḥ | adharmād yās tu catvāro yatra doṣā vyavasthitāḥ || 2.102 taṃ prasahya vi gṛhṇanti majjayanti vipatsu ca | vedānām āśramāṇāṃ tu varṇānāṃ tu diśāṃ tathā || 2.103 vibhāgam ete kurvanti catvāro bhuvaneśvarāḥ | ity eṣas sṛṣṭimārgas tu saṃkṣepāt kathito mayā || 2.104 bhṛtakāmasya bāhulyāt vistāro naiva śakyate | nisargaviparītas tu pralayasya samaḥ smṛtaḥ || 2.105 pralayānte punaḥ prāpte nirvyāpāraḥ paraḥ pumān | vijñānaghanarūpo'sau parame vyomni tiṣṭhati || 2.106 tam evaṃ puruṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ mām avehi pitāmaha | māyayā śayitaṃ brahman nāgendre kṣīrasāgare || 2.107 mām eva bahudhā yajñair yajante sarvam ānavāḥ | anudhyāyanti mām eva yogino vijitendriyāḥ || 2.108 stutyaiḥ stuvanti mām eva bhaktyā saṃpūjayanti ca | pravadanti ca mām eva vedaśākhāśirāṃsi ca || 2.109 aham eva virāḍātmā sarva lokātmakaḥ sthitaḥ | mayi lokāḥ sthitās sarve tenāsmi jagataḥ prabhuḥ || 2.110 bhaktimantaḥ prapadyante nityaṃ mām eva ye narāḥ | siddhimanto bhaviṣyanti kṛtārthās te na saṃśayaḥ || 2.111 icchādvayaṃ ca me brahman prāṇinaḥ pratijāyate | ekā'pekṣā'paropekṣā nityaṃ yābhyām ahaṃ sthitaḥ || 2.112 śubhakarmakarān bhaktān anugṛhṇāmi pūrvayā | adhārmikān abhaktāṃś ca nigṛhṇāmy anayā punaḥ || 2.113 yata eva matolabdhvā śarīraṃ sarvasādhanam | viśuddhaṃ karma kartavyaṃ matprasādāya dehibhiḥ || 2.114 prasanne mayi sarveṣāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ pitāmaha | svargo vā'py apavargo vā bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 2.115 ity etat kathitaṃ brahman sāram uddhṛtya sarvataḥ | lokamātraṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotum icchasi || 2.116
iti śripāñcarātre paramasaṃhitāyāṃ sṛṣṭikramo nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ
*[viraktaḥ?]
atha tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||
brahmā yat tvayā paramo devaḥ kathitas sargakāraṇam | kathaṃ saṃpūjanaṃ tasya dhyānaṃ vā saṃbhaven nṛṇām || 3.1 na hy asau kāraṇaiḥ kaścit[kaccit?] paricchinnaḥ kadācana | digdeśakālarūpaiś ca na rūpaṃ tasya niścitaḥ || 3.2 atha tasya kathaṃ pūjā kartavyā siddhim īpsatā | etadbū(brū?)hi kathaṃ nyāyyaṃ devadeva paraṃ hitam || 3.3 paramaḥ guhyam etat tvayā pṛṣṭaṃ vakṣyāmi hitakāmyayā | yādṛśaṃ devadevasya pūjanaṃ tadvidhaṃ śruṇu || 3.4 mūrtimān eva pūjyo'sāv amūrter na tu pūjanam | kāryārthaṃ mūrtayas tasya lokānugrahahetavaḥ || 3.5 ataḥ puruṣarūpeṇa kalpayitvā tam acyutam | abhyarcya parayā bhaktyā siddhiṃ gacchanti mānavaḥ || 3.6 nirākāre tu deveśe nārcanaṃ saṃbhaven nṛṇām | na ca dhyānaṃ na ca stotraṃ tasmāt sākāram arcayet || 3.7 ākāre tu kṛtā pūjā stutir vā dhyānam eva vā | vidhinā śāstradṛṣṭena deva eva kṛtā bhavet || 3.8 bhaktyā paramayā'kṛṣṭo devadevas sa yogibhiḥ | teṣām anugrahārthāya rūpaṃ bheje caturbhujam || 3.9 tasmāt tenaiva rūpeṇa devadevaṃ samarcayet | phalabhedāt dvidhā tasya pūjanaṃ śāstracoditam || 3.10 phalam abhyudayaḥ pūrvaṃ nirvāṇaṃ tu paraṃ phalam | aparaś ca paraś ceti tayor devo'pi bhidyate || 3.11 udayāyāparaḥ pūjyo nirvāṇāya paraḥ pumān | tatrāṣṭabhujam ākāraṃ kalpayitvā suvāhanam || 3.12 sāyudhaṃ saparivāraṃ ca udayārthī prapūjayet | mahendranīlasaṅkāśaṃ padmākṣaṃ pītavāsasam || 3.13 pūjākālaś ca pūrvāhnaḥ kālas saṃvatsaro'vamaḥ | avicchedaś ca pūjāyā nityam āphalalābhataḥ || 3.14 atyabhyudayakāla[ma]sya pūjanaṃ parikīrtitam | niśśreyasārthino brahman yathā pūjā tathā śruṇu || 3.15 śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ gadā padmaṃ caturbhir dhārayet[yan] bhujaiḥ | arcanīyaḥ paro devaḥ śuddhasphaṭika sannibhaḥ || 3.16 sṛṣṭibījaṃ tathā padmaṃ cakraṃ sthitinibandhanam | gadā saṃhārabījaṃ tu śaṅkhaṃ muktinibandhanam || 3.17 madhyaṃdinādikālo'yaṃ yathāśakti ca pūjanam | phaleṣu nirapekṣattvaṃ yāvajjīvaṃ tu pūjanam || 3.18 sarvatattvayutasyaiva pūjā saṃhāramārgataḥ | ity evaṃ mokṣakāmasya pūjanaṃ te prakīrtitam || 3.19 tayos tu pūjayor brahman mokṣapūjā viśiṣyate | ātyantikaphalatvāt tu netarā tadviparyayāt || 3.20 kṛtasya karmaṇo nāśo nāsti janmaśateṣv api | saṃpātāt puṣṭir eva syād asaṃyogā phalāntare || 3.21 sukhaṃ cānuttamaṃ muktir aduḥkham āpi naśvaram | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena mokṣahetor atandritaḥ || 3.22 vāsudevam upāsīta codayārthī mahāmanāḥ | trividhaṃ pūjanaṃ tasya karmaṇā vacasā dhiyā || 3.23 uttarottaram eteṣāṃ mahāphalam iti sthitiḥ | gandhapuṣpādibhir dravyair vimalais sādhusammataiḥ || 3.24 mantreṇa viniyogas tu karmayajña iti smṛtaḥ | stotrāṇāṃ caiva mantrāṇāṃ śucir bhūtvā samāhitaḥ || 3.25 yaj japaṃ kurute bhaktyā vāgyajña iti saṃsmṛtaḥ | sarvaṃ vāhyaṃ parityajya mānasaiva yathāvidhi || 3.26 yad arcayati deveśaṃ manoyajñas sa ucyate | ekaikasya tridhā bhedo brahman śaktivaśā(t) smṛtaḥ || 3.27 sāttvikī rājasī caiva tāmasī caiva sā tridhā | sātvikī muktihetos tu rājasī kāmasiddhaye || 3.28 tāmasī parapīḍārthaṃ pūrvapūrvā garīyasī | brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāś śūdrā yoṣita eva ca || 3.29 bhaktiyuktāḥ svabhāvena kuryād devasya pūjanam | samṛddhāś ca daridrāś ca yuvānaḥ sthavirās tathā || 3.30 paṇḍitā yogino vāpi kuryur devasya pūjanam | haripādārcanād anyan na kiṃcit paramaṃ hitam || 3.31 tasmāt sarvaprayatnena vaiṣṇavaḥ puruṣo bhavet | na kaścit phalado loke taṃ muktvā puruṣottamam || 3.32 tadicchayā pravartante karmāṇi ca phalāni ca | na sampadāṃ samāhāre nāpadāṃ vinivartane || 3.33 samarthaḥ puruṣaḥ kaścit tasmād devam upāśrayet || 3.34 brahmā kathaṃ pūjyas sa deveśaḥ pūjakaḥ kīdṛśo bhavet | anuṣṭhānaṃ ca kiṃ tasya phalaṃ va kīdṛśaṃ bhavet || 3.35 paramaḥ arcanasya vidhiṃ vakṣye tava brahman samāhitaḥ | yathā bhāgavataḥ kuryād yāgaṃ bhagavato hareḥ || 3.36 samayo'gre samācāraḥ svādhyāyo dravyasaṃgrahaḥ | śuddhir yāgas stutir dhyānam ity evaṃ vidhiraṣṭadhā || 3.37 vidhinā'nena yastiṣṭhet sa bhāgavata ucyate | janmāntarakṛtaiḥ puṇyairnaro bhāgavato bhavet || 3.38 dvividhaḥ puruṣo brahman dīkṣito'dīkṣitastathā | dīkṣitassakalaṃ kuryādekadeśamadīkṣitaḥ || 3.39 samayastu dvayostulyaḥ tasmātsamayamācaret | dhyātavyo bhagavāneva nānyo viśvasya kāraṇāt || 3.40 svāmitvena gurutvena suhṛttvena ca sarvadā | tadvidyādhyayanaṃcaiva tadguṇaśravaṇādaraḥ || 3.41 tadbhakteṣuca viśvāsaḥ karmaṇā manasā girā | dravyakarmaguṇānāṃ ca sātvikānāṃ niṣevaṇam || 3.42 na kadācinmatiṃ kuryāt paratantraniṣevaṇe | devāgāraṃ samīpasthaṃ kuryāddevaṃ pradakṣiṇam || 3.43 nirmālyaṃ laṅghayennaiva na bhuñjīta na saṃspṛśet | na dadyācca na jighrecca rakṣet......ca || 3.44 stotrāṇi satataṃ tatra śucirbhūtvā svayaṃ japet | sāyaṃ prātardiśopañca[rdivā madhyaṃ?] dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum || 3.45 suptotthitaḥ svayaṃ gacchan namaskurvan patannapi | pratigṛhṇan dadhānaṃca[naśca] mantramaṣṭākṣaraṃ japet || 3.46 pāṣaṇḍasamayasthāṃśca devakośopajīvinaḥ | nāstikān ninditānduṣṭān na spṛśenna ca saṃvadet || 3.47 āsanaṃ śayanaṃ yānaṃ nātiṣṭhecca kurūpakam | napādau tatra kurvīta yatra rūpaṃ hareḥ sthitam || 3.48 sthānāni śruṇuyādviṣṇostīrthāni ca viśeṣataḥ | upāsakāṃśca siddhāṃśca bāndhavāniva sarvadā || 3.49 nāśuddhadravyamaśnīyānnāśubhaiśca samāhṛtam | na māṃsaṃ naca madyāni madyapairvā manaḥśṛtam || 3.50 dīkṣitaḥ śrāddhasaṅghātasūtānnāni vivarjayet | aśucirna bhavennityaṃ dhīro bhāgavato bhavet || 3.51 vaiṣṇavāṃśca viśiṣṭāṃśca pañcarātraviśāradān | karmaṇāṃ vicikitsādhuḥ[syāt?] sarvakālaṃ vicārayet || 3.52 nāpṛṣṭastu svayaṃ brūyānnacānyāyena pṛcchataḥ | jānannapi hi medhāvī jaḍavallokamācaret || 3.53 vyāsīnā[vyādhīnāṃ?]ssaṃprayoge ca bhaye ca pratyupasthite | aṣṭākṣaraṃ japennityaṃ dvādaśākṣarameva vā || 3.54 pramāde vā'parādhe vā laṅghane samayasya ca | prāyaścittaṃ japaṃ kuryāt sahasraṃ śatamevavā || 3.55 ityevaṃ samayaḥ prokto brahmannuddeśatastava | anyacca vaiṣṇave dharme vihitaṃ paripālayet || 3.56 ācāramadhunā vakṣye kāryaṃ bhāgavataissadā | ācāro nityakarmaiva śāstradṛṣṭaṃ prakīrtyate || 3.57 uṣaḥkāle malotsargaṃ kṛtvā prakṣālya vāgyataḥ | śucir ācamya sandhyāyāṃ pañcopaniṣadaṃ japet || 3.58 śatakṛtvaḥ sahasraṃ vā daśakṛtvothavā'padi | bhāskaraṃ kālamantreṇa svamantreṇa diśāṃ kramāt || 3.59 namaskṛtvā śucir bhūtvā mantram aṣṭākṣaraṃ japet | dvādaśākṣaram evāpi yathāsaṃbhavam anvaham || 3.60 stotrāṇi ca japitvānte devadevam anusmaret | bhaktaiśca saha saṃbhāṣya brāhmaṇais tu viśeṣataḥ || 3.61 anutiṣṭhet svakarmāṇi nityaṃ dharmoktam eva ca | mantrāṇi śruṇuyād viṣṇoḥ kathāṃ yāṃ pāpanāśinīṃ || 3.62 tadbhaktais saha varteta vivādaṃ teṣu varjayet | trikālam ekakālaṃ vā śaktitaḥ puruṣottamam || 3.63 snātvā bhaktyā yajed devaṃ nityakarmaṇy atandritaḥ | ayanādiṣu [sarveṣu?] dvādaśyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 3.64 puṇyasthāneṣu tīrtheṣu viśeṣeṇa prapūjayet | viṣṇurūpāṇi saṃpaśyet prayatnenāparāṇi vā || 3.65 tatra tatra namaskṛtya tam eva pratipadyate | nānṛtaṃ saphalaṃ kuryāt kadācid devapādayoḥ || 3.66 āpatkāle vi['pi] varteta deva bimbasya nopari | devadevāśrayān dhīro nibhṛtaṃ kīrtayet kvacit || 3.67 kāraṇe samanuprāpte na vācyam iti kīrtayet | grāsamuṣṭiṃ gave dadyāt prāg evāśanakālataḥ || 3.68 nānanujñāpya bhuñjīta yatīn bhāgavatān api | dīkṣitānāṃ samācāraṃ vakṣye tava pitāmaha || 3.69 yathā bhāgavatānāṃ hi siddhir bhavati śāśvatī | prātar evotthito maunī manasā sarvam uccaran || 3.70 prāṅmukho gantukāmas tu vāmapādaṃ nyased bhuvi | praviśed vāmapādena nivṛtyātmānam uccaret[ran] || 3.71 malaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā mṛdbhir adbhiś ca śāstrataḥ | spṛṣṭvā viśvātmanā toyam ācāmet puruṣātmanā || 3.72 parameṣṭhyātmanā prokṣya śiras sarvāṅgam eva vā | sandhyām upāsya vidhinā japitvā ca yathākramam || 3.73 manomantreṇa saṅkalpya paramātmānam avyayam | spṛṣṭvāhaṃkāramantreṇa indriyāṇi sakṛt sakṛt || 3.74 abhivandyāmṛśed gāṃ ca kapilāṃ buddhividyayā | mantraṃ param anuspṛśya laukikaṃ kāryam ācaret || 3.75 datvā devāya viprebhyo gandhamātrasya vidyayā | tenaiva gandham ālabhya hastaśaucaṃ samācaret || 3.76 bheṣajāny upayuñjīta rasamātrasya vidyayā | darśanaṃ rūpamantreña puṣpāṇy ābharaṇāni ca || 3.77 sparśamantreṇa vastrāṇi maṅgalāny āsanaṃ tathā | śruṇuyāc ca śubhāṃ vācaṃ śabdamātrasya vidyayā || 3.78 mahābhūteṣu sarveṣu tanmātreṇaiva saṃsmaret | aśucīnāṃ ca saṃsparśe kutsitānnasya bhojane || 3.79 anyeṣu cāpy apathyeṣu pañcagavyaṃ naraḥ pibet | saṃgṛhyopaniṣanmantrair bhājane vimale kramāt || 3.80 gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ sarpir dadhi kṣīraṃ ca pañcamam | parameṣṭhyādibhiḥ pītvā tair deham abhimantrayet || 3.81 evaṃ pāpād vimuktaḥ syāt kārya[ya?]śuddhiś ca jāyate | mantraiḥ snātvā vidhānena vāsudevaṃ jagadgurum || 3.82 kṛtarakṣo'rcayen nityaṃ tanmantraiḥ kṛtavigraham | śudhyarthaṃ prathamaṃ snātvā mantrasnānaṃ samācaret || 3.83 sarveṇa mṛdam ādāya nivṛttyā vāri śodhayet | viśvena tīrtham āvāhya puruṣeṇānulepayet || 3.84 parameṣṭhyātmanā snāyād ācāmed vidhinā punaḥ | pañcopaniṣadā prokṣya sarvagātraṃ viśodhayet || 3.85 antarjala gato bhūtvā pañcamantrān kramāj japet | prāṇāyāmaiḥ tribhir dvābhyām ekena vinayena vā || 3.86 japitvā tu kṛtasnānaḥ paridhāyātha vāsasī | ācāntaḥ prāṅmukho bhūtvā kuśalaṃ nissamāhitaḥ || 3.87 japet paramahaṃsaṃ tu trimātraṃ praṇavaṃ tathā | sahasraṃ śatavāraṃ vā dvādaśāṣṭākṣarāv api || 3.88 ādityam upatiṣṭheta pūrvaṃ muktvā jalāñjalim | etair eva mahāmantraiḥ kālena ca kṛtāñjaliḥ || 3.89 sūkṣmaṃ tejomayaṃ dhyātvā maṇḍalasthaṃ paraṃ prabhum | tarpayed devatāḥ paścād udakena yathākramam || 3.90 indrādīn viṣṇupūrvāṃś ca vāsudevādikān api | mūrtīr dvādaśaśaktīś ca paramātmānam eva ca || 3.91 pṛthivyādīni bhūtāni ṛṣīṃś ca pitṛbhis saha | ādau nāma dvitīyāntaṃ tarpayāmīti cottaram || 3.92 eṣa mantras tu nirdiṣṭaḥ tarpaṇe tu yathātatham | saṃtarpya punar ācamya yāgasthānaṃ samācaret || 3.93 yatrārādhya paraṃ devaṃ vidhinā vaiṣṇavo naraḥ | śoṣabhojī parāṃ siddhim acireṇaiva gacchati || 3.94
iti śrīpāñcarātre paramasaṃhitāyāṃ vinayo nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||
atha caturtho'dhyāyaḥ ||
brahmā śrotum icchāmy ahaṃ deva viṣṇor ārādhanaṃ param | katham abhyarcanīyo'sau vaiṣṇavaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 4.1 paramaḥ athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi viṣṇor ārādhanakramam | yasyābhyāsād avāpnoti bhaktimān vaiṣṇavaṃ padam || 4.2 yāgasthānaṃ samāsādya prakṣālyācamya vāgyataḥ | mantreṇa gṛham ālokya vedisthaṇḍilam eva ca || 4.3 vediṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā namaskṛtya samāhitaḥ | kṛtvopavītavad vastram uttaraṃ prāṅmukhaś śuciḥ || 4.4 āsīnaḥ praṇavenātha parāmṛśya karāv ubhau | kaniṣṭhādiṣu vinyasya pañcopaniṣadaḥ kramāt || 4.5 ṣaḍaṅgam ekahastena mudrāmantrais samācaret | astramantreṇa digbandhaṃ kṛtvā sarvāsu dikṣu ca || 4.6 agniprākāramadhyaṃ ca tejomantreṇa sarvataḥ | ātmarakṣāṃ vidhāyaivaṃ ācared dhāraṇākramam || 4.7 prāṇāyāmais tribhir yuktaṃ badhvā''dau yogasaṃpuṭam | pūraṇād recanād vāyo recanād vāpi yatnataḥ || 4.8 bhavet prāṇakṛtaḥ puṃsaḥ prāṇāyāmas sa ucyate | nābhipadme tato vāyaṃ saṃcintya puruṣātmanā || 4.9 dhārayet tatra caitanyaṃ vāyubhūtaṃ viśeṣataḥ | tato viśvātmanā vahniṃ hṛdi saṃcintya bhāskaram || 4.10 dhārayet tatra caitanyam agnibhūtaṃ samantataḥ | māhendrastaṃ bhavaṃ kaṇṭhe tatas sarveṇa dhārayet || 4.11 nivṛttyā varuṇaṃ mūrdhni vārirūpaṃ ca dhārayet | kṛṣṇā raktā ca pītā ca śuklarūpā ca dhāraṇā || 4.12 tribhis tribhiḥ smṛtaikaikā prāṇāyāmair yathoditaiḥ | dhāraṇāsu ca sarvāsu niścalena samādhinā || 4.13 tadguṇānvitam ity evaṃ jagat sarvaṃ vicintayet | pūrako recakaḥ kuṃbho nirmaya iti kramāt || 4.14 dhāraṇāsu ca vijñeyaḥ kāryo bhāgavatair naraiḥ | nirdagdhakalmaṣas tv evaṃ dhāraṇābhiḥ kṛto yadā || 4.15 tato yogamayaṃ dhyānam ātiṣṭhed ātmaśuddhidam | pṛthivyādīni bhūtāni niścalena samādhinā || 4.16 pralayakramam āsthāya saṃharet paramātmani | tataḥ sthūlaśarīrāntāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ sarvāṃ vicintya ca || 4.17 sṛṣṭvā dakṣiṇahastena mantrān uktvā krameṇa ca | dhyātvā tu kāraṇāny eva yathāsthānaṃ niveśayet || 4.18 madhyāsye hṛdi guhye tu tathā pādatalakramāt | ākāśādīni bhūtāni pañcamantrais tu vinyaset || 4.19 evaṃ mantramayo bhūtva mahāyogasamādhinā | amṛtodakasaṃpūrṇaiḥ kalaśair hemanirmitaiḥ || 4.20 diṅnārīṇāṃ karadhṛtair ātmānam abhiṣecayet | saṃcintya hṛdaye sūryaṃ bhāsvaraṃ maṇḍalākṛtim || 4.21 tasmin saṃcintya somaṃ tu tathā some'gnimaṇḍalam | evam antar bahiś cāpi śarīraṃ mantranirmitam || 4.22 kalpayitvā hareḥ pūjāṃ kartum arhati sādhakaḥ | sakṛd eva svayaṃ bhūtvā devadevaṃ samarcayet || 4.23 samānavyavahāre'pi na pūjyaḥ pūjako'pi vā | śarīraṃ prākṛtaṃ tasmāt saṃhṛtya pralayakramām || 4.24 viśuddham anyad utpādya pūjayet puruṣottamam | sthaṇḍile pratimāyāṃ vā jale vā'gnāv athāpi vā || 4.25 manasā vā yajed devaṃ hṛdyākāśe'tha maṇḍale | sūryamaṇḍalamadhye vā yathāsambhavam arcayet || 4.26 dravyāṇi pūrvam āhṛtya viśuddhāni samantataḥ | parameṣṭhyātmanā prokṣya yāgapīṭhaṃ prakalpayet || 4.27 pīṭhaṃ siddhamayaṃ tatra devas saṃpūjyate hariḥ | vāsudevādayaḥ pādā yāgapīṭhasya niṣṭhitāḥ || 4.28 adharmādyās tu catvāraḥ pādapīṭhāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | āgneyyāṃ vāsudevas tu dharmamūrtiḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 4.29 nairṛtyāṃ jñānamūrtis tu devaḥ saṅkarṣaṇaḥ sthitaḥ | pradyumno diśi vāyavyāṃ vairāgyātmā vyavasthitaḥ || 4.30 aiśvaryamūrtir aiśānyām aniruddho vyavasthitaḥ | vaṃśāś catvāra eva syur adharmādyās tu buddhayaḥ || 4.31 ahaṃkārās trayaḥ pāśā'yatanās tu trayoguṇāḥ | staraṇāny asya bhūtāni rudracchadanam ucyate || 4.32 tasmin brahmodbhavaṃ padmaṃ siddhaṃ dvādaśa padmakam | antaḥkesarasaṃpūrṇaṃ madhye vipulakarṇikam || 4.33 adhiṣṭhātā virāḍasya lokamūrtiḥ prajāpatiḥ | padmapatreṣu vijñeyāḥ kramāt dvādaśa mūrtayaḥ || 4.34 mohinyādyās tripañcaitāḥ kesareṣu tu śaktayaḥ | guṇayonitrayaṃ mūle karṇikāyāḥ krameṇatu || 4.35 guṇaśaktitrayaṃ madhye krameṇaiva vyavasthitam | agnis somaś ca sūryaś ca teṣām upariniṣṭhitāḥ || 4.36 evam etad yathānyāyaṃ pīṭhamantraiḥ prakalpyaca | gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjāṃ devapīṭhasya kalpayet || 4.37 parābhiś śaktibhis tasmin vigrahaṃ paramātmanaḥ | caturbhujam anudhyāyec chuddhasphaṭikanirmalam || 4.38 śaṅkhacakragadāpadmaiś caturbhiḥ kṛtalakṣaṇam | tasminn āvāhayed devaṃ paramātmānam acyutam || 4.39 añjalau manasā pīṭhaṃ prathamaṃ parikalpayet | āvāhayet tato devaṃ saṃbhṛtyai tatra sarvagam || 4.40 cetanaṃ nityatṛptaṃ ca praṇave parameṣṭhinā | praṇave saṃniviṣṭantam āhvayet puruṣātmanā || 4.41 añjalisthe tataḥ pīṭhe dhyāyed viśvātmanā param | nivṛttyātmānam uccārya taṃ dehe viniveśayet || 4.42 sarvātmanā śarīreṇa saṃyuktam anucintayet | praṇamya kiṃcid utthāya prayujya svāgataṃ punaḥ || 4.43 sānnidhyaṃ prārthayitvā ca satvasya guṇavidyayā | rajasaḥ śaktimantreṇā dadyāt pādyādikaṃ kramāt || 4.44 aṣṭākṣareṇa mantreṇa dadyād ardhyaṃ yathāvidhi | mukhavāsaṃ tato dadyād rasamātrasya vidyayā || 4.45 datvā dhūpena mālyādi labdhanujñaḥ pradakṣiṇam | dattvā'gnikāryam ārabhya saṃskṛtya vidhivad dhaviḥ || 4.46 devapārśvaṃ samāsādya yathāvad vidhipūrvakam | tamasaḥ śaktimantreṇa snānaṃ devasya kārayet || 4.47 pañcopaniṣadā kṛtvā śāntiṃ śuddhena vāriṇā | guṇamantreṇa vastre dve dadyād yajñopavītikam || 4.48 dadyād ābharaṇāny eva saṃbhavān manasāh ivā | dadyāc caiva śubhān gandhān gandhamātrasya vidyayā || 4.49 dadyāt puṣpāṇi mālāś ca rūpeṇādarśam eva ca | sparśamantreṇa dhūpaṃ ca dīpaṃ rūpasya vidyayā || 4.50 ardhyaṃ datvā vidhānena dvādaśākṣaravidyayā | havīṃṣi rasamātreṇa bhakṣyabhojyādikaṃ punaḥ || 4.51 toyaṃ ca mukhavāsaṃ ca datvā mantreṇa pūrvavat | stotrāṇi śabdamātreṇa nivedya praṇipatyaca || 4.52 diṅmantreṇa parikramya namaskṛtya pradakṣiṇam | kālena japakālaṃ ca śubhaṃ kṛtvā yathepsitam || 4.53 japaṃ[pan?] paramahaṃsaṃ ca dvādaśākṣaram eva ca | aṣṭākṣaraṃ ca deveśaṃ dhyātvā praṇavam eva vā || 4.54 ardhyaṃ paramahaṃsena tato datvā praṇamya ca | ātmānaṃ kiṅkaratvena nivedyātha visarjayet || 4.55 āvāhito yathāpūrvaṃ visarge'pi tathā smaret | krameṇa viparītena kṣantavyam iti cārcayet || 4.56 etad vīravidhir hy eṣaḥ saṃkṣepāt kathito mayā | iṣṭvaiva paramātmānaṃ nityaṃ bhāgavataś śuciḥ || 4.57 sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā muktimārgaṃ prapadyate | labhate cepsitān kāmān ihāmutra ca sarvaśaḥ || 4.58 nistaraty apavargāṃś ca śatrubhiś ca na bādhyate | saṃskṛtaś ca vidhānena viditaṃ tāntriko vidhim || 4.59 prayujya labhate siddhim anyathā pātakī bhavet | pratimāyām upāsīta pīṭhaṃ kṛtvā krameṇa tu || 4.60 dhyātvā yogamayaṃ mūrtiṃ pratimām eva cetasā | sthāpayitvā hariṃ tasyām āvāhya vidhinā yajet || 4.61 jalamadhye'pi yāgasya neti [navi?] śeṣo'sti kaścana | agnimadhye tu tat sarvaṃ jalaśūnyaṃ prapūrayet || 4.62 hṛdyābhoge tu yāgasya manasā sarvam ācaret | maṇḍale yajamānas tu kalpayed vidhim īdṛśam || 4.63 yogaiśvaryādikāś śaktīr dikṣu sarvāsu bhāgaśaḥ | bahirāvaraṇe kuryād yogapīṭhasya sādhakaḥ || 4.64 tāsām api bahiḥ kuryāt dikṣu dvādaśamāsapān | lokapālān bahisteṣāṃ vāsa dikṣv indrapūrvakam || 4.65 cakramaṇḍalamārgeṇa sarvaṃ dhyātvā yathākramam | akṣabhūmigataṃ pīṭhaṃ dhyātvā devaṃ samarcayet || 4.66 sūryamaṇḍalamadhye'pi yāgasyāyaṃ vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ | evam eteṣu vaikuṇṭhaṃ pūjāsthāneṣu pūjayet || 4.67 yathāyogaṃ yathākālaṃ devapūjāviśāradaḥ | sthaṇḍilādikrameṇaiva labdhvā ca pratyayāt punaḥ || 4.68 sthāneṣv anyeṣu yaṣṭavyam evaṃ doṣo'nyathā mahān | sarveṣām eva yāgānāmāśāpālān bahiḥ sthitān || 4.69 kurvīta vighnarakṣārthaṃ yāgasya paramātmanaḥ | sarveṣām eva yāgānāṃ mānaso yāga uttamaḥ || 4.70 aprasāde hi manasaḥ karmayogo'pi niṣphalaḥ | snehapūrvam anudhyānaṃ bhaktir ity abhidhīyate || 4.71 pūjanaṃ hi vinā bhaktyā kṛtam apy akṛtaṃ bhavet | aṣṭāṅgā bhaktir uddiṣṭā vaiṣṇavasya viśeṣataḥ || 4.72 yām avāpya parāṃ siddhim acireṇādhigacchati | devasyārādhanaṃ nityaṃ samayasya ca rakṣaṇam || 4.73 vaiṣṇavasya ca viśvāsaḥ pūjāyām ādaro mahān | svayam ārādhane yatnaṃ tatkathāśravaṇādaraḥ || 4.74 parabādhāsv anāsthā ca tatpūjānupajīvanam | ity eṣāṣṭavidhā bhaktir vidyate yasya dehinaḥ || 4.75 ya idaṃ śruṇuyāt tantraṃ sa cedaṃ vaktum arhati || 4.76 brahmā yad abhyudayakāmasya proktam ārādhanaṃ tvayā | aparasyādi devasya tad idānīṃ bravīhi me || 4.77 paramaḥ ayam evāparasyāpi viṣṇor ārādhanakramaḥ | viśeṣatantraṃ vakṣyāmi sarvam anyad yathoditam || 4.78 aṣṭabāhus tadārādhyo raktapadme janārdanaḥ | vāhanenāyudhaiś cāpi parivāraiś ca saṃbhṛtaḥ || 4.79 anantaḥ pannagaḥ prācyāṃ paścimāyāṃ ca pakṣirāṭ | devasya vāmato lakṣmīr dakṣiṇena sarasvatī || 4.80 agneyyāṃ vṛddhir eva syān nairṛtyāṃ siddhir ucyate | vāyavyāṃ matir uddiṣṭā śantir īśānagocarā || 4.81 śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ gadā padmaṃ khaḍgaṃ kheṭaṃ śaraṃ dhanuḥ | ity āyudhāni devasya kareṣv aṣṭasu padmaja || 4.82 urasā kaustubhaṃ ratnaṃ śrīvatsaṃ ca samudvahan | lokopakārasiddhyartham anekaṃ rūpam āsthitaḥ || 4.83 pūjanīyo vibhūty arthaṃ devo dvādaśamūrtibhiḥ | haṃsaṃ paramahaṃsasya sthāne sarvatra yojayet || 4.84 sṛṣṭikrameṇa tattvānāṃ vinyāsaṃ parikalpayet | pūjānte kāmasaṅkalpaṃ kāle cācchidram arcanam || 4.85 sarvaśaktyā nibhitteṣu vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca bhojanam | dānāni vividhāny evam ācāryāṇāṃ ca satkriyām[yā?] || 4.86 vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca mantrāṇām upadeśaiḥ prasādhanam | vratānāṃ kālayuktānām avicchedena dhāraṇam || 4.87 ity abhyudayakāmasya vidhir eṣaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | saṃvatsaraṃ yajed devaṃ varṣāṇi dvādaśaiva vā || 4.88 vi[dvi?]vidho'bhyudayaḥ prokto devapūjāsamāśraye[yāt?] | prathamo dṛṣṭajanmasthaḥ parajanmāśrayo'paraḥ || 4.89 prathamo laghur atra syāt dvitīyo gurur ucyate | kāmenopāsya deveśam aprāpya nidhanaṃ gataḥ || 4.90 janmāntare tato bhūyaḥ sa taṃ kāmam avāpnuyāt | yāvajjīvaṃ tu ye devaṃ vibhūtyartham upāsate || 4.91 rājānas te bhaviṣyanti pūrṇā janapadeśvarāḥ | athavā nāvagantavyo viśeṣaḥ kālanirmitaḥ || 4.92 tīvrabhaktimatāṃ naṇāṃ siddhir bhavati nānyathā | etad uddeśataḥ proktam aparasya pitāmaha || 4.93 pūjanaṃ devadevasya bahudhā yatprakīrtyate || 4.94
iti śripāñcarātre paramasaṃhitāyāṃ arcanāvidhānaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ
atha pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
kāni dravyāṇi pūjāyām eṣāṃ saṃgraha iṣyate | śuciś ca kīdṛśī teṣām etan me bhagavan vada || 5.1 paramaḥ amā sthānaṃ ca pātrāṇi darbhāmbu pratimā api | gandhapuṣpāṇi bhūṣāṃś ca dhūpadīpākṣatāni ca || 5.2 ardhyaṃ nivedyam ityādi pūjadravyaṃ pitāmaha | etāni śodhayitvā'gre pūjayet puruṣottamam || 5.3 tatrātmā[tma?]no bahu[hi?]śśuddhiḥ snānenācamanena ca | pūrvamuktaṃ mayā sathānaṃ[snā?]śruṇu vakṣyāmi padmaja || 5.4 aṅguṣṭhatalamūlaṃ hi brahmatīrtham iti smṛtam | triḥ pibed brahmatīrthyena saṃprabhṛjya mukhaṃ punaḥ || 5.5 vāmahastaṃ punaḥ prokṣya pādayoś ca tale ubhe | talena hṛdayaṃ spṛṣṭvā mukham aṅgulibhis tathā || 5.6 aṅguṣṭhe'nāmikāṃ kṛtvā netraṃ spṛṣṭvā ca vāriṇā | tenaiva tarjanīṃ kṛtvā tathā dve nāsike ubhe || 5.7 kaniṣṭhaṃ tu tathā kṛtvā tenaiva śravaṇe spṛśet | tathaiva madhyamāṃ kṛtvā bāhudeśāv ubhau spṛśet || 5.8 tenaiva nābhideśaṃ ca sarvair yuktaḥ śiraḥ spṛśet | etad ācamanaṃ proktaṃ dīkṣitasya viśeṣataḥ || 5.9 paṃca mantrān krameṇoktvā pītvonmṛjya mukhaṃ punaḥ | bhūya eva tathācamya prokṣya mantrais tu pañcabhiḥ || 5.10 ārabheta hareḥ pūjām anyad anyas samācaret | snānam adbhir mṛdā cāpi prokṣaṇācamanair api || 5.11 śarīraṃ bahir antaś ca puruṣasya viśudhyati | satyapriyatamālāpair vācaḥ śuddhir vidhīyate || 5.12 jñānaprasāda santoṣā manasaḥ śuddhihetavaḥ | etat trayaṃ bhaved yasya viśuddhaṃ dehinas sadā || 5.13 tathaiva pūjayā nityaṃ tasya devaḥ prasīdati | eṣā'tmaśuddhir ākhyātā sthānaśuddhim ataḥ śruṇu || 5.14 dyūta bhojanayoḥ sthānam uccārasthānam eva ca | āsanaṃ ca śmaśānasya[naṃca?] caṇḍālādhiṣṭhitaṃ tathā || 5.15 kṛmikīṭayutaṃ cāpi tuṣabhasmāsthisaṃyutam | mahāja(nā)varuddhaṃ ca pūjāsthānaṃ vigarhitam || 5.16 śubhām api sadā bhūmiṃ gomayenānulepayet | gomayaṃ tu navaṃ grāhyaṃ bhūmisthaṃ dhenusaṃbhavam || 5.17 vatsajaṃ śithilaṃ śuklaṃ kīṭaduṣṭaṃ tu varjayet | upaliptam athāstreṇa saṃsidhya[cya?] kalaśaṃ tyajet || 5.18 hastaṃ prakṣālya toyena saṃspṛśet pāṇinā punaḥ | vāyumantreṇa saṃprokṣya jalamantreṇa mantravit || 5.19 akṣataṃ vikiret tasmin mantreṇāṣṭākṣareṇa ca | sthānaśuddhir bhaved evaṃ pātraśuddhim ataḥ śruṇu || 5.20 āmrakalpe[lke?]na toyena hemaṃ tāmraṃ ca śodhayet | rājataṃ gṛhadhūmena śāntāṅgāreṇa vā punaḥ || 5.21 bhasmamiśreṇa toyena lohayuktaṃ viśodhayet | śaṅkhaśuktimayānāṃ tu lavaṇena viśodhanam || 5.22 phalapatramayānāṃ tu mṛdbhir adbhiś ca śodhanam | lepagandhāpanodena śuddhir bhavati nānyathā || 5.23 gandhapuṣpayutaṃ toyam ekapātre prapūrayet | pañcamantraiḥ [ntrān?] kramāt tasmai [smin?] pañcopaniṣadā nyaset || 5.24 prokṣayet tena sarvāṇi pātrāṇi pṛthag eva vā | akṣārākaluṣaṃ śuddhaṃ gandhapūrṇaṃ rasānvitam || 5.25 aspṛṣṭaṃ durjanais toyam analpaṃ sarvakarmasu | dravyaśuddhir bhavet tena beraśuddhim ataḥ śruṇu || 5.26 lohapātravadevāsya viśuddhir lohajasya tu | pūrṇenācchādanāc chuddhiḥ śailasya tu vidhīyate || 5.27 evaṃ dārumayasyāpi maṇijānāṃ tu mārjanam | evaṃ viśoddhya saṃhṛtya spṛṣṭvā śakramataḥ param || 5.28 beraśuddhiṃ vijānīyāt kuśādīnāṃ tu mārjanam | anyair anupayogas tu sarveṣāṃ śuddhir uttamā || 5.29 sadarbham āsanaṃ kṛtvā pūjāsthānād adhaḥsthitaḥ | darbhapāṇiḥ pavitreṇa vāri saṃskṛtya śodhayet || 5.30 śreṣṭho gandha[ḥ] samuddiṣṭaḥ kuṅkumāgarucandanaiḥ | pradagdhvā sahasāviṣṭaiḥ ślakṣṇaiḥ karpūrasaṃyutaiḥ || 5.31 kṛtrimo vā bhaved gandhaḥ prāmāṇyaṃ haritaḥ śubhaḥ | kevalaṃ candanaṃ cāpi viṣṇoḥ prītikaraṃ śubham || 5.32 karavīrāv ubhau padmau ketakī jātimallikā | utpalāni tathā trīṇi tagaraṃ campakaṃ tathā || 5.33 droṇa vānīraśamyākā śvetārka kuṭajaṃ tathā | kandalī bakulaṃ caiva tulasī navamallikā || 5.34 asanastabakastālaṃ tamālo marutaḥ śamī | punnāgo vaṃśa punnāgāḥ kṣudrapunnāga eva ca || 5.35 mālatī śveta kumudā devadārūtpaladvayam | kovidāraś ca nāgaś ca sadā bhadrapriyaṅgukā || 5.36 bilvaṃ ca navamālā ca kanyāhastidvayaṃ tathā | āvīraṃ karṇikāraṃ ca vaiṣṇavī śaṅkhapuṣpikā || 5.37 dvāvaśokau ca kundaś ca gandhapūrṇāṅkurāṇi ca | śephālikā kuravakaḥ pītakoraṇḍa eva ca || 5.38 nandyāvartadvayaṃ cāpi kṣudraketaka eva ca | evaṃ saṃgṛhya puṣpāṇi pūjayet puruṣottamam || 5.39 divāpuṣpair divāpūjā rātripuṣpais tathā niśi | āpatkāle yathāyogaṃ pūrvapūrvaṃ tu śasyate || 5.40 muktapuṣpā varā māyā māyā ca [yātayāmāca?] sṛkkarā tathā | varjitāni viśeṣeṇa tatrāpi parivarjayet || 5.41 koraṇḍa kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ ca kāpitthaṃ harikarṇikā | ājñāvibhītakaṃ caiva śirīṣaṃ madayantikā || 5.42 nirguṇḍī sindhuvāraṃ ca kiṃśukaḥ śalmalī japāḥ | arkaṃ ca kanakonmattaṃ karañjaṃ viṣapādapam || 5.43 bandhūkamādhavīnīpamarjunaṃ pāṭalaṃ tathā | caṇḍākośātakī caivā lāvū śigrastathaiva ca || 5.44 etāni vṛkṣavallīṣu viśeṣeṇa vivarjayet | hidruṃ[chinnaṃ?] ca mukulaṃ cāpi jīrṇaṃ paryuṣitaṃ tathā || 5.45 bhūmigaṃ bahubandhaṃ ca patitaṃ pātravarjitam | bhuktaśeṣaṃ parimlānam aspṛśyaspṛṣṭam eva ca || 5.46 puṣpaṃ vihitam apy etam āpatkāle'pi varjayet | pātre puṣpāṇi gṛhṇīyāt pāṇī prakṣālya vāriṇā || 5.47 vidhāya sthāpayet paścād apratāpe naro budhaḥ | yavamudva priyaṅgūnāṃ niṣpāvaṃ na ca kasya ca || 5.48 dūrvā bhūstṛṇamāṣāṇāṃ gṛhṇīyād aṅkurāṇi ca ārdrāṇi cāgrayuktāni nirvṛṇani nivedayet || 5.49 patrāṅkurāṇi devāya viparītāni varjayet | lāmajjaṃ sarvamūleṣu praśastaṃ paramātmanaḥ || 5.50 devadārukṛtaṃ dhūpaṃ candanāgarumiśritam | na[ā?]dadyād devapūjayāṃ vidhūmāṅgārasaṃbhavam || 5.51 sālaṃ sarjarasaṃ daṇḍaṃ kṛtrimāgaru miśritam | prāṇyaṅgavarjam anyad vā dhūpaṃ pātrān nivedayet || 5.52 gavyena sarpiṣā dīpaṃ tailenāpi kṛto[taṃ?] na vā[vaṃ?] | sūtravartiyutaṃ dadyād amukhānaladīpitam || 5.53 dukūlakṣaumanetrāṇi sūkṣma kārpāsitāni ca | navavastrāṇi devāya dhūpitāni nivedayet || 5.54 hemaratnamayāny eva dadyād ābharaṇāni ca | na dadyād doṣayuktāni bhuktapūrvāṇi vā nṛbhiḥ || 5.55 prāṇyaṅgatuṣabhasmāsthikāṣṭhapāṣāṇasaṃyutān | ucchinna hīnasaṃskārān taṇḍulān parivarjayet || 5.56 kundendu muktā śaṅkhābhaiḥ satkṛtaiḥ śālitaṇḍulaiḥ | ṣaḍbhiḥ prakṣālitaiḥ pakvaṃ payasaṃ tu nivedayet || 5.57 śāli ṣāṣṭika godhūma yavamudgādibhiḥ kṛtān | akṣāralavaṇām pṛṣṭān [piṣṭān?] dhṛtamṛṣṭān nivedayet || 5.58 varjanīyaṃ havir bhakṣyam atyuṣṇam atiśītalam | apakvam atipakvaṃ ca duṣṭapakvaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ || 5.59 kālapakvāni sarvāṇi phalāni madhurāṇi ca | kṛmikīṭaviyuktāni pūjākāle nivedayet || 5.60 gandhaparṇarasopetaṃ vastrapūtaṃ navaṃ ghṛtam | agnikārye nivedyaiva grāhyaṃ gokṣīrasaṃbhavam || 5.61 upastīrya ghṛtenādau pātre kṛtvā havir dvidhā | abhidhārya punas tena nivedyam upasādayet || 5.62 gandhapuṣpapradānena parivārasya pūjanam | ardhyapādyanivedyādi devasyaiva samarpayet || 5.63 palāśodumbarāśvatha plakṣanyagrodha sambhavāḥ | kṣīravṛkṣodbhavā vāpi dvādaśāṅgulamātrakāḥ || 5.64 samagrāḥ pīṭḥamantrais tu juhuyāt samidho budhaḥ | vakrā gandhayutāstīkṣṇā bhinnāś ca viṣavṛkṣajāḥ || 5.65 sacchidrās samidhaś śuṣkā juhuyān māraṇādiṣu | idhmas tu hastamātraṃ syāt paridhir bāhumātrakaḥ || 5.66 adbhis tu nityadhāryaṃ syāt labdho vā vaiṣṇavālayāt | evam etaiḥ śubhair dravyair ātmīyair devam arcayet || 5.67 uttarottara bhūyiṣṭhāḥ sapta jātīḥ smariṣyati | pūrvaṃ saṃskāra hāniś ca na kadācid bhaviṣyati || 5.68 tataḥ padam avāpnoti yad gatvā nānuśocati | anyadīyais tu ye dravyair arcayanti janārdanam || 5.69 dhanārthaṃ vā yaśo'rthaṃ vā sa teṣāṃ vikalaśramaḥ | pūjāhetoḥ prayacchanti ye kecit dravyam ātmanaḥ || 5.70 pūjāsu kriyamāṇāsu te bhavanty aṃśabhāginaḥ | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena dravyam ātmasamārjitam || 5.71 pūjāyāṃ viniyuñjīta nāpadyapi parārjitam || 5.72 dravyālābhe tu pūjāyāṃ puṣpair api samarcayet | puṣpālābhe tu toyena toyālābhe tu cetasā || 5.73 anyena vaiṣṇavenāpi vittamohe tu kārayet | natu devam anārādhya svayaṃ bhuñjīta buddhimān || 5.74 anarcayitvā ye devaṃ nāśnanti na pibanti ca | na teṣāṃ durlabhaṃ kiṃcid iha loke paratra ca || 5.75 yat karoti śubhair dravyair yat karoti dine dine | yat karoti svayaṃ bhaktyā tena viṣṇuḥ prasīdati || 5.76 evaṃ dravyāṇi śuddhiṃ ca[vidhānaṃ tava] padmaja | saṃkṣepāt kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ kathayāmi te || 5.77
iti śrīpāñcarātre paramasaṃhitāyāṃ dravyavidhānaṃ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ |
atha ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ
mantrakośaṃ samācakṣva yathāvat paramātmanaḥ | lakṣaṇaṃ viniyogasya phalāni vividhāni ca || 6.1 paramaḥ hanta te kathayiṣyāmi mantrāṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ param | bījāni viniyogaṃ ca guhyam etad ahaṃ tava || 6.2 mantrapūrvāḥ kriyās sarvā sādhayantīpsitaṃ phalam | mantrair ākṛṣyate devo mantrair eva visṛjyate || 6.3 mantraṇād eva mantrās te tasmāt tān na prakāśayet | na svarūpaṃ likhet teṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ na ca kīrtayet || 6.4 ādīpaḥ praṇavo bījaṃ sarvamantrasya niścitam | pāmayanyāpi [prāṇayaṃścāpi?] sarvasya tad eva paramaṃ matam || 6.5 tenaiva devam abhyarcya tam eva satataṃ japet | nityaṃ praṇavaniṣṭhasya siddhir bhavati tādṛśī || 6.6 praṇavān nādhiko mantraḥ kaścid asti pitāmaha | auṃkāras tu trimātraḥ syān makāras tv ardhamātrakaḥ || 6.7 praṇavāt tu paraṃ bījaṃ mantrāṇāṃ vividhaṃ smṛtam | bījātparo namaskāra iti sarvatra niścitaḥ || 6.8 namaskārāt paraṃ viddhi parā ceti padaṃ tathā | tasmā........śrityeva kamalāsanāt || 6.9 satvayonī rajoyoniḥ tamoyonīti nāma ca | caturthyantaṃ bahutvena paraśabdo'pi tatsamaḥ || 6.10 prathamaikādaśākāraṃ bindubhis savisargakaiḥ | jyeṣṭhādīnāṃ tu pañcānāṃ paṃca bījānilena ca || 6.11 tṛtīyapañcamābhyāṃ ca svarābhyāṃ dvādaśena ca | caturdaśyāṃ ca yuktena lakārenaiva pañcadhā || 6.12 pañcabījāni tāni syu[ḥ] vāgīśvaryādiṣu kramāt | ṣaṣṭhādyaiḥ pañcabhir yukto mohinyādiṣu sasmṛtaḥ || 6.13 nāmadheyas tu sarvāsāṃ hṛṣṭādeva [sṛṣṭāveva?] yathoditam | makāro bindubhūtas tu sarvabhūteṣu padmaja || 6.14 pareṣv avasthito jñeyaḥ śarīre prāṇavat sadā | dakāras tu guṇasyokto guṇānāṃ yonivat smara || 6.15 buddhibījaṃ bakāras tu buddhibhedeṣv ataḥ śruṇu | dharmādīnā makārādyaiś caturbhis sahito bhavet || 6.16 adharmādyeṣu vijñeyaś caturbhiḥ sa......bhir yutaḥ | ahaṃkāro[re?]makāras tu tadbhedeṣu guṇa svarāḥ || 6.17 pakāro manaso bījaṃ saṅkalpasya ca nāma ca | kālabījaṃ hakāras tu digbījaṃ savisargataḥ || 6.18 nakāradīni pañcaiva śabdamātrādiṣu smṛtāḥ | buddhīndriyeṣu ṇādīni tādīnyanyendriyeṣu ca || 6.19 ña kārādīni pañcaiva bhūtabījāni padmaja | nāmadheyāni sarveṣāṃ sṛṣṭāveva yathātham || 6.20 vāsudevādikānāṃ ca guṇaśaktisamanvayāt | bījāni kalpayedvidvān pañcarātraviśāradaḥ || 6.21 bahirāvaraṇe teṣāṃ viniyogaḥ kramātsmṛtaḥ | cakramantrān ato vakṣye cakramaṇḍalakalpane || 6.22 akṣabījaṃ cakāras tu cakramadhye vyavasthitam | kālabījaṃ hakāras tu svarair dvādaśabhir yutam || 6.23 meṣādi rāśibījāni vijñeyāny arabhūmiṣu | tithibījāni rāśīnāṃ vāmadakṣiṇa yogataḥ || 6.24 anupūrvāḥ smṛtāḥ śāntāḥ śuklakṛṣṇātmikā matāḥ | ādyaiḥ svakaiḥ kramād yuktā bindvantair vadanais saha || 6.25 śukle kṛṣṇe visargāntā meṣādi krama yogataḥ | nakṣatrāṇi ca kāntāni rephādīny aramadhyataḥ || 6.26 aśvayuk prabhṛtīny āhuḥ saṃsthitāni yathākramam | hādyā māntā gṛhā jñeyā vyutkramāda kṛtakramāḥ || 6.27 svarāśiṣu gṛhās sapta rāhuketu sthiter vaśāt | hrasvākṣarāṇi pūrvaṇi śrībījāni......bhā..bhiṣu || 6.28 sakāraś ca makāraś ca bījaṃ nemidvayasya ca | tattvanām api bījāni kīrtitāny eva sarvaśaḥ || 6.29 cakramantrā ime proktā yathāvac cakrakalpane | ṣaḍaṅgasyāpi bījāni śruṇu nāmāni ca kramāt || 6.30 guṇasvaraiḥ sahaikārair visargeṇa ca bindunā | hakāraḥ saṃyuto bījaṃ ṣaḍaṅgeṣu ca kīrtitam || 6.31 hṛdayaṃ ca śiraścaiva śikhākavacam eva ca | astranetraṃ ca nirdiṣṭaṃ ṣaḍaṅgam iti padmaja || 6.32 ātmarakṣāsu sarvatra pūjārambhe tu sandhyayoḥ | śayāno bhuktavāṃś cāpi ṣaḍaṅgaṃ nityam ācaret || 6.33 udakyāñjali mokṣe ca sthānaśuddhau ca sarvaśaḥ | āyudhānāṃ ca saṃsparśo śastramantro vidhīyate || 6.34 ātmanaḥ pariṣeke ca devasyāpi pradakṣiṇe | upasthāne ca sandhyāyāṃ diṅmantras tu vidhīyate || 6.35 japena bhūtamantrāṇāṃ bhūtāni vaśam ānayet | kālamantraṃ japan nityaṃ dīrgham āyur avāpnuyāt || 6.36 prakṛtestu japan mantraṃ svaḥstho bhavati sarvadā | vāsudevādikānāṃ tu mantrāṇāṃ satataṃ japāt || 6.37 dharmādi viṣayā siddhiḥ puruṣasyopajāyate | aṣṭākṣaraṃ japen nityaṃ dvādaśākṣaram eva vā || 6.38 ante ca praṇavaṃ kṛtvā mumukṣur niyatendriyaḥ | nāntataḥ praṇavanyāsaṃ phalakāmasya kīrtyate || 6.39 svāhākāraṃ tu homeṣu sarvatrānteṣu yojayet | kṣīrayāvakabhaikṣāṇi śākaṃ vā phalam eva vā || 6.40 bhakṣayet prayato bhūtvā sādhayen mantram īpsitam | nadīsaṅgamatīrtheṣu parvatāyataneṣu ca || 6.41 devatāṃ pūjayitvādau mantrān ahar ahar japet | sahasram ayutaṃ lakṣaṃ lakṣāṇi dvādaśottamam || 6.42 japena mantrāḥ sidhyanti homena ca phalapradāḥ | samidājyaphalādīni padmapatraṃ havīṃṣi ca || 6.43 juhuyāt phalasidhyarthaṃ phalakāmo dine dine | mahatas tu mahākālaḥ kālaś cālpaḥ kṛśasya tu || 6.44 kāme siddhetu tatkāme[le?] tadvidvān manasā caret | laghunā tu na kālena devam āvāhayet param || 6.45 parapīḍā nimittaṃ vā vaiṣṇavaḥ sādhayet kvacit | svayam eva vinaśyanti hy āpado viṣṇuyājinaḥ || 6.46 sampadaś ca vivardhante niṣkāmasyāpi santatam | phalam arthayamāno'pi kāmasaṅkalpavarjitaḥ || 6.47 pūjayitvā paraṃ devaṃ tatphalaṃ labhate dhruvam | idaṃ dehīti saṅkalpaḥ pūjyamāno'pi yatnataḥ || 6.48 na prasīdati govindaḥ kurvann api phalaṃ nṛṇām | atha ced vaiṣṇavasyāpi sādhyakāmo hṛdi sthitaḥ || 6.49 tadā tasyaiva devasya parivāraṃ prapūjayet | dvādaśāraṃ mahācakraṃ rājyahetoḥ prapūjayet || 6.50 bhāsvaraṃ sūryasaṅkāśaṃ nābhinemipariṣkṛtam | imi tyasya bhavedbījaṃ nāma cāsya sudarśanam || 6.51 pāñcajanyaṃ mahāśaṅkhaṃ yaśaḥkāmaḥ prapūjayet | śamity asya bhaved bījaṃ śabdapūrṇasya devatāḥ || 6.52 śatrūṇāṃ bādhanārthāya gadām eva prapūjayet | saṃharantīm iva kruddhām apradhṛṣyāṃ surāsuraiḥ || 6.53 ṣaḍ ity asya bhaved bījaṃ strī[rūpā] ruvācāsya devatā | kṛtyā durgeti nāmāni tasya eva pitāmaha || 6.54 dhanasañcayam anvicchan bhaktyā vaiśravaṇaṃ param | pūjayet tasya kiṃ bījaṃ tena sidhyati tatphalam || 6.55 vibhavān bhoktukāmas tu pūjayed agnim anvaham | gakāraṃ tasya bījaṃ tu nakṣatraṃ cāsyakṛttikā || 6.56 tithiyogeṣu vakṣyāmi saṃmānaṃ vā pitāmaha | etad uddeśamātreṇa kāmabījāni kānicit || 6.57 darśitāni tava brahman sādhakānāṃ hitāya ca | asaṃkhyat vāddhi kāmānāṃ vistāro naiva śakyate || 6.58 vaktuḥ śrotuś ca tattvena divyair varṣaśatair api | sarve sarvasya kāmā hi sammatā eva dehinaḥ || 6.59 nānyaḥ sidhyati kāmena tasmāt kāmo nirarthakaḥ | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena muktvā kāmamanoratham || 6.60 bhagavantam upāsīta sarvaṃ tenaiva sidhyati || 6.61
iti śrīpāñcarātre paramasaṃhitāyāṃ mantrakośo nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ
atha saptamo'dhyāyaḥ brahmā bhagavan vaiṣṇavo yāgas tvayā yo'yaṃ prakīrtitaḥ | dīkṣitasyaiva nānyasya mantraiḥ kartuṃ na saṃbhavet || 7.1 tatra dīkṣāṃ samācakṣva vaiṣṇavānāṃ yathākramam | kasmin deśe bhaved dīkṣā kasya vā puruṣasya vā || 7.2 dīkṣāyāṃ kīdṛśo bheda ācāraś cātra kīdṛśaḥ | etat sarvaṃ samācakṣva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 7.3 paramaḥ nadīsaṅgamatīrtheṣu devatāyataneṣu ca | parvatāgreṣu koṣṭheṣu sthāne vā sumanohare || 7.4 pūrvaṃ parīkṣitāṃ bhūmiṃ yāgasthānaṃ prakalpayet | brāhmaṇasya sitā bhūmiḥ kṣatriyasyāruṇā bhavet || 7.5 pītavarṇā ca vaiśyasya kṛṣṇā śūdrasya kīrtitā | kāmena cāpi bhāgaḥ syād ādyā pāpapraṇāśinī || 7.6 bhūmidacārkaparā.............śatrunibarhiṇī | nimnā prāguttare koṇe dikṣu śeṣāsu connatā || 7.7 vistīrṇā durjanāspṛṣṭā bhūmiḥ syāc chubhakarmaṇi | jñātvaivam ipsitāṃ bhūmiṃ kṛtvāgre śalyaśodhanam || 7.8 prāṇiṃgatāli bhasmāstu[prāṇyaṅga tuṣa bhasmāsthi?] rahitāṃ tā[kā]rayed budhaḥ | ārdrīkṛtya mṛdā bhūyo madhyavediṃ tu kārayet || 7.9 sarvataḥ sasamām eva salilasya vyavasthayā | tasyāḥ sarvāsu dikṣv eva nibaddhāṃ kārayed dhṛ[tvṛ?]tim || 7.10 vedimadhyaṃ praviśyanti yathā nānye bahiḥ sthitāḥ | uparyapi vinā stambhaiḥ kuryād āvaraṇaṃ punaḥ || 7.11 na patanti yathā vedyāṃ sadā sūryasya raśmayaḥ | dvāradeśaṃ kramāt kṛtvā vahnikuṇḍaṃ caturdiśam || 7.12 rasāṃsi vividhair di[rdra?]vyair nānāvarṇāni sādhayet | kalaśān vividhāṃś cāpi pātrāṇi vividhāni ca || 7.13 dīkṣārthinas tu yāvantaḥ saṃbhavanty atra vaiṣṇavāḥ | te sarve samam evā'tra prayateran samāhitāḥ || 7.14 utsāhe cārthadāne ca kāyakleśe ca yo'dhikaḥ | ceṣṭa keta[te ka?]sya dharmeṇa phalaṃ bhūyo bhaviṣyati || 7.15 ācāryo'nugrahāyaiva yadā śiṣyān sa dīkṣayet | tadāpi sarva evaite śuśrūṣeran yathābalam || 7.16 tatraiva kalpite sthāne nicchidre nirupadrave | nagaragrāmayor dūre sarvataḥ parivārite || 7.17 sarvopakaraṇair yuktaiḥ pūjādravyaiś ca saṃyute | vaiṣṇavair abhyanujñātaḥ kuśalai r dīkṣitaiḥ purā || 7.18 ādarśatalasaṅkāśe pītānāṃ svara[vitānāmbara?] bhūṣite | puṣpauṣadhiphalādyaiś ca kalaśair dikṣu śobhite || 7.19 adīkṣitajanāspṛṣṭe sannikṛṣṭa jala[na?]sya ca | ācāryaḥ kārayed dīkṣāṃ vaiṣṇavasya manasvinaḥ || 7.20 dvādaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vā viṣuvaty ayane pi vā | śroṇāyāṃ vā prayuñjīta dīkṣām asya yathāvidhi || 7.21 viṣṇubhakto gṛhasthaś ca dīkṣākarma vicakṣaṇaḥ | paropakāranirataḥ cakraliṅgadharas tathā || 7.22 dīkṣātantram anājīvan kevalaṃ kṛtyavasalaḥ | yo nivṛttaśrutair yukta ācāryaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 7.23 brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyā dīkṣāyogyās trayaḥ smṛtāḥ | jātiśīlaguṇopetāḥ śūdrāś ca striya eva ca || 7.24 jijñāsu[suṃ?]r nāstikaṃ krūram adharmanirataṃ śaṭhaḥ[śaṭham] | anāśritam avidvāṃsaḥ[saṃ] kṛtaghnaṃ na ca dīkṣayet || 7.25 ḍambhārthaṃ vartate yaś ca parīkṣārthaṃ ca durmatiḥ | tasyāpi dīkṣāṃ nācāryaḥ kārayed vaiṣṇavīṃ parām || 7.26 devapūjāvidhijñāne yas sadā buddhimān bhavet | tasya dīkṣāṃ prayuñjīta dharma evaṃ vivardhate || 7.27 śiṣyeṇa kalpitaṃ bhūmim ācāryaḥ svayam ādi[vi?]śet | saṃcintya manasā devaṃ dīkṣitaiś ca samanvitaḥ || 7.28 akṣāralavaṇaṃ bhuktvā pūrvedyus susamāhitāḥ[taḥ] | prātar ācamya tāṃ bhūmiṃ kuryān mānena sammitām || 7.29 dvādaśāratnimātraṃ tu vedimānaṃ vidhīyate | viprāṇāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ ca ṣaḍbhāgonaṃ viśāṃ bhavet || 7.30 strīśūdrayo stribhāgonaṃ sūtranyāsena kalpayet | vede[di?] dvādaśabhāgena madhyato'kṣaṃ prakalpayet || 7.31 nābhes tad eva mānaṃsy ādaraṇāt[rāṇāṃ?] dviguṇaṃ bhavet | nābhipadme vimānaṃ ca vidyāt saṃca[sta?]raṇasya ca || 7.32 madhyataḥ śaṅkam āhatya samavṛttaṃ samasthitam | pramāṇeṣv aṅkitaṃ sūtraṃ pāśitaṃ tatra yojayet || 7.33 varṇakair ālipet tatra sarvakṣetrāṇi saṃyutaḥ | sarvato vṛttarūpāṇi mānair yuktair yathākramam || 7.34 akṣabhūmiṃ tridhā kuryāt tribhir vṛttais samātmakaiḥ | kalpyate kamalaṃ yatra mukhyaṃ dvādaśapatrakam || 7.35 karṇikā madhyame vṛtte dvitīye kesarāṇi ca | tṛtīye tasya ṣā[pa]trāṇi samāni lalitāni ca || 7.36 madhye sthūlāni sarvāṇi kramād agre tanūni ca | patrāntarāṇi sarvatra samarūpāṇi kalpayet || 7.37 nābhikṣetraṃ tathā kuryāt tribhis sūtrais samanvitam | arakṣetraṃ punar bhindyād bhāgair dvādaśabhiḥ samaiḥ || 7.38 arāṇi cāntaraṃ cāpi teṣu kuryād yathākaramam | tulyam evobhayor mānaṃ sarvadikṣu vidhīyate || 7.39 arāntare diśaḥ kuryād vidiśasvaragocaram | mūle śirasi cārāṇi sthūla rūpāṇi kalpayet || 7.40 madhye ca vṛttarūpāṇi mānasyārdhena sarvataḥ | nemikṣetre punaḥ kuryāt dve vṛtte sarvatas same || 7.41 adharottararūpeṇa prathayas tatra sammatāḥ | tāś caturviṃśati jñeyā[ḥ?] sarva dikṣv anupūrvaśaḥ || 7.42 arāgramadhye sarveṣāṃ pradhīnāṃ sandhikalpayet | etāvac cakram ākhyātaṃ samantāt parimaṇḍalam || 7.43 bahir āvaraṇaṃ cāsya nābhimānena kalpayet | dīkṣārthināṃ praveśārthaṃ sarvataḥ parimaṇḍalam || 7.44 tatra sthānāni dikṣv eva dikpālānāṃ prakalpayet | caturaśrāṇi sarvāṇi hastārdhena samaṃtataḥ || 7.45 veder api bahirvṛttaṃ nimnam unnatam eva vā | hastamānena kurvīta digdvārāṇāṃ prasiddhye || 7.46 dvārāṇi caturaśrāṇi diṅmukheṣu prakalpayet | madhyatas sāvakāśāni vistīrṇāni ca pakṣayoḥ || 7.47 dvārāṇi cottarādīni viprādīnām anukramāt | praveśe nirgame vāpi dīkṣāyām avadhārayet || 7.48 bahirvṛttaṃ tu kurvīta pañcabhir maṇḍalair yutam | mahābhūtāni yatra syur ākāśādīni sarvataḥ || 7.49 evaṃ sūtreṇa sumitaḥ kṛtvā cakraṃ samaṃtataḥ | varṇakair ālikhet pañcāt pañcabhiḥ kuśaloguruḥ || 7.50 śuklaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tathā raktaṃ śyāmaṃ pītaṃ ca vā'yasam | padmajaṃ padmavarṇāṃś ca cakramaṇḍalalekhane || 7.51 karṇikām ālikhet pūrvaṃ pītavarṇena sarvataḥ | raktaśūklāpakīrṇāni kesarāṇi samālikhet || 7.52 patrāṇi tu sitenaiva śyāmavarṇaṃ tadantaram | śuklāṃ raktāṃ ca kṛṣṇāṃ ca tridhā nemim athālikhet || 7.53 arāṇi pītavarṇāni tanmadhyaṃ sitamālikhet | nemikṣetre pṛthīnāṃ tu vyatyayena samālikhet || 7.54 śuklakṛṣṇāv ubhau varṇau pītavarṇaṃ tu sandhiṣu | evaṃ cakraṃ likhitvā tu bahirāvaraṇe punaḥ || 7.55 purāṇi lokapālānāṃ nānāvarṇāny athālikhet | bāhye tu maṇḍale kuryāt pañcavarṇānanukramāt || 7.56 kṛṣṇaṃ pītaṃ tathā raktaṃ śyāmaṃ śuklaṃ ca pañcamam | dvārāṇi raktaśuklābhyāṃ lalitāni prayojayet || 7.57 evam ālekhanaṃ kṛtvā cakrasya kamalodbhava | samayaṃ grāhyec chiṣyaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ mahātmanām || 7.58 ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi rajasāṃ pātane vidhim | yena kurvanti rūpeṇa rajobhiś cakramaṇḍalam || 7.59 lekhane yasya varṇasya nirdeśaḥ kathito mayā | tad varṇenaiva rajasā tasya pūraṇam ucyate || 7.60 oṣadhībhiḥ śilābhiś ca patraiḥ kāṣṭhais tathā phalaiḥ | rajāṃsi kārayed vidvān kuśalair abhyupāyataḥ || 7.61 teṣāṃ maṇḍalavinyāsaḥ sarvasthāneṣu kalpitaḥ | nimnonnatakṣayādīni kauśalena samānayet || 7.62 karṇikām ucchritāṃ kuryāt yantrabandhena kenacit | patrāṇi cāntarabhuvaḥ tathaivārāṇimadhyataḥ || 7.63 anyatra samarūpāṇi rajāṃsi vikared budhaḥ | evaṃ rajobhir ālikhya cakramaṇḍalam uttamam || 7.64 dīkṣayed arthinaś śiṣyān ācāryas susamāhitaḥ | varṇakair eva likhitaṃ kuḍyamadhye paṭe'pi vā || 7.65 sthāpayedaiśvaraṃ cakram asamakṣaṃ janasya ca | svayaṃ tu kāle saṃpaśyed anudhyāyan paraṃ prabhum || 7.66 pramāṇaṃ saṃbhavād eva tasya tatra vidhīyate | sthānāni tu samastāni nemyantāni nahāpayet || 7.67 evam uktaṃ mayā sarvaṃ tava cakrasya lekhanam | yasyānudhyānamātreṇa sarvam eno'vaśīryate || 7.68 piśācāḥ pannagā yakṣā grahāḥ pretāś ca rākṣasāḥ | asyāntike na tiṣṭhanti likhitasyāpi veśmani || 7.69 idaṃ cakram upārūḍho vāsudevo jagatprabhuḥ | pūjanīyaḥ prayatnena vaiṣṇavaiḥ siddhim īpsubhiḥ || 7.70
iti śrīpāñcarātre paramasaṃhitāyāṃ cakronāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ
athāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ
paramaḥ ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi dīkṣāyā lakṣaṇaṃ param | yām avāpya viśuddhātmā vaiṣṇavaḥ siddhimi(mṛ?)cchati || 8.1 apratiṣṭhasya manasaḥ śreyomārgam avindataḥ | upāyaṃ bandhanasyāhur dīkṣāṃ dīkṣāviśāradāḥ || 8.2 sā tu bhaktivaśān nṛṇāṃ triṣu karmasu niṣṭhitā | prathamaṃ samaye paścāt tantrajñāne tato'rcane || 8.3 tīvropetāḥ prayoktavyās triṣu karmasu paṇḍitaiḥ | ānupūrvyeṇa dharmasya sarvakālavivṛddhaye || 8.4 śruṇuyāt samayaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtvā samayam agrataḥ | punas tantram upādadyāt dīkṣito granthadīkṣayā || 8.5 punaś ca mantradīkṣāyāṃ dīkṣito devam arcayet | yastu tīvraḥ prayuñjīta dīkṣāṃ bhaktisamanvitaḥ || 8.6 tasya devaprasadena sakalaṃ sidhyatīpsitam | ālikhya varṇakaiś cakraṃ parivārasamanvitam || 8.7 darśayec chiṣyam ācāryaḥ sa syāt samayadīkṣitaḥ | rajobhiś cakram ālikhya paścād varṇair yathāvidhi || 8.8 darśayed vidhinā śiṣyaṃ saṃbhavet tatra dīkṣitaḥ | agnau hutvā'khilān mantrān āvāhya ca paraṃ prabhum || 8.9 maṇḍalaṃ darśayed yas tu sa tu jñeya upāsakaḥ | prathamaṃ śruṇuyāt tantraṃ dvitīyaṃ mantram āmanet || 8.10 tṛtīyaṃ pūjayed devam ity evaṃ trividhaḥ kramaḥ | sāmānyena pravakṣyāmi dīkṣāvidhimataḥ param || 8.11 sarvasiddhikaraṃ brahman śruṇu tvaṃ susamāhitaḥ | diśamagre parijñāya cakram ālikhya śāstrataḥ || 8.12 kalaśān dikṣu sarvāsu vāripūrṇān nidhāpayet | vastra saṃvītakaṇṭhāṃś ca puṣpāṅkuraphalānvitān || 8.13 dvādaśāṣṭau catuṣkaṃ vā vārimantreṇa mantravit | vitānaṃ vyomamantreṇa datvā dīpaṃ ca tejasā || 8.14 cāmaraṃ vayumantreṇa chatraṃ ca kṣitividyayā | vāsudevasya vāri[ru?]ṇyām abhikruddhaṃ[gnikuṇḍaṃ?] vidhāya ca || 8.15 vilāpya ghṛtam utpūya vipulaṃ homasiddhaye | kṣālayitvā ca pātrāṇi saṃhṛtya ca samitkuśam || 8.16 araṇi tvāṃ mathitvāgnim utpādya maṇināpi vā | śraddhānaṃ vinītaṃ ca śiṣyaṃ tantrāṇi vāsa[ca?]yet || 8.17 saṃhāravartmanā caiva saṃhṛtya prāṅmukhaḥ svayam | srṣṭimārgeṇa cotpādya sthāpayen nibhṛtendriyam || 8.18 etat sarvaṃ vidhāyāgre dīkṣācāryaḥ svayaṃ punaḥ | kṛtarakṣaḥ kṛtanyāso bījanyāsaṃ samācaret || 8.19 akṣabījaṃ nyased akṣe nābhibījāni nābhiṣu | patreṣu mūrtayo yojyāḥ kesareṣu tu śaktayaḥ || 8.20 areṣu kālabījāni śaktibījāni bījataḥ | agreṣu mūrtipālānāṃ tattvāni pṛthiṣu kramāt || 8.21 pakṣāṇāṃ ca tithīnāṃ ca bījāni kramaśo nyaset | purāṇāṃ dakṣiṇe pārśve vāmane vihitāni ca || 8.22 nebhije ca tathānyebhyo dikpatīnāṃ ca dhāmasu | bhūtabījāni bāhyeṣu maṇḍaleṣu nipātya ca || 8.23 maṇḍalābhyantare padme devam āvāhayet param | āvāhya pūjayec caiva manasā śāstravartmanā || 8.24 pīṭhasthaṃ paramātmānaṃ saṃcintyārghyaṃ pradāya ca | labdhānujñaḥ parikramya vandamānaḥ pradakṣiṇam || 8.25 agnikārya prasidhyartham agnikuṇḍaṃ samāśrayet | hastamātra pramāṇena samantāt parimaṇḍalam || 8.26 tatrollekhādikaṃ karma cakravākavasānikam | kṛtvotthāya paraṃ devaṃ vidhimārgeṇa pūjayet || 8.27 dhyānenāñjana dānāntaṃ datvā darpaṇam āharet | punar utthāya pātrasthāṃ[sthaṃ?] caror bhāgaṃ tṛtīyakam || 8.28 nivedya bhakṣya bhojyādi saṃgṛhītaṃ nivedayet | puṣpāñjali pradānāntam ātmarakṣāṃ vidhāya ca || 8.29 labdhānujñaḥ paridhyādi homakāryaṃ samācaret | agnimadhye ca padmasthaṃ devam āvāhya tejasā || 8.30 pūjayitvā samiddhomaṃ kṛtvā'dāya sruvaṃ navam | pīṭhamantraiḥ kramād dhutvā dhārayā satataṃ smṛtam || 8.31 pakṣaṃ paramahaṃsena darvyā tu juhuyāt punaḥ | ghṛtāhutisahasraṃ ca tenaiva juhuyād guruḥ || 8.32 śatakṛtvas pīṭhamantraiḥ pañcopaniṣadā tathā | śaktibhir mūrtibhiś cāpi mūrtipālaiś ca śaktibhiḥ || 8.33 daśakṛtvas tu juhuyād akṣamantrādibhir ghṛtam | saṃtapyaivaṃ pariśritya maṇḍale śiṣyam āhvayet || 8.34 triguṇais tribhir ālabdhaṃ nābhihṛnmūrdhasu kramāt | caros tribhāgam ādāya vahneḥ paścimato guruḥ || 8.35 triguṇe ca[na?] samabhyukṣya pradadyāt puruṣātmanā | prāśnīyāt sa ca tatraiva vāgyato vaiṣṇavaṃ haviḥ || 8.36 prāśyācamya yathāyogam ācāryam upasaṃśrayet | sa ca tasmai guṇenaiva pradadyād dantadhāvanam || 8.37 ācāntasya pradoṣetu rakṣāṃ kālena kārayet | karāgre yojayet sūtraṃ triguṇenābhimantritam || 8.38 vāsudevena saṃspṛśya svāpayed darbhasaṃstare | cakṣuṣi rūpamantreṇa saṃspṛśya svapnasiddhaye || 8.39 svapnam ālokayet yuktvā svayam āsīta saṃyataḥ | dīkṣitair bahibhis sārdhaṃ kathayan vaiṣṇavīṃ kathām || 8.40 nidrayā tu vinācāryas tāṃ niśām ativāhayet | aśakto visṛjed devam agnau maṇḍala eva ca || 8.41 prabhāte ca samutthāya susnāto mantravigrahaḥ | kṛtādhivāsinaṃ stya [cakrādhivāsanaṃ tya] ktvā punar utpādya maṇḍalam || 8.42 śiṣyam āhūya saṃskṛtya kṛtvā mantramayaṃ navam | hutvā tu sakalair mantrair ānupūrvyeṇa pūrvavat || 8.43 vastram ekam upādāya śiṣyaṃ badhvā mukhāntare | haste gṛhītvā praviśet svena dvāreṇa maṇḍalam || 8.44 nītvā pradakṣiṇaṃ caiva dikpālān praṇipātayet | tat puṣpaṃ nipatet puṣpe yasminn eva yadṛcchayā || 8.45 sa mantras tasya rakṣāyām udaye ca vidhīyate | utpādya cakṣuṣī cainaṃ darśayec cakramaṇḍalam || 8.46 tattvāni ca vibhāgena kathayed ānupūrvaśaḥ | tattvarūpam idaṃ buddhyā[dhvā]dhyāyasveti vinirdiśet || 8.47 ātmānaṃ parayā bhaktyā sarvasvaṃ ca nivedayet | nivedayec ca ratnāni bhūṣaṇāny ambarāṇi ca || 8.48 dāpayet prītidānam ca grāhayed vaiṣṇavaṃ vratam | abhyanujñāṃ tato dadyāt devapūjana karmaṇi || 8.49 śrāvayed upadeśaṃ ca rahasyaṃ ca kramāgatam | evam eva pareṣāṃ ca sarveṣām upapādayet || 8.50 yadi paśyati duḥsvapnaṃ durnimittam athā'pare | tatra pañcopaniṣadā śataṃ homo vidhīyate || 8.51 vidyānvayatapoyogād ācāryaḥ śiṣyam āśritam | laghunāpi vidhānena dīkṣayed arka[c cakra?]maṇḍale || 8.52 śiṣyam utsārya deveśaṃ maṇḍalāntaṃ visṛjya ca | muktvā ca vahni madhyasthaṃ tatas sarvaṃ viśodhayet || 8.53 yaṃ tu śiṣyaṃ guṇopetam ācāryaṃ kartum icchati | tasyābhiṣekaṃ kurvīta vidhinānena mantravit || 8.54 gandhapuṣpaphalakṣīraśālimāṣayavādibhiḥ | ratnadhātusuvarnaiś ca kumbhaṃ dvādaśa pūrayet || 8.55 tīrthatoyena śuddhena mūrtimantrair yathā kramam | sthāpayed atha tān dikṣu gandhapuṣpair alaṃkṛtān || 8.56 śiṣyaṃ ca prāṅmukhaṃ kṛtvā tantramārgeṇa dīkṣitam | śraddadhānaṃ vinītaṃ ca vidyāvantam alolupam || 8.57 ācāryaḥ prāṅmukho bhūtvā devaṃ pīṭhagataṃ prabhum | manasā pūjayitvā tu kāryam etaṃ nivedayet || 8.58 labdhānujṇaḥ punaḥ kuryād abhiṣekaṃ guruḥ sthitaḥ | sṛṣṭikrameṇa kalaśān mantrair ādāya mūrdhani || 8.59 kṛtvābhiṣekaṃ sarvais tu vidhiṃ [bṛsiṃ?] dadyāt svayaṃ guruḥ | so'pi śuddhāmbaro bhūtvā tasyām āsīta vāgyataḥ || 8.60 dadyāc ca vaiṣṇavaṃ cakraṃ yogapaṭṭakam eva ca | ācāryo vaiṣṇave tantre tvaṃ bhava prāṇināṃ priyaḥ || 8.61 śiṣyās tvām upasarpantu teṣu vartasva śāstrataḥ | nārthalobhena vartedhāḥ nāśayā vā bhayena vā || 8.62 pañcarātraviśeṣeṇa devaṃ ca satataṃ smaret | ity uktas tu samutthāya kṛtvācāryapradakṣiṇam || 8.63 āsane sthāpayitvāsya pādau prakṣālayej jalaiḥ | pādatoyena cātmānaṃ śirasi prokṣya bhaktitaḥ || 8.64 toṣayed dhanadānena śaktibhaktivaśād gurum | hiraṇyaṃ vāhanaṃ bhūmiṃ vastraṃ bhūṣaṇam eva ca || 8.65 yad dadāty eṣa gurave tena tuṣyati devarāṭ | adyāhaṃ tvāṃ prapanno'smi śarīreṇa dhanena ca || 8.66 ity uktvā pādayor asya praṇipātaṃ samācaret | svastisaumya vivardhasva jīvitena dhanena ca || 8.67 ity uktvā taṃ guroś śiṣyaṃ prītiyukto visarjayet | labdhadīkṣaś ca yaḥ śiṣyo vaiṣṇave cakramaṇḍale || 8.68 sa tu prāñjalir ācāryaṃ dhanena paritoṣayet | paritoṣya tu pāṇibhyām upasaṃgṛhya pādayoḥ || 8.69 anujñāṃ devadevasya pūjane prārthayed gurum | so'pi pūjaya devaṃ tvam ity anujñām udāharet || 8.70 labdhānujñaś ca śiṣyo'pi tataḥprabhṛti mantravit | pūjayet paramaṃ devam evaṃ pūjāphalaṃ labhet || 8.71 ācāryeṇā nanujñāto yaḥ pūjāṃ kurute naraḥ | na tasya pūjayā kiṃcid devadevaḥ prasīdati || 8.72 tasmān maṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ devam ācāryadarśitam | dṛṣṭvā'nujñāṃ guroḥ prāpya pūjayet puruṣottamam || 8.73 evaṃ yo vaiṣṇavīṃ dīkṣāṃ kuryāt kārayate'pi vā | tāv ubhau gacchataḥ svargaṃ narakaṃ tu viparyaye || 8.74 yaḥ kuryād vaiṣṇavīṃ dīkṣāṃ dhanalobhena kevalam | nāstikasya prapannasya sa guruḥ pātakī bhavet || 8.75 ajñānād avamanyeta yas tv ācāryam upāsakam | sa tantrapātako jñeyo dīkṣā tasya tu niṣphalā || 8.76 dīkṣāvasāne tat sarvaṃ samṛddhe'mbhasi nikṣipet | anyatra vā śucau deśe nikhanet pathi dūrataḥ || 8.77 prastārya maṇḍalaṃ pūrvaṃ hutvā mantrānyathākramam | havir bhuktvā gṛhītvā ca dantakāṣṭhaṃ prayujya ca || 8.78 cakrādhivāsanaṃ kṛtvā svapnaṃ dṛṣṭvā pare'hani | upavāsaparo bhūtvā punaḥ paratare'hani || 8.79 likhitvā maṇḍalaṃ sarvaṃ japahomasamanvitam | praviśyāstamite sūrye sarvam evaṃ visṛjya ca || 8.80 prabhāte'vabhṛthaṃ gacched yatra tīrthaḥ[rthaṃ?] paraṃ bhavet | bhaktiyuktān viśeṣeṇa brāhmaṇān svasti vācayet || 8.81 iti karma krameṇoktaṃ dīkṣāyāṃ kamalāsana | anugrahāya bhaktānāṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ kathayāmi te || 8.82
iti śrīpāñcarātre paramasaṃhitāyāṃ dīkṣānāma aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ
atha navamo'dhyāyaḥ
śubhānām aśubhānāṃ ca nimittānāṃ janārdana | sādhakasya kathaṃ jñeyaṃ jñāyate taṃ bravīhi me || 9.1 paramaḥ dantakāṣṭhanipātena svapna saṃdarśanena ca | agnirūpais tu jāniyāt sādhakasya śubhāśubham || 9.2 nyagrodhodumbarośvatthān plakṣān darbhāṃś ca vaiṣṇavān | ātmākaram apābhargam ajjanaṃ dhātakīṃ śamīm || 9.3 anyāni ca pavitrāṇi kārayed dantadhāvanam | dvādaśāṅgulamātraṃ tad avakraṃ grandhivarjitam || 9.4 mūlato bhakṣayed vidvānadbhiḥ prakṣālya vāgyataḥ | uttarāṃ diśam aindrīṃ ca pratīcīṃ dakṣiṇāṃ tathā || 9.5 paśyantaḥ kramaśodvarṇāḥ khādeyur dantadhāvanam | śodhayitvā krameṇaiva tena dantān uparyadhaḥ || 9.6 bhañjanaṃ madhyataḥ kṛtvā jalaiḥ prakṣālya tat punaḥ | bahir eva kṣiped vidvān patanaṃ tasya lakṣayet || 9.7 pūrvāgre tu bhaved vṛddhir āgneyāgre tapo balam | dakṣiṇāgre bhaven mṛtyur nairṛtyāgre dhanakṣayaḥ || 9.8 vāruṇyāgre parāśāntir vāyavyāgre rujāgamaḥ | uttarāgre dhanāvāptir aiśānyagre paraṃ sukham || 9.9 ūrdhvāgre tu sthite tasmin mahatī vṛddhir iṣyate | ity etāni nimittāni jānīyād dantadhāvane || 9.10 dīkṣākāle viśeṣeṇa prārambheṣu mahatsu ca | yadāvāmanyate jñātum ātmanaś ca śubhāśubham || 9.11 tadā kṛtopavāsas tu yathāvad upalakṣayet | svapnenāpi pravakṣyāmi sādhakasya śubhāśubham || 9.12 svapnaṃ dṛṣṭvā yathārūpaṃ gurave tu nivedayet | svapnaṃ tu prathame yāme kuryāt saṃvatsarāt phalam || 9.13 aṣṭamāsāt dvitīye tu tṛtīye tribhir eva ca | māsenaiva bhaved antye prabhāte tvarayā phalam || 9.14 raśmim antaṃ vivasvantaṃ śaśāṅkaṃ tārakāvṛtam | pradīptam agnihotraṃ ca pradīptaṃ vāpi bhāsvaram || 9.15 mātaraṃ pitaraṃ dārān putrān bhrātṛn suhṛjjanān | apakvaṃ mānuṣaṃ māṃsaṃ pādādipratibhakṣaṇam || 9.16 kṣīrasomasurāraktaśarkarādadhisarpiṣā[ṣī] | sāgarasya ca nadyāś ca pānaṃ pāyasabhakṣaṇam || 9.17 naranāgādi saudhānāṃ śibikāphalavṛkṣayoḥ | śakaṭāsanaśayyāyāṃ sukhenevādhirohaṇam || 9.18 samudrasaridādīnāṃ taraṇaṃ ca mahāmbhasām | devadvijaguruprājñasādhubhiś ca samāgamam || 9.19 śaṅkhacakradhvajādīni gandharvanagaraṃ vṛṣam | chatram indradhvajaṃ varṣam ādarśaṃ ratnam eva ca || 9.20 cāmaraṃ tālavṛntaṃ ca kumbhaṃ rudhiram āmiṣam | piṣṭānulepanaṃ gātre puṇyaśabdaśrutāni ca || 9.21 agamyāgamanaṃ sarpa vṛścikādyaiś ca daṃśanam | bandhanaṃ sarvagātreṣu bandhubhir dharṣaṇaṃ tathā || 9.22 svapnān evaṃ vidhān dṛṣṭvā vividhān aparān api | acirād eva jānīyāc chubhāṃ vṛddhim upasthitām || 9.23 svapne tu nagnamātmanāṃ vastrahīnaṃ viceṣṭitam | bhagnayān ādhirūḍhaṃ ca bhagnachatradhvajāyudham || 9.24 caṇḍālarajakaś citrīdrutakamlecchacāraṇān | paśyet pāṣaṇḍino yaś ca na śubhaṃ tasya jāyate || 9.25 kharoṣṭramahiṣavyāghravalmīkārohaṇaṃ tathā | tailābhyaktas tathāruhya dakṣiṇāgamanaṃ tathā || 9.26 rūpakāñcanalābhaṃ pānaṃ ca madhutailayoḥ | nartanaṃ paṅkadigdhasya vivāhakaraṇaṃ tathā || 9.27 srotasā haraṇaṃ śīghraṃ pakvamāṃsasya bhakṣaṇam | dantānāṃ patanaṃ caiva śiromuṇḍanam eva ca || 9.28 salilonmajjanaṃ duḥkhaṃ śuṣkavṛkṣādhirohaṇam | svapnāt apam amaṅgalyān dṛṣṭvānyānapi tādṛśān || 9.29 na naraḥ śubham āpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā | yas tu madhye tadā tasya bhakṣayet ghṛtapāyasam || 9.30 parvatasthaś ca yo bhūtvā vṛkṣaṃ samadhirohati | prāsādāvasthito yaś ca samudraṃ tarati svayam || 9.31 sa tu rājyam avāpnoti bhakṣayan bhūmim eva ca | devabrāhmaṇagāvaś ca liṅginaḥ pitaro nṛpāḥ || 9.32 yad vadanti naraṃ svapne tathaiva ca bhaviṣyati | dīkṣāyāṃ sthāpane cāpi puruṣeṣu mahatsu ca || 9.33 vikāreṣu ca yatnena svapnaṃ samupalakṣayet | agnikārye ca yady agnir vinā yatnena dīpyate || 9.34 śikhābhir ujvalantībhir vartate vā pradakṣiṇam | hṛdyaṃ vā visṛjed gandhaṃ rūpaṃ vā sumanoharam || 9.35 sampadas tasya vardhante sādhakasya na saṃśayaḥ | yadi homārthamānīto naśyed vahnir akāraṇāt || 9.36 vipadas tasya jāyante sādhakasya na saṃśayaḥ | visṛjed viṣṇuliṅgaṃ vā durgandhaṃ vā hutāśa[naḥ]nam || 9.37 yadi vā na pradīpyeta prasavyaṃ vā na tac chubham | maṇḍale likhyamāne ca yadi varṣaṃ mahad bhavet || 9.38 dāruṇo vā mahān vāyuḥ pariveṣo raves tathā | maraṇaṃ bāndhavānāṃ vā devatānāṃ tathā'priyam || 9.39 sādhakasya na tatrāsti śubhaṃ kiṃcit pitāmaha | yadi vānyanimittāni śubhāni ca mahānti ca || 9.40 prasannaś ca śivaḥ kālo vardhante tasya sampadaḥ | svayam evopatiṣṭheta durlabhaṃ yadi sādhanam || 9.41 devatāyāḥ prasādo vā tan nimittaṃ mahattaram | prāptānāṃ sādhanānāṃ ca jāyante pyāpado yadi || 9.42 kṣobho devakṛtovāpi durnimittaṃ tad iṣyate | evam etair nimittais tu sādhakaḥ siddhim īpsitam || 9.43 ātmanaḥ pratibudhyeta śubhaṃ vā yadi vā'śubham || 9.44
iti śrīpāñcarātre paramasaṃhitāyāṃ nimittajñānonāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
atha daśamo'dhyāyaḥ
yogamārgaṃ samācakṣva vistereṇa janārdana | yogāṅgāni ca sarvāṇi tatra me paramā spṛhā || 10.1 paramaḥ jñānānāṃ khalu sarveṣāṃ yoga jñānaṃ viśiṣyate | yogajñānād dhikaivalyaṃ prāpnoti paramaṃ sukham || 10.2 kevalaṃ tu kṛtaṃ karma yogajñānād vinā nṛbhiḥ | na kuryād vipulāṃ siddhiṃ tasmād yogaṃ samāśrayet || 10.3 sa tu jñāna kriyābhedād dvividhaḥ śāstracoditaḥ | karmanāṃ saṃvibhāgāc ca vairūpyān manasas tathā || 10.4 jñānayogo bhavaty ekaḥ karmayogaḥ paraḥ smṛtaḥ | yat karoti samādhānaṃ cittasya viṣaye kvacit || 10.5 anākulam asaṃkṣobhaṃ sa yoga iti kīrtyate | yadi karmāṇi badhnāti cittam askhalitaṃ naraḥ || 10.6 karmayogo bhavety eṣaḥ sarvapāpa praṇāśanaḥ | yadi tu jñāna evārthe cittaṃ badhnāti nirvyathaḥ || 10.7 jñānayogaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ sarvasiddhikaraḥ śubhaḥ | ubhayor yogayor yasya na cittaṃ vindati vyathām || 10.8 sa tat padam avāpnoti yad viṣṇoḥ prathitaṃ padam | ubhayasyāpi yogasya deva eva nibandhanaḥ || 10.9 jñānena karmaṇā cāpi tac ca kāryam upāsanam | yamaś ca niyamaś caiva karmayogasya niścitam || 10.10 vairāgyaṃ ca samādhiś ca jñānayogasya ucyate | vāgindriyam anukrośād akṛtyakaraṇāt karam || 10.11 agamyāgamanāt pādaṃ nartanollaṅkhanād api | nindyanārīsamāyogāj jaghanendriyam ātmanaḥ || 10.12 icchāmātreṇa coccārād duḥśīlaṃ guhyam indriyam | saṅkalpanād anarthānāṃ manaś ca parirakṣati || 10.13 yad ayaṃ dhārmiko yogaḥ sa yamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ | vratopavāsadānādau yad etāni niyacchati || 10.14 niyamas tena saṃjñeyaḥ karmayogasya sādhanaḥ | karmayogena yatkarma kṛtvā'nte karma tatpunaḥ || 10.15
ardhyapādyādivad deyaṃ pādayoḥ paramātmanaḥ | kriyamāṇāni karmāṇi phalārtham api yogavit || 10.16 śuśrūṣām eva devasya cintayed atiśaṅkitaḥ | jñānayuktaṃ ca yatkarma jñānaśūnyaṃ ca yad bhavet || 10.17 ubhayor antaraṃ dūrād iti tantrasya nirṇayaḥ | madhureṣv api śabdeṣu śrotrendriyam apekṣate[kṣitam?] || 10.18 darśanīyeṣu rūpeṣu tathaiva nayanendriyam | cañcalaṃ[tvakcalaṃ?] mṛdusaṃsparśe śubhadaṃ tava [śubhagandheca?] nāsikām || 10.19 jihvā māhārasaṅge ca [saṃkoce] lokatantre manas tathā | yaj jñānena nigṛhṇati vairāgyam iti tad viduḥ || 10.20 sthitir avya bhicāreṇa jñātavyaṃ paramātmani | samādhir iti vijñeyo jñānaṃ yogāṅgam uttamam || 10.21 vairāgyeṇendriyāṇy ādau nigṛhya dṛḍhamānasaḥ | samaṃ dadhīta deveśe cittam ekāntaniścayaḥ || 10.22 paśyann iva samāsannaṃ praṇipatya spṛśann iva | vacaḥ śṛṇvanti vastasta[nniva stha?]sya cintayed aviśaṅkitaḥ || 10.23 yogaṃ samabhyaset tena devadevaḥ prasīdati || 10.24 brahmā saṃsāra vāsanāviṣṭaṃ cittaṃ cirataraṃ nṛṇām | kṣaṇena jñānayogena niroddhuṃ śakyate katham || 10.25 nirmale'pi kṛte citte jñānayogasamādhinām | tasyāvasāne taṃ bhūyaḥ svabhāvaṃ nātivartate || 10.26 vaśīkṛtam ivā[mapā?]viddhaṃ manyate cittam ekadā | tatpunaḥ kāraṇe prāpte maryādām ativartate || 10.27 paramaḥ evam etad yathārtha[ttha?]tvaṃ duṣkaraṃ cittabandhanam | abhyāsena tu dīrgheṇa vairāgyam upapādayet || 10.28 tato'sya vāsanāḥ kiṃcid viśīryante samaṃtataḥ | vāsanāsu kṣarantīṣu samādhiṃ dṛḍham ācaret || 10.29 samādher api sāmarthyāt saṅgasyaca visarjanāt | prāsādam etya vaikuṇṭhaṃ svakṛtaṃ karma rakṣati || 10.30 upakramair bahutaraiś cittavṛttiṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ | ānayed vaśam ekānte tvarayā na kadācana || 10.31 yaḥ punas tvarayā cittaṃ svavaśe kartum icchati | anarthās taṃ prasarpanti vyādhayo vā pṛthagvidhāḥ || 10.32 vipraduṣṭaṃ yathānaṅgaṃ mṛdupūrvair anukramaiḥ | sucireṇa vaśaṃ kuryāt tathā cittaṃ mahāmanāḥ || 10.33 vivikte nirjane deśe nirābādhe manorame | āharaiś ca vihāraiś ca parikleśavivarjite || 10.34 śītenoṣṇena vātena himenāpi na nirvyathe | puṇyakṣetre jalāḍhye ca sattvam āsthāya niścalam || 10.35 yogavidyāṃ samabhyasya dhārayitvā vivicyati | śarīrān upaghātena kāle samāhitaḥ || 10.36 janmasthiti vināśādīn ātmīyān eva cintayet | tathācintayatas tasya devaṃ śaraṇam icchataḥ || 10.37 yogagatyabhiyogeṣu śraddhā bhaktiś ca jāyate | tatra svam eva śikṣet tu cittam avyagramānasaḥ || 10.38 yatrāsya vāsanā tīvrā viṣayaṃ tac ca lakṣayet | kṛtvā vivekaṃ tatraiva rāgabījaṃ nivartayet || 10.39 yogābhyāsasya tadvidvān anarthasthānam ātmanaḥ | avaśyaṃ tatra sakto'pi pratibudhyeti niścalam || 10.40 pratibadhya[ddha?]matiḥ śūnyaṃ sthānaṃ yatnena saṃśrayet | asaṃbhavād asaṃyogād udvegād doṣadarśanāt || 10.41 vayasaḥ pariṇāmāc ca vairāgyaṃ viṣaye bhavet || 10.42 brahmā ebhis taṃ kāraṇair nṛṇām upabhogo nivartate | rāgas tu manasaḥ puṃsaḥ katham evaṃ nivartate || 10.43 idaṃ me syād idaṃ me syād ity asya hṛdi tiṣṭhati | saṅkalpasthiramūlaś ca tasyocchedaḥ kathaṃ bhavet || 10.44 viṣayeṣūpabhukteṣu rāgo jñānān nivartate | abhukteṣu ca ya[yaḥ?]t snehaḥ sa kathaṃ vinivāryate || 10.45 paramaḥ bhoktavyā viṣayāḥ pūrvaṃ dharmasyāpy avirodhinaḥ | alabhyam api jānīyāt darśanaśravaṇādibhiḥ || 10.46 tasya svarūpaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca pramādaṃ bhayam eva ca | hṛdaye vāsayen nityaṃ svayam eva samāhitaḥ || 10.47 yoginaḥ sabahūn paśyet tadartheṣv eva viplutān | mā bhūvam aham ity evam iti yatnena dhārayet || 10.48 suciraṃ yogam abhyasya tattvajñānasamādhinā | alpena kāmabījena magnāṃs tamasi lakṣayet || 10.49 evaṃ vāsayatas tasya kṛtabuddher vijānataḥ | yogamārge bhavaty eva pratyayaḥ paramārthataḥ || 10.50 bhuktān bhogān ivābhuktān paśyato'pi dine dine | śraddhā bhaktī vivardhete devapādārcanāṃ prati || 10.51 tato dhyānamayenaiva yajñena niyatendriyaḥ | yathotsāham upāsīta devadevam atandritaḥ || 10.52 dravyair
