manoharair evaṃ puṇyakṣetram upāgataḥ | arcayet paramaṃ devaṃ pratyakṣam iva buddhavat || 10.53 tatprasādāt kṛtaṃ karma nāsya kiṃcid vinaśyati | na cainam upasarpanti vighātā daivamānuṣāḥ || 10.54 yogārūḍho'pi puruṣaḥ svacittaṃ svavaśe sthitam | anyad īyam iti jñātvā na manyeta vaśīkṛtam || 10.55 prākṛtānāṃ na vairāgyam ātmīyaṃ saṃprakāśayet | yadi śaknomi[ti?] vairāgyaṃ devasyaiva prakāśayet || 10.56 alamabhyasya vairāgyaṃ kṛtabuddhir atandritaḥ | samādhinā paraṃ devaṃ satataṃ hṛdi dhārayet || 10.57 yathā ratne hiraṇye vā nivāso'sya mano bhavet | ciram avyabhicāreṇa tathā deva[vaṃ?] niveśayet || 10.58 śikṣayitvā tathā cittaṃ yogavartmany avasthitaḥ | deva deva prasādena tam eva pratipadyate || 10.59 brahmā yaś ca karmamayo yogo yaś ca jñānamayaḥ pṛthak | kasya ko'tiviśeṣeṇa puruṣasya praśasyate || 10.60 paramaḥ narasyākṛtabuddhes tu ghaṭamānasya satpathe | karmayogā[gaḥ pra]t prayoktavyā[vyaḥ] tasya jñānaṃ hi durlabham || 10.61 yas tu vidyā vinītaḥ syāt kṛtabuddhiś ca mānavaḥ | jñānayoga[ḥ?] paraṃ tasya sahikarmaṇi sīdati || 10.62 ubhayenābhiyogena yasya saṃpadyate matiḥ | acireṇaiva kālena tasya viṣṇuḥ prasīdati || 10.63 nātaḥparam ataṃ[taḥ?] kiṃcin narāṇāṃ pāpanāśanam | viṣṇoḥ priyatamaṃ vāpi yad yoge ramate manaḥ || 10.64 phalanti yome.......karmaṇy api pitāmaha || 10.65 nopadravāś ca bādhyante nāndhakāraṃ ca gacchati | śreyasā parameṇaiva yad yojayati mānasaḥ || 10.66 eṣa yogaḥ samāsena kīrtitas te pitāmaha || 10.67 yogābhyāsena jānīyād ānīyād ātmīyāṃ prakṛtiṃ naraḥ | indriyāṇāṃ svabhāvaṃ ca cittasya ca guṇāguṇān || 10.68 ariṣṭānāṃ ca saṃprāptiṃ nimittaṃ śakunādiṣu | devatānāṃ svabhāvaṃ ca karmaṇāṃ gatim eva ca || 10.69 na kāryaṃ karśayed yogī nava [ā] yatnena poṣayet | na duḥkhe'pi smayaṃ kuryān na sukhe mānamūrjitam || 10.70 ekānte sthiram āsīta vinītāṅko yathā sukham | staṃbhādikam upāśritya bandhanena niyamya ca || 10.71 adhyāyāṃś ca [ātmānaṃ ci]ntayet tatra kāryaṃ ca karaṇāni ca | devasya ca parāṃ pūjāṃ vairāgyeṇa parān guṇān || 10.72 lokacintāprasuptaṃ ca mano nityaṃ prasādayet | vāsānāś ca cirārūḍhā yatnād asya nivartayet || 10.73 abhiyuñjīta yatnena prāṇāyāmān yathābalam | teṣām evābhiyogena yogo'sya bhavati dhruvam || 10.74 yena kālena vahati prāṇaḥ koṣṭhe śarīriṇām | tasmin kāle nirodhasya prāṇāyāma iti smṛtaḥ || 10.75 nirodhas tu tridhā tasya yogibhiḥ parikīrtyate | staṃbhanāt yasya nicchidraṃ pūraṇād recanāt tathā || 10.76 tribhir etair upāyais tu prāṇasyāyāmam ācaret | abhyāsād asya saṃrūḍhā mātrā bhavati bhūyasī || 10.77 prāṇāyāmā vivardhante mātrābhiś cāpi yoginaḥ | yo[yā?] vivṛddhir bhavet tasya pāpānāṃ ca parīkṣayaḥ || 10.78 cittavṛttiṃ vaśekṛtvā prāṇāyāmakṛtodyamaḥ | bhaktimān param āpnoti vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma śāśvatam || 10.79
iti śrīpāñcarātre paramasaṃhitāyāṃ yogo nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ
athaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ
brahmā ariṣṭam iṣṭakṛt proktaṃ tvayā me puruṣottama | jñātavyā yasya saṃprāptir yogābhyāsena yogibhiḥ || 11.1 kathaṃ vā jñāyate'riṣṭaṃ kena kālena vā punaḥ | etad ācakṣva me deva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 11.2 paramaḥ ariṣṭam iti vijñeyam aparaṃ tasya lakṣaṇam | ātmasthaṃ vā parasthaṃ vā sapakṣeṇa pitāmaha || 11.3 prāṇo'pānas tathodānaḥ samāno vyāna eva ca | evaṃ pañcavidho vāyuḥ śarīre dehinaḥ smṛtaḥ || 11.4 prasvā[procchvā] [praśvā] so'tha manojṛmbhaḥ kāsa[śa] hikkā kṣutāni ca | nityam ardhva pravṛttasya prāṇavāyor viceṣṭikam || 11.5 niśvāsaṃ ca nigāraṃ ca śakṛnmūtra visarjanam | adhogater apānasya ceṣṭitaṃ guhyakarma ca || 11.6 vyānas tu sarva gātrastho yatyāha* jvara smaḥ | balabṛhmaṇaceṣṭānām udānaḥ kāraṇaṃ bhavet || 11.7 * atra skhalitā paṃktiḥ samāno jāṭharaṃ vahnim uddīpayati sarvadā | eteṣām eva vāyūnām avasthānaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ || 11.8 sphuraṇāni pradeśeṣu lakṣyante dhvanayas tathā | gulphakūrparaguhyeṣu vāmapārśve ca sandhiṣu || 11.9 kaṇṭhe ca śravaṇānte ca śaṅkhe mūrdhni ca sthitam | anyeṣu ca pradeśeṣu sphuraṇāny upalakṣayet || 11.10 kaṇṭhasyābhyantare ghoṣe jaṭharecāṅgasandhiṣu | jṛmbhaṇāni ca sarvatra yathāvad upalakṣayet || 11.11 evam ādyā vikārās tu vāyūnāṃ dehagocarāḥ | prasannā jīvitaṃ dadyur aprasannās tanukṣayam || 11.12 nāsikāpuṭayoḥ prāṇaḥ paryāyeṇa pravartate | saṃkrāmakālaṃ jānīyāt tasya santatacāriṇaḥ || 11.13 uttaraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ vidyād dakṣiṇaṃ cottarāyaṇam | madhyamārge tu jānīyād viṣukālaṃ yathā kramam || 11.14 tasya saṃkrāntayo māsāste tu dvādaśa vatsaram | ṣaṇmāsaṃ cāyanaṃ vidyāt sūkṣmajñānena yogavit || 11.15 pañca prabhṛti vardhante pañca pañca yathā kramam | ahorātrāṇi yāvanti jāyante pañcaviṃśatiḥ || 11.16 ekaikena dinenaiva tataḥ prabhṛti vardhanam | trayastriṃśad bhaved yāvad ahorātrāṇy anukramāt || 11.17 ravimāsād viniḥsṛtya yadi saṃkrāntivardhitam | prāṇā bhavanti martyasya tasyātha śruṇu jīvitam || 11.18 trīṇi dvevaikam evābdaṃ māsāḥ saṃcakratus tathā | dvau caikaś cārdhamāsaś ca................ || 11.19 trīṇi dve punar ekaṃ ahorātrāṇy anukramāt | evam eva vijānīyāj jīvitasya na saṃśayaḥ || 11.20 saṃkrāntikālam ātmīyam ādāv evopalakṣayet | tasya vṛddhiṃ vijānīyād ariṣṭaṃ samupasthitam || 11.21 nāḍikāmāsavarṣād yair vṛddhim asya tu lakṣayet | phalāni gaṇayet teṣāṃ vipulāny uttarottaram || 11.22 ariṣṭasyāpi gaṇayet kālaṃ pṛthag upasthitam | pṛthag evobhayaṃ jñeyaṃ naimittikanimittavat || 11.23 ekānte cintayen nityaṃ sūryamāse naro budhaḥ | nāḍīmāsadīnāny eṣu yeṣv ariṣṭasya saṅgatiḥ || 11.24 nātaḥ sūkṣmataraṃ kiṃcid āyur jñānaṃ pitāmaha | hrāsavṛddhir yadālocya koṣṭhavāyor vivicyate || 11.25 anyeṣām api vāyūnāṃ ceṣṭitaṃ yadi naśyati | tenāpi vidyād āsannam aparāntaṃ naro budhaḥ || 11.26 hānirindriyaśaktīnāṃ chāyāyāḥ parivartanam | dṛṣṭimāndyaṃ viśeṣeṇa yasya puṃsaḥ pravartate || 11.27 pādāṅguṣṭhe karāṅguṣṭhe sphuraṇaṃ tu vinaśyati | ṣaṇmāsād adhikaṃ tasya jīvitenaiva śiṣyate || 11.28 yadi tu sphuraṇaṃ naśyed adhastāt kūrparopari | trimāsābhyantare mṛtyuḥ puṃsas tasya bhaviṣyati || 11.29 meḍhre pārśve ca kakṣe ca naśyanti[ti] sphuraṇaṃ yadi | ekamāsena tasyāpi jīvitakṣayam ṛcchati || 11.30 ardhamāse svakādṛṣṭiḥ svedabandhaṃ na paśyati | jaṭharāntargato doṣo daśāhena vinaśyati || 11.31 khadyotasadṛśajyotir netrayoḥ pañcabhir dine | na paśyed yadi jihvāgraṃ triyahaṃ tasya jīvitam || 11.32 pālāgrāṇi[jvāgrāṇi][nāsāgrāṇi] na paśyed yo hemaraṇamacidiccasaḥ[dvyahe maraṇam ṛcchati] | karṇaghoṣaś ca vāk[vācaś ca] pramādo mati vibhramaḥ || 11.33 yasyaite tu vinaśyanti tasyaikāhaṃ tu jīvitam | evam ādīni cānyāni nimittāni pitāmaha || 11.34 āmanyeta naro vidvān mṛtyukālasya lakṣayet[ṇam] | aparānte'pi cāsanne vaiṣṇavo nirbhayo bhavet || 11.35 nā tilobhaṃ ca manyeta [saṃprāpyā?] py āpadāśrayam | svabhāvāt parivardhante kāryāṇi karaṇāni ca || 11.36 varṣebhyo dvādaśebhyor vāk narāṇāṃ jīvite sati | tasya sūkṣmaṃ parijñātuṃ śakyate yogibhir nṛbhiḥ || 11.37 prāptam ālakṣya kaivalyam indriyodyamadhātuṣu | ye bhavanty akṛtajñānā vaiṣṇavāḥ sādhu saṃyutāḥ || 11.38 ariṣṭaṃ vihitaṃ teṣāṃ viśeṣeṇa parāśritam | navoditasya candrasya yo na paśyati maṇḍalam || 11.39 kṣīṇasya vā bahiḥ sūkṣmaṃ rekhām ayam avasthitam | tathaivārundhatīṃ devīṃ dhruvam ākāśanimnagāḥ || 11.40 saṃvatsarānvayenārvāk tasya mṛtyur bhaviṣyati | apradīptau śaśāṅkārkāvagniṃ vā dīptivarjitam || 11.41 paśyann ekādaśe māsi yamalokaṃ prapadyate | yakṣarakṣaḥ piśācānāṃ vimānaṃ nagarāṇi ca || 11.42 yaḥ paśyati grīṣmakāle daśa māsān sa jīvati | jāmbūn adamayān vṛkṣān parvataṃ vā tathāvidham || 11.43 yaḥ paśyati naraḥ svaḥstho navamāsān sa jīvati | charditaṃ kāñcanaṃ rūpyaṃ ratnāni vividhāni vā || 11.44 raktamūrdhānamavāk paśyann aṣṭamāsān sa jīvati | pāṃsu bhasmasu paṅke vā pādanyāse kṛte sati || 11.45 khaṇḍitaṃ lakṣyate yasya sapta māsān sa jīvati | raktaḥ kapoto kāko vā sahasā chāyayā vinā || 11.46 yasya rohati gātreṣu kṛtavāso'pi vā kacit | pāṃsu varṣaṃ bhavet pṛṣṭhe kāraṇena vinā yadi || 11.47 ṣaṇmāsaṃ jīvitaṃ tasya nādhikaḥ kamalodbhava | chāyāpuruṣam ālokya śirasā hīnam ambare || 11.48 kabandhākṛtim anyaṃ vā pratyakṣaṃ puruṣaṃ sthitam | kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ mahāghoraṃ pañcamāsān sa jīvati || 11.49 kṛṣṇavarṇā gatā nārī bhinded yasya yadā śiraḥ | mūrchāyāṃ supta [pti] kāle vā cāturmāsyaṃ sa jīvati || 11.50 nīlavarṇaṃ mahāghoraṃ paraṃ paśyati rākṣasam | piśācaṃ vā tathārūpaṃ trīn māsān sa tu jīvati || 11.51 aniyukte śmaśāne yaṃ sandhyākāle niśācaret[rān?] | paśyati svayam evaiko dvau māsau tasya jīvitam || 11.52 bastagandhi bhaven mūtraṃ yasya rogair vinā kvacit | śarīram eva vā sarvaṃ paśyed vā brahmarākṣasam || 11.53 saṃpretān vā vidhā paśyen nidhanāni mahānti ca | svapne salī[li?]la magnasya duḥkhaṃ vā dāruṇaṃ bhavet || 11.54 hetunā vividhāvyaktaṃ brūyān maraṇam ātmanaḥ | apriyān api paśyan vā bandhūn api hitaiṣiṇaḥ || 11.55 ekamāsāv adher arvāk tasya naśyati jīvitam | candrādityau tu yaḥ paśyed rudhireṇokṣitāv iva || 11.56 vyoma vā rudhirābhyaktaṃ varṣam ekaṃ sa jīvati | darpaṇe salile vāpi pratibandhaṃ[bimbaṃ] puraḥsthitam || 11.57 yaḥ paśyed vikṛtākāram aṅgahīnam athāpi vā | dīpasya cāpraśāntasya vartidaṇḍaṃ na jighrati || 11.58 dvādaśāhena tasyāpi mṛtyakālo bhaviṣyati | oṣṭhaḥ pracyavate sthānāt vakrā bhavati nāsikā || 11.59 karṇaś ca calati sthānāt ṣaḍrātraṃ tasya jīvitam yasya kṛṣṇā bhavej jihvā mukhaṃ vā kamalaujasam || 11.60 āhāre yasya vidveṣo jīvitāśāya bhūyasī | daṇḍena saṃśrīkau[gaṇḍautu niśrīkau] raktau trirātreṇa sa naśyati || 11.61 āpāṇḍu nīlapakṣītu yasya rohati mūrdhani | pratyakṣaṃ darśane yasya dvirātraṃ tasya jīvitam || 11.62 acirād dṛśyate yatra[sya] darpaṇe salile'pivā | ahorātreṇa tasyāpi mṛtyur bhavati niścayāt || 11.63 ariṣṭakālam āsannam upalakṣya naro budhaḥ | samāhitamanā bhūtvā satvastho'pi gatajvaraḥ || 11.64 vairāgyaṃ paramāsthāya viṣād abhayavarjitaḥ | saṃtyajya sarvakarmāṇi mānasaṃ yogam ācaret || 11.65 puṇyasthānam anuprāpya śāntātmā vijitendriyaḥ | sarvātmanā paraṃ devam abhyarcya śaraṇaṃ vrajet || 11.66 vaiṣṇavān yoga niṣṭhāṃś ca pūjayitvā vicārya ca | yogamārgaṃ samātiṣṭhed apramattaḥ samāhitaḥ || 12.67
iti śrīpāñcarātre paramasaṃhitāyāṃ ariṣṭonāma ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ
atha dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ
brahmā ko dharmo viṣṇubhaktānāṃ devadeva praśasyate | prāyaścittāni vā kāni dharmā naimittikās tathā || 12.1 muktikāmasya ke dharmā bhūtikāmasya ke matāḥ | etat sarvaṃ samācakṣva tatra me saṃśayo mahān || 12.2 paramaḥ kṛtena karmaṇā yena bhagavān bhuvaneśvaraḥ | prasīdati hitaṃ kartuṃ sa dharmo nātra saṃśayaḥ || 12.3 sa punas trivadhaḥ proktāḥ pūrvam eva mayā tava | manovākkarmasaṃbandhāt tatra vakṣyāmi mānasam || 12.4 śraddhā smṛ[dhṛ]tiḥ prasādaś ca trayas sarvās tu mānasāḥ | eṣām eva vibhāgās tu sarve'nye mānasāḥ smṛtāḥ || 12.5 śraddhāvān labhate jñānaṃ śraddhāvān sādhusammataḥ | śraddhāvān api yuktaś ca śraddhāvān devasammataḥ || 12.6 dhṛtyā na cyavate dharmāt dhṛtyā duḥkhair na ba[bā]dhyate | dhṛtyā sukhair na muhyeta dhṛtyā nodvegam ṛcchati || 12.7 prasanno bādhate nānyaṃ prasanno nābhyasūyati | prasanno nārthalubdhaś ca prasannas satataṃ sukhī || 12.8 yatra ete guṇā yasya svabhāvād yatnato'pi vā | nityaṃ manasi tiṣṭhanti devas tasya prasīdati || 12.9 guṇavadbhis tu saṃyogo guṇānāṃ kāraṇaṃ bhavet | śravaṇaṃ vā guṇeṣv eṣu viśratānāṃ mahātmanām || 12.10 eteṣāṃ viparītā ye tān adharmān pracakṣate | teṣu prasaktā duḥkhāni labhante sarvajanmasu || 12.11 tasmāt sarvaprayatnena siddhikāmas tu vaiṣṇavaḥ | vinayaṃ manasaḥ kuryāt tribhir ebhir guṇais sadā || 12.12 vaśīkṛte tu manasi sarvam eva vaśīkṛtam | bhaviṣyati naras tasmāt sādhayet prathamaṃ manaḥ || 12.13 satpathe manasi nyaste vāṇī tiṣṭhati satpathe | saṅkalpitaṃ hi manasā prakāśayati vāk punaḥ || 12.14 satyaṃ priyaṃ hitaṃ ceti vāgdharmaḥ strividho bhavet | triṣv eteṣu vyavasthāpya vācaḥ sidhyati mānavaḥ || 12.15 arthavārtāsu sarvāsu guṇavārtāsu sarvataḥ | dharmavārtāsu cāgryāsu satyam evāñjasā vadet || 12.16 prāptakāle priyaṃ brūyād gurūṇāṃ mahatāṃ tathā | paṇḍitānāṃ śiśūnāṃ ca jīrṇānāṃ kliśyatāṃ tathā || 12.17 āsannānāṃ sakhīnāṃ ca śiṣyāṇām anujīvinām | dhārmikānāṃ[ṇāṃ]ca bhaktānāṃ hitaṃ brūyād yathāyatham || 12.18 vṛddhānāṃ saṃprayogaiś ca puṇyaśāstra niṣevaṇaiḥ | abhyāsena ca dīrgheṇa vāṇī sanmārgam ṛcchati || 12.19 vāgindriyam ajasṛkvā [m asatsaṅgā]d ayanta viniyogataḥ | saṃniroddhum aśakyaṃ hi tasmān maunaṃ viśiṣyate || 12.20 lokatantrapravṛttasya na maunaṃ dharma iṣyate | tasmād vācaṃ sadā rakṣet viṣṇubhakto dṛḍhavrataḥ || 12.21 tribhir etair vihīnātma vāṇī bhavati dehinaḥ | adharmāyaiva sā jñeyā duḥkhavyasanakāriṇī || 12.22 paricaryā viśuddhiś ca parānugraha eva ca | śārīras trividho dharmas tena sidhyati mānavaḥ || 12.23 devasyārādhanārthāya yat karoti pariśrayam | vrataiś ca dravyayatnaiś ca paricaryā tu sā smṛtā || 12.24 vrataṃ triṣavaṇasnānam adhaḥ śayanam eva ca | brahmacaryaṃ tathā maunam akṣāralavaṇāśanam || 12.25 rātrau vīrāsanaṃ caiva divā svāpana varjanam | puṇyasthānādi gamanam ity ādi kamalāsana || 12.26 pūjā dravyāṇi devasya samāharati yat svayam | viśodhayati saṃśrāntaḥ paricaryā'pi sā bhavet || 12.27 viśuddhir ātmano jñeyaṃ[yā] malānām apakarṣaṇam | malās tu bahavaḥ kāye tān apāsya viśudhyati || 12.28 mūtraśuklapurīṣāṇi śleṣmavikreya śoṇitam | svedośrūṇi nakhāḥ visravāś ca pṛthagvidhāḥ || 12.29 antargatā na doṣāya bahiḥsthā doṣahetavaḥ | kāle kāle malās tv ete sarveṣāṃ saṃbhavanti ca || 12.30 teṣāṃ śuddhir mṛdā caiva kṣālanāc ca viśodhanam | malānāṃ parakīyānāṃ sparśane snānam ācaret || 12.31 śāvasūtakasaṃyoge durmanaiś ca samāgame | śuklamokṣe vamitvā ca snānam evātmaśodhanam || 12.32 ātmīyānāṃ malānāṃ ca pracyutānāṃ śarīrataḥ | sparśane snānam evoktaṃ svedabāṣpādikaṃ vinā || 12.33 tatrāpy ācamanaṃ kuryān nidraṃ kuryān na sarvadā | yāni cātmaśarīrasya karmopakaraṇāni vai || 12.34 anyabhogena duṣyanti tāny apy asya pitāmaha | devopakaraṇānāṃ ca sthānādīnāṃ pitāmaha || 12.35 doṣahetur manuṣyāṇām upabhoga iti sthitiḥ | pūjāyāṃ viniyuktaṃ tu yad dravyam iha pūjakaiḥ || 12.36 nirmālyam iti vijñeyaṃ sarvakāryeṣu varjitam | hemaratnāṃ śukādīnāṃ sthānasyāgneḥ sruvasya ca || 12.37 pātrāṇāṃ pratimāyāś ca śuddhiḥ prakṣālanād bhavet | malānāṃ kṣālanenāpi śuddhir bhavati laukikī || 12.38 devapūjātha ca snānaṃ nityaśaḥ kārya[ya?]śodhanam | lokasaṃvyavahāreṣu dharmaśāstrāntareṣu ca || 12.39 vidi[hi]tāḥ śuddhayo grāhyāḥ viṣṇubhaktena dhīmatā | atithīnāṃ gurūṇāṃ ca bhṛtyānāṃ vāpi duḥkhinām || 12.40 mahatāṃ dharmasetūnāṃ devatāyatanasya ca | bhikṣukāṇāṃ paśūnāṃ ca vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca mūyasām || 12.41 utsāhair arthadānaiś ca yatnenopakaroti yat | paropakāra ity eṣaḥ śārīro dharma uttamaḥ || 12.42 gāvaḥ pūjyās tu tiryagbhyas tābhyo'pi manujās tathā | tebhyo'pi brāhmaṇāḥ pūjyā bhikṣubhyo'pi ca yoginaḥ || 12.43 yogibhyo'pi tathā pūjyā muktikāmāḥ samāhitāḥ | annadānaṃ paro dharmo vasudānaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ || 12.44 śayanāsanadānaṃ ca vaiṣṇaveṣu yatiṣv api | vidyādānaṃ viśeṣyante nānyāni vipulāni ca || 12.45 bhūmivāhanayānādi vāstvaiśvaryādi sampadaḥ | dānāni kīrti bhūyāṃsi madhyamāni phaleṣu ca || 12.46 avasthayāpadeśena pātreṇa śraddhayā'pi ca | kālena ca dhanenāpi phalaṃ vividham ucyate || 12.47 sarvatrāpi yaśobuddhi[kāma]kāryāś ca ninditāḥ || 12.47,5 ślāghā ca kīrtanaṃ cāpi vaiṣṇavasya viśeṣataḥ | kāmabhedena dānaṃ tu bhūmyādīnāṃ praśasyate || 12.48,5 āyurārogyaputrādi prārthayanti tadanvayāt | dravyāṇi kāladeśau ca pātrasyāpi parīkṣayet || 12.49,5 parīkṣya kriyamāṇe tu sarvaṃ saṃpadyate phalam | yad vā sarvāṇi deyāni dātavyāni manasvinā || 12.50,5 devadevaṃ samuddiśya yaśas tatrānuṣaṅgikam | śuśrūṣāpi paraṃ dānaṃ muktasya ca mahātmanaḥ || 12.51,5 bhaktyā kevalayā kṛtvā siddhir bhavati nānyathā | ity evaṃ trividhaḥ prokto dharmas te kāyasaṃbhavaḥ || 12.52,5 pravṛtter upasaṃkṣepān nivṛttiṃ tu parāṃ śruṇu | etebhyo viparīto yas tam adharma pracakṣate || 12.53,5 adharmād vinivṛttis tu manovāk kāyakarmabhiḥ | nivṛttirūpo dharmo'sau jñeyaḥ pāpavināśanaḥ || 12.54,5 ity evaṃ trividho dharmo manovākkāyasaṃbhavaḥ | kathitas te tathā brahman vaiṣṇavasya viśeṣataḥ || 12.55,5 jitendriyasya viduṣas trividho mānasaḥ paraḥ | prākṛtasyāpi bhaktasya kāyadharmaḥ paraḥ smṛtaḥ || 12.56,5 madhyamānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ vāciko dharma uttamaḥ || 12.57 trividhaḥ kathito dharmo yas tvayā puruṣottama | tenaiva kiṃ vimucyante saṃsārād viṣayānvitāḥ || 12.58 paramaḥ kriyārūpaḥ smṛto dharmo jñānarūpaṃ ca tatpunaḥ | jñānena sādhyate mokṣaḥ kriyā jñānasya śodhinī || 12.59 dha[ka]rmeṇa ca kṛtaṃ jñānaṃ na kvacit pratihanyate | tasyaiva tu vidhaṃ dharmaṃ jñānasya[śruṇu] padmaja || 12.60 kevalaṃ khalu vijñānaṃ dharmasyānugrahaṃ vinā | saṃsāravāsanāviṣṭaṃ nā[na]? prasīdati kiṃcana || 12.61 tasmād dha[t ka]rmeṇa deveśam ārādhya tadanugrahāt | antarāyam atikramya siddhiṃ vrajati vaiṣṇavaḥ || 12.62 karmaṇārādhito devaḥ pāti janmāntareṣv api | upadravāṃś ca nudati saṃtanoti ca saṃpadaḥ || 12.63 saṃniroddhuṃ svaśaktyābhiḥ[tu] śakyaṃ naikam apīndriyam | vinā devaprasādena tasmāt tvaṃ[t taṃ] śaraṇaṃ vraja || 12.64 amukte[amuktau?] bheda eva syāt jīvasya ca parasya ca | muktasya tu na bhedo'sti bhedahetor abhāvataḥ || 12.65 tasmād vimuktim anvicchan viṣṇum eva dine dine | tyaktvā phalam upāsīta manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ || 12.66 tatas tasya pradāne[sāde]na jñānam asya vivardhate | kṣīyate jñānavṛdhyā tu karmapūrvakṛtaṃ punaḥ || 12.67 karmakṣaye viśuddhātmā paraṃ nirvāṇa[m ṛ]m icchati || 12.68
iti śrīpāñcarātre paramasaṃhitāyāṃ dharmo nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ
atha trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ
brahmā nirvāṇamārga gahane prāyeṇa bhuvimānavāḥ | dhṛtyā paramayā sthātuṃ na śaktā iti me matiḥ || 13.1 alpasārā nirudyogāḥ kāmakrodha vaśīkṛtāḥ | niṣkāmā na hi deveśaṃ gacchanti śaraṇaṃ kvacit || 13.2 anyeṣāṃ gūhamāno'pi kāmo'sya hṛdaye sthitaḥ | prakāśa eva devasya sarvadā sa bhaviṣyati || 13.3 tasmāt sarvopakārārthaṃ kāmyayāgān vibhāgaśaḥ | kathayasva yathākālaṃ yathākāmaṃca sarvaśaḥ || 13.4 paramaḥ narāṇāṃ vividhāḥ kāmāḥ sarveṣāṃ kamalāsana | prathamaḥ puṣṭikṛj jñeyo dvitīyaṃ parapīḍanam || 13.5 vidyayā dhanayānaiś ca putraiḥ paśubhir eva ca | dāraiś ca parivāraiś ca yaśasā vijayena ca || 13.6 ārogyeṇa ca rūpeṇa sthānamānādibhis tathā | saṃyogāt puṣṭim ākhyātā puruṣāṇāṃ pitāmaha || 13.7 māraṇaṃ vyādhiyogaṃ ca deśādutsādanaṃ tathā | jayabhaṅgo'rthanāśaś ca tathaivākarṣaṇaṃ balāt || 13.8 vidveṣaṇaṃ vimohaś ca vaśīkaraṇam eva ca | parapīḍanamākhyānam evam ādi pitāmaha || 13.9 puṣṭiṃ vā parapīḍāṃ vā parārthaṃ naiva kārayet | saṃbandhārthaṃ dhanārthaṃ va nāgaḥ kartus tathā bhavet || 13.10 ātmanastūpapannāyāṃ puṣṭau yatnaṃ samācaret | tatrāpi parimāṇena siddhir bhavati nānyathā || 13.11 aparādhād vinātmānaṃ bādhate yaḥ sadā balāt | tasya pīḍāṃ prayuñjīta naivaṃ bhavati kilbiṣī || 13.12 pūrvapakṣaḥ smṛtaḥ kālaḥ puṣṭikāmasya nityaśaḥ | kṛṣṇapakṣas tu vijñeyaḥ śatrupīḍāsu sarvataḥ || 13.13 tithīnāṃ tu vibhāgena bhidyate tatra devatā | kāmabhedena tāṃ nityaṃ pūjayet phalasādhakaḥ || 13.14 tatra tāṃ devatām eṣaḥ phalakāmaḥ prapadyate | tadvidyām abhiyuñjīta śruṇuyāsta[tta]dgaṇān api || 13.15 kalpayet parivārāṃś ca tasyā eva yathāyatham | rakṣārthaṃ lokapālāṃś ca dikṣu sarvāsu kalpayet || 13.16 padmaṃ tu kevalaṃ kṛtvā maṇḍalasthaṃ vibhāsvaram | aṣṭapatraṃ kramād dikṣu karṇikākesarojvalam || 13.17 tatrasthāṃ devatāṃ kṛtvā parivāraiḥ samāvṛtām | āyudhair vāhanaiś cāpi saṃyutām arcayet budhaḥ || 13.18 devatānāṃ tu sarvāsāṃ vimānaṃ maṇḍalaṃ bhavet | vṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā dvārapālair adhiṣṭhitam || 13.19 vapus tejomayaṃ tāsāṃ dīpyamānaṃ samaṃtataḥ | prasādaṃ sukharūpaṃ ca puṣṭāv anyatra bhūṣaṇam || 13.20 ātmaśuddhiṃ kramāt kṛtvā sthānaśudhyādikaṃ tataḥ | ekavīra krameṇaiva devatām arcayed budhaḥ || 13.21 mantrāḥ sarve susaṃgrāhyā ye purastān mayoditāḥ | taddaivatyās tu mantraḥ syuḥ sarvakāryeṣu padmaja || 13.22 upacārakramas tulyaḥ sarvāsām apy aśeṣataḥ | āvāhanavisargādi pratimākalpanādi ca || 13.23 nāmnā rūpeṇa kālena svabhāvena ca devatāḥ | bhidyante parivāraiś ca mantraiś ca vividhais tathā || 13.24 brahmā kair dravyaiḥ kriyate yāgaḥ kasmin kāle ca sādhakaiḥ | devatānāṃ ca ko bhedaḥ tad idānīṃ bravīhi me || 13.25 paramaḥ pratipatprabhṛtīnāṃ tu tithīnām anupūrvaśaḥ | devatānāṃ yathākāmaṃ yāgaṃ vakṣyāmi tac chruṇu || 13.26 triśikhasya tripādasya saptajihvasya padmaja | lohitasyāṣṭabāhoś ca trimūrtes tejasāṃ nidheḥ || 13.27 raktair gandhaiś ca puṣpaiś ca rakta sragvastrabhūṣitaḥ | agnimadhye tu saṃpādya sthaṇḍile vā'sanaṃ śubham || 13.28 tenaiva kramayogena pūjayej jātavedasam | āsanaṃ vāhanaṃ cāsya raktam eva prakalpayet || 13.29 āyudhenaiva mantreṇa sāṅgopāṅgena sādhakaḥ | arthān sarvān avāpnoti bhuṅkte ca satataṃ śubham || 13.30 āgneyyāṃ na ca yatnena vratāni paripālayet | na mukhena dhamed agniṃ nādhaḥ kuryān na laṅghayet || 13.31 agnāv ahutvā nāśnīyān na ca kurvīta pādayoḥ | nānudagdham anukrośet tam eva śaraṇaṃ vrajet || 13.32 evaṃ vidhaiḥ śubhair dravyair brahmāṇaṃ pītavigraham | caturmukhaṃ vidhātāraṃ dvitīyāyāṃ prapūjayet || 13.33 jāyante bahavaḥ putrā vardhate paśusantatiḥ | phalanti vṛkṣauṣadhayaḥ sādhakasya na saṃśayaḥ || 13.34 yakṣarājaṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ śaṅkha padmanidhīśvaram | mahodaraṃ mahākāyaṃ bhaktyā vaiśravaṇaṃ yajet || 13.35 madyamāṃ sopahāraiś ca carubhir balibhis tathā | parivāraiś ca saṃyuktaṃ paripūrṇaṃ dhaneśvaram || 13.36 prāpnoti vibhavān sarvān aiśvaryaṃ cāpi gacchati | caturthyāṃ sitavarṇaṃ tu gaṇeśaṃ vighnanāyakam || 13.37 caturbhujaṃ bṛhatkukṣim ekadantaṃ gajānanam | kandamūlaphalair bhakṣyair bhojyaiś ca vividhair budhaḥ || 13.38 arcayed vighnaśantyarthaṃ kāle kāle ca sādhakaḥ | tasya vighnā na jāyante dyūte ca vijayī bhavet || 13.39 vyavahāre raṇāgre ca jayas tasya bhaviṣyati | pañcamyāṃ padmamadhyasthaṃ padmahastāṃ prapūjayet || 13.40 strīdevatābhiḥ sarvābhiḥ sevyamānāṃ samantataḥ | puṣṭirūpāṃ śriyaṃ devīṃ padmaiḥ carubhir eva ca || 13.41 brahmaśriyai sitaiḥ sarvai raktair ājaśriyaṃ [yai yajet] haret | rājā rājyam avāpnoti jayārthī jayam aśnute || 13.42 aiśvaryakāmas tv aiśvaryaṃ dhanārthī labhate dhanam | ṣaṣṭhyāṃ skandaṃ yajed bhaktyā dāḍimī puṣpasannibham || 13.43 taruṇaṃ śaktihastaṃ ca ṣaṇmukhaṃ kukkuṭadhvajam | mayūravāhanaṃ caityatyāginaṃ balanāyakam || 13.44 vidyāṃ medhāṃ balaṃ rūpaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ | saptamyāṃ taṃ yajed devaṃ saptasaptiṃ mahaujasam || 13.45 lokopakāraniratam ekacakrarathe sthitam | grahāṇām īśvaraṃ bhānuṃ dīptaṃ kavacakuṇḍalaiḥ || 13.46 karavīraiḥ sarojaiś ca suraktai raktavigraham | daridro'pi bhaved āḍhyo vyādhitaḥ svaḥsthatāṃ vrajet || 13.47 śvetarūpaṃ caturbāhum aṣṭamyāṃ rudram arcayet | tejaḥsvī balavān vāgmī nirvighnaś ca bhaviṣyati || 13.48 navamyām ambikāṃ dṛṣṭvā raktaiḥ puṣpais tathā'miṣaiḥ | naras tarati durgāṇi labhate ca jayaśriyam || 13.49 añjanābhaṃ mahākāyaṃ daśamyāṃ yamam arcayet | apamṛtyuṃ ca tarati nirjayaś ca bhaviṣyati || 13.50 ekādaśyāṃ sahasrākṣaṃ śvetarūpaṃ samarcayet | ādhipatyam avāpnoti vibhāvān api puṣkalān || 13.51 dvādaśyāṃ vāsudevaṃ tu sitair dravyaiḥ samarcayet | vardhate vibhavo nityam apradhṛṣyaṃ ca[ś ca?] śatrubhiḥ || 13.52 kāmadevaṃ trayodaśyām arcayed ratnavigraham | putre dāreṣu bhṛtyeṣu saubhāgyaṃ labhate param || 13.53 aṣṭabāhuṃ caturdaśyāṃ jñānārthaṃ rudram arcayet | nivedya pāyasaṃ sājyaṃ labhate jñānam uttamam || 13.54 arcayet pañcadaśyāṃ tu somaṃ saṃpūrṇamaṇḍalam | jalapuṣpaiḥ sitaiḥ śubhrair nīrogaḥ puṣṭimān bhavet || 13.55 tathaiva kṛttikādīnāṃ nakṣatrāṇāṃ ca devatāḥ | arcitāḥ svāni[nu?]rūpāṇi phalāni dadati dhruvam || 13.56 ukto guggulunā dhūpaḥ sarveṣāṃ ghṛtamiśritam | mukhyaś candanagandhaś ca karpūrāgaru saṃyutaḥ || 13.57 puṣṭikāmasya śasyante tithayaḥ pūrvapakṣajāḥ | kṛṣṇapakṣasya tithayaḥ parapīḍāsu saṃmatāḥ || 13.58 kāmarūpāṇi sarvāṇi pūjādravyāṇi sādhakaḥ | ātmano devatāyāś ca svarūpanyāsam eva ca || 13.59 deśaṃ kālaṃ ca saṃbhārān utsāhaṃ satvam eva ca | anurūpeṣu sarveṣu kāmaḥ sidhyati nānyathā || 13.60 vidveṣe cābhicāre ca vaśīkāre ca sarvadā | nāmānyāsāṃ[nyasya] prayuñjīta sādhyamānasya sādhakaḥ || 13.61 tasyānte kāmarūpaṃ ca devatāyai nivedayet | mudrābandhāṃś ca kurvīta sarvayāgeṣu mantravit || 13.62 ātmarakṣāṃ ca sarvatra na bhayaṃ tasya jāyate | tad evaṃ saṃjapen mantraṃ śucir bhūtvā samāhitaḥ || 13.63 sahasram ayutaṃ lakṣam evaṃ siddhir bhaviṣyati || 13.64
iti śrīpāñcarātre paramasaṇhitāyāṃ kāmyayāgo nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ
atha caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ
mudreti kā tvayā proktā yasyā bandho vidhīyete | eṣa me vada vaikuṇṭha lakṣaṇena samanvitām || 14.1 paramaḥ hiṃsakānāṃ mudaṃ yasmāt drāvayantīti darśitāḥ | tena mudrāḥ smṛtā brahman devatānāṃ manoharāḥ || 14.2 pratyakṣālana [bhijñāca]mudrābhiḥ kriyate deva sarvadā | arcaneṣu viśeṣeṇa tena mudrā mahāphalāḥ || 14.3 anugrahaś ca yat rūpaṃ devatāyāḥ prakāśyate | sā mudrā kathitā brahman devatāguhyam uttamam || 14.4 hṛdayaṃ ca śiraś caiva śikhākavacam eva ca | astranetraṃ ca vijñeyaṃ sarvāṅgaṃ sarvasammatam || 14.5 anāmikāmadhyamayor nivedyāṅguṣṭhamāyatam | kurvīta hṛdaye muṣṭiṃ mudrā ca hṛdaye smṛtā || 14.6 nibadhya muṣṭimaṃ hanyād aṅguṣṭhāgreṇa tarjinīm | sthāpayitvā lalāṭānte mudrā śirasa ucyate || 14.7 evaṃ badhvā dṛḍhāṃ muṣṭiṃ kuryād aṅguṣṭham ūrdhvagam | sthāpayitvā śikhādeśe śikhāmudreyam iṣyate || 14.8 antaḥ praviśya cāṅguṣṭhaṃ veṣṭayitvā samantataḥ | saṃharet tarjanīṃ bhūyaḥ sā mudrā kavacasya tu || 14.9 agrahastaṃ parāhṛtya badhvā nārā ca muṣṭivat | visṛṣṭvā [viśiṣṭān] tiryag ānamya astramudreyam ucyate || 14.10 sthāpayitvā bhruvor madhye śikhāmudrām atho mukhīm | netramudrā prayoktavyā hastaḥ sarvatra dakṣiṇaḥ || 14.11 ṣaḍ etāḥ[kathitā] mudrāḥ ṣaḍaṅga nyāsakarmaṇi | ātmarakṣaṇam etābhiḥ kriyate sādhakaiḥ sadā || 14.12 hṛdaye vā lalāṭe vā saṃpuṭāñjalir ūrdhvagā | mudreyaṃ kathitā.....jñeyā praṇāme parameṣṭhinaḥ || 14.13 kṛtvāṅguṣṭhau samāv ūrdhvau badhvā hastau parasparam | yogasaṃpuṭamudreyaṃ sthāne nyāse ca kathyate || 14.14 tathaiva chidravat kṛtvā nyasya mūrdhany atho mukham | abhiṣekaṃ prayuñjīta nyāsānte pāvanaṃ param || 14.15 prasārya karajānūrdhvaṃ manibandhau samudyatau | antaḥ praveśya cāṅguṣṭhau padmamudrāṃ prakalpayet || 14.16 āsane padmarūpe ca sṛṣṭicintāsu ca kramāt | maṇibandhasamau hastau tiryak saṃbhrāmya cakravat || 14.17 paryāyeṇa prayoktavyā cakramudrā mahodayā | cakrakalpana kāle ca rakṣārthaṃ ca prayujyate || 14.18 muṣṭiṃ kṛtvā tu hastābhyāṃ aṅguṣṭhau vinatāv ubhau | yuktvā saṃbhrāmya nirmuktau gadāmudreti kīrtyate || 14.19 pratīkāre ca vighnānāṃ bhūmirakṣāsu cottamā | nibadhya dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhaṃ vāmahastasya muṣṭigam || 14.20 kṛtvā cāṅguṣṭhatarjanyau saṃyute prasṛte same | tisras tu dakṣiṇasyānyā badhnīyur muṣṭim ūrdhvataḥ || 14.21 śaṅkhamudreyam uddiṣṭā dravyāṇāṃ sthāpane param | padmaṃ cakraṃ gadā śaṅkham iti mudrā catuṣṭayam || 14.22 caturṣv evā grahas teṣu devasya vinivedayet | dhanuṣas tu dhanur muṣṭiḥ śaramuṣṭiḥ śarasya tu || 14.23 khaḍgasya kle[ko]śa viśleṣo mudrā kheṭasya maṇḍalam | ubhe kaniṣṭake badhvā pradeśinyāv ubhau tathā || 14.24 hastāv ubhau parāvṛttāv aṅguṣṭhāgnau samāvadhaḥ | madhyamān āmike kuryād abhitaḥ patrayugmavat || 14.25 proktā garuḍamudreyaṃ badhvā bahuphalāvahaḥ | garuḍasthāpane mukhyā sarvasarpabhayeṣu ca || 14.26 prasārya karajān sarvān viralān ūrdhvagāminaḥ | kṛtvā hastasya cāyāmaṃ mudrān antasya kalpyate || 14.27 śayane bandha[dhya]māne ca ātmarakṣāṃ kariṣyati | mūṣikāṇāṃ kṛmīṇāṃ ca sarvadā viṣanāśinī || 14.28 kṛtvotthānāv ubhau hastau saṃpuṭāgrau prasāritau | kurvīta prārthanāmudrāṃ sāṃnidhyāvāhanādiṣu || 14.29 urasi sparśanaṃ kuryād ubhayoḥ sthānayor budhaḥ | śrīvatsārthaṃ dakṣiṇataḥ kaustubhārthaṃ ca vāmataḥ || 14.30 etad uddeśataḥ proktaṃ mudrāṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tava | viniyogaś ca pūjāyāṃ tatra tatra pradarśitaḥ || 14.31 ānantyāl lakṣaṇasyāsya vaktuṃ brahman na śakyate | devatānāṃ bahutvāt tu mudrā bhinnā pṛthak pṛthak || 14.32 sāmānya mudrayā tasmāt sarvāsāṃ kāryam arcanam | nāmanī prārthanī ceti mudre dve sarvasammate || 14.33 tābhyām evāṅgabhūtāsu devatāsu prayojayet | acyutasyāpi pūjāyāṃ tat dve mukhyasya kalpayet || 14.34 mānasaṃ rūpasaṅkalpaṃ mudrāṃ mokṣārthināṃ viduḥ | itareṣāṃ tu hastābhyaṃ prayogaḥ śasyate budhaiḥ || 14.35 na jātu darśayen mudrāṃ mahājanasamāgame | guhyam etad dhi mantreṣu tasmād rahasi yojayet || 14.36 na[nā]dīkṣitasya mudrāṇāṃ lakṣaṇāni prakāśayet | krudhyanti devatās tasya viphalaṃ ca kṛtaṃ bhavet || 14.37
iti śrīpāñcarātre paramasaṃhitāyāṃ mudrānāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ
atha pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ
brahmā kāmyakarmaṇi sarvatra vartamānasya dehinaḥ | sāmānya kalpam ācakṣva yena sidhyanti kāminaḥ || 15.1 paramaḥ sāvaśeṣaṃ mayā proktam idaṃ tava pitāmaha | aśeṣeṇa tu vakṣyāmi kāmyakalpasya saṃgraham || 15.2 ādau saṅkalpayet kāmam ekam eva narobudhaḥ | jātiśīlānurūpyeṇa yena puṣṭaḥ svayaṃ bhavet || 15.3 saṃkalpya dūrato gacchet bāndhavānāṃ purasya ca | āśramaṃ ca niṣeveta toyāḍhyaṃ parvatāśrayam || 15.4 yuktakeśa nakhaśmaśruś cīravalkalasaṃvṛtaḥ | tīrthasnātaḥ svakaṃ kāmaṃ devatānāṃ nivedayet || 15.5 kalpayitvā kuṭīm ekāṃ svayam eva samāśrayet | aśaktaḥ kārayed anyaiḥ sarvārthaṃ vāsam āviśet || 15.6 ekam āsāvamaṃ kālaṃ tatra saṃvatsarāvadhiḥ | kurvīta kāmasidhyarthaṃ puraścaraṇamāditaḥ || 15.7 śarīramantrasaṃskāraḥ puraścaraṇam iṣyate | na tu tena vinā kāmaḥ tāpasasyāpi siddhyati || 15.8 vanyaśākhaiḥ svayaṃ pakvaiḥ kurvīta prāṇadhāraṇam | kandamūlaphalaiś caiva kālapakvaiś ca śaktitaḥ || 15.9 prātaḥ snātvā śucau deśe pūjayen mantradevātām | japakāle japen mantraṃ na kṣipraṃ na vilambitam || 15.10 sahasraṃ śatavāraṃ vā yāvad utsāham eva vā | devatābhibhukho bhūtvā vāgyataḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ || 15.11 āvṛttigaṇanāṃ kurvan japed avahitāśanaḥ | prāpte madhyaṃ dine kāle vidhivat snānam ācaret || 15.12 snātvācāmya nivedyārdhyaṃ tasmān mantraṃ japet punaḥ | ardhyaṃ datvā'parāhne tu viyujen mantradevatāḥ || 15.13 punaḥ snātaḥ kṛtāhāraḥ sandhyām ārādhya saṃviśet | evam eva paredyuś ca karma kurvīta sādhakaḥ || 15.14 uccārārthaṃ bahir gatvā snanaṃ niyatam ācaret | japaṃ niyamapūrvaṃ tu mantraṃ tu prayatottaram || 15.15 dvādaśaiva sahasrāṇi mahāmantraṃ japed budhaḥ | sudarśanaṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ ca vārāham aparajitam || 15.16 dvādaśākṣarato hīnaṃ japed akṣaralakṣakam | pradhānād aṅgamantreṣu deśastu deśa bhāgi[vi]kaḥ || 15.17 eka bījeṣu mantreṣu tenaivāṅgāni kalpayet | kāryaṃ sakalam uktvaiva mālāmantraḥ samāpyate || 15.18 ādyantayos tu praṇavaṃ kuryān mantrasya siddhaye | siddhe mantre yathā nyāyaṃ home svāhāntam ācaret || 15.19 ghṛtena vā samiddhir vā phalair vā homam iṣyate | niyataṃ mantrasiddhyarthaṃ daśavārāvamaṃ budhaḥ || 15.20 aśaktas tu japenn eva mānasaṃ homam ācaret | homāntam eva kurvīta nityaṃ mantraṃ japen budhaḥ || 15.21 nirmathya cāgniaṃ homārtham avināśena dhārayet | tasmin vinaṣṭe bhūyo'pi manthanenaiva dhārayet || 15.22 japyamāne mahāmantre bhayaṃ kurvanti devatāḥ | ghorarūpaṃ mahānādaṃ na tatra vyākulī bhavet || 15.23 anākulam asaṃbhrāntaṃ vañcayanti ca devatāḥ | vilobhanam upasthāpya nārīratnasukhādikam || 15.24 anyaḥ kāraṇavādena svapne bandhujanā iva | sādhakasya dṛḍhāṃ buddhiṃ mandīkurvanti devatāḥ || 15.25 yo na gacchati saṃmohaṃ sādhakas tatra buddhimān | tasya sidhyanti saṅkalpā ye'sya nityaṃ manogatāḥ || 15.26 ajasraṃ kurvatāṃ karma dhīrāṇāṃ vyavasāyinām | sidhyanti vividhāḥ kāmā netareṣāṃ pitāmaha || 15.27 sahāyena vinā dhīraḥ sādhayet kāmya[rya]m ipsitam | kuryāt sahāyam akliṣṭam aśakto [kte] netaraḥ[re] kvacit || 15.28 siddhe mantre prayuñjīta homaṃ kāryasya siddhaye | yāvad daśa sahasrāṇi juhuyāt tāvad āhutīḥ || 15.29 tato bhūyo'tha juhuyāt saṅkalpasya tu gauravāt | śvetapadmāṃs tu juhuyād icchan brahmaśriyaṃ naraḥ || 15.30 raktapadmāni juhuyād ya icchati nṛpaśriyam | aśvatthasamidhā homaṃ rājyakāmaḥ samācaret || 15.31 dūrvāṃ dhṛtāktāṃ juhuyād ya icched vṛddhim āyuṣaḥ | kanyākāmaḥ kālapakvāṃ bhūmikāmas tu mṛttikām || 15.32 sthānakāmas tu juhuyān nyagrodhasamidho naraḥ | audambarīs tu juhuyāt samidhaḥ sarvaśāntaye || 15.33 pāyasaṃ putrakāmas tu juhuyād vaśyakarmaṇi | apāmārgaṃ tu juhuyāt gaveṣu[mahatsu] vyasaneṣu ca || 15.34 vidyākāmas tu juhuyāt pālāśīḥ samīdho budhaḥ | annam annādyakāmas tu jñānakāmo navaṃ ghṛtaṃ || 15.35 bilvam aiśvaryakāmas tu tilān rogasya śāntaye | rudhiraktas tu juhuyāt samidhaḥ kaṇṭakānvitāḥ || 15.36 śatrūn utsādaya[ne]t sa[sa]ndhau sarvapāpān ruṣānvitaḥ | māṣacūrṇapratikṛtiṃ hutvā kṛtvā padāditaḥ || 15.37 chatreṇa juhuyāc chatror abhicarāya sādhakaḥ | vidveṣam icchan lavaṇaṃ juhuyāt tilasaṃyutam || 15.38 suvarṇakāmo juhuyān nimbapuṣpāṇi sādhakaḥ || 15.39 varṣakāmas tu juhuyāt samidho vetasasya tu | svāhākāras tu homeṣu mantrānte niyataḥ smṛtaḥ || 15.40 huṃkāraphaṭkārayutaṃ parapīḍās tu sammatam | tāṃ tām avasthāṃ sādhyasya cintayet sarvakarmasu || 15.41 vaśīkāre vaśībhūtaṃ vidveṣe dveṣam āgatam | parapīḍāsu sarvāsu kuryāc chāntiṃ kṛtātmanaḥ || 15.42 anyathā sumahān doṣo viṣṇudharmeṣu darśitaḥ | prayujya karma kāmārthaṃ pratilabhya ca tatphalam || 15.43 punaḥ kāmasya siddhyarthaṃ prayateta vicakṣaṇaḥ | nirvedaṃ ca tvarāṃ capi kāmyakarmaṇi varjayet || 15.44 vāṅmanobhiḥ kṣaye siddhir anyathā jīvite kṣayaḥ | tasmād ātmahitaṃ kāmam ekam uddiśya puṣkalam || 15.45 kāmyakarmāṇi kurvīta nālam alpaṃ mahāmatiḥ || 15.46
iti śrīpāñcarātre paramasaṃhitāyāṃ kāmyo nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ
atha ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ
kāmasiddhikarān mantrān kāṃścid vakṣyāmi padmaja | śruṇu tān praṇidhānena mahāvīryān mahābalān || 16.1 vārāhaṃ nārasiṃhaṃ śrīkaraṃ ca sudarśanam | etac catuṣṭayaṃ prāhuḥ śreṣṭhaṃ mantreṣu vaiṣṇavāḥ || 16.2 acirād eva sidhyanti mantrā hy ete mahodayāḥ | anyeṣu cirakālena tasmāt teṣāṃ pradhānatā || 16.3 akṣarāṇi trayastriṃśad vārāhasya pitāmaha | bhūmikāmo viśeṣeṇa mantram etat prasādhayet || 16.4 sthānaṃ vaiṣṇavam āsādya pūjayitvā ca taṃ prabhuṃ | dhyātvā varāharūpeṇa mantram āvartayed imam || 16.5 dvādaśaiva sahasrāṇi mantrasiddhis tathā bhavet | punas sa yāvatīṃ bhūmiṃ manasā labdhum icchati || 16.6 tasyāḥ saṃnihitāṃ bhūmim āsādya satataṃ japet | lakṣamardhaṃ caturbhāgaṃ tribhāgaṃ ca yathā tatham || 16.7 yāvaj japati tāvat sā labhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | catuḥśatākṣaro mantro nārasiṃha iti smṛtaḥ || 16.8 amoghaś cāpradhṛṣyaś ca mahāvīryo mahodayaḥ | pātālaviṣayā siddhis tena sarvā tu labhyate || 16.9 siddhi[ddhiḥ] dravyaṃ raso vā pi bhūmiḥ svargo rasāyanam | rathenārthasamṛddhiḥ syāt siddhadravyeṇa siddhimān || 16.10 rasāyanena dīrghāyuḥ bhū(?)miḥ svargeṇa nirvṛtiḥ | paścimadvāram āśritya deva devasya mandiram || 16.11 dvādaśaiva sahasrāṇi mantram āvartayed imam | puraścaraṇasiddhyarthaṃ tato bilamukhaṃ vrajet || 16.12 tatrāpi vidhinā tiṣṭhan mantram etat sadā japet | sahasravāramāvṛtya praviveśāviśaṃkitaḥ || 16.13 yas tu praveśanaṃ necchet pātālaṃ sādhakaḥ kvacit | sa bilasya samīpastho mantrasya japam ācaret || 16.14 kṛte tu japabāhulye bhitāḥ pātāla vāsinaḥ | kurvanti bahudhā vighnaṃ sādhakasya samaṃtataḥ || 16.15 te tu niścalacittasya jñāti[tu?]kāmā manorathān | āgatyāgatya pṛcchanti tatra kāryaṃ yathāruci || 16.16 tair upānītam ādāya kāmam asya hṛdi sthitam || 16.17 svadeśe vā sukhaṃ jīvet yatra kutra yathā sukham | śrīkarasyāpi yo mantras tam aṣṭākṣarakaṃ viduḥ || 16.18 sarvakāmān avāpnoti yasyābhyāsena sādhakaḥ | vaiṣṇavaṃ sthānam āsādya viviktaṃ sumanoramam || 16.19 bhagavantaṃ samārādhya japen mantram anāratam | dhruvaṃ pañca sahasrāṇi tata ūrdhvaṃ yathāruci || 16.20 evaṃ japet dvādaśāhaṃ puraścaraṇasiddhaye | āyuṣkāmo dhṛtābhyaktān dūrvāṃstu juhuyān na va || 16.21 āhutīrayutaṃ hutvā hutaśeṣeṇa sarpiṣā | carūn prāśya viśuddhātma dadyād viprāya kāñcanam || 16.22 apamṛtyūn atikramya śatavarṣāṇi jīvati | sūtreṇa grathitaṃ cakraṃ mantreṇāmṛśya dhārayet || 16.23 sarvebhya eva satvebhyo rakṣā bhavati niścalā | āhave sumanāḥ puṣpair mantreṇānena mantrayet || 16.24 mu[su]khaṃ graha gṛhītasya sa tu śīghraṃ vimuñcati | vīrakrayeṇa vikrīya śatapuṣpaṃ sahasraśaḥ || 16.25 juhuyān madhurais tāṃ [s tāvat] tat daridraḥ sakulaṃ bhavet | ūrdhvabāhur jape[r bhava]n nityam ādityābhimukho japet || 16.26 avicchinnaṃ bhavaty asya nityam annādyam āspade | śmaśānabhasma juhuyāt vāsarāṇy ekaviṃśatiḥ || 16.27 budhyā śatrum anusmṛtya tam utsādayati dhruvam | āsurīpiṣṭakalkena viṣṇum ālikhya[pya] sarvataḥ || 16.28 tantreṇāmṛśya bahuśaḥ śatrus tu jvaravān bhavet | gavyena payasā devaṃ snāpayitvā vimocayet || 16.29 gomayena sthititvena kṛtvā pratikṛtiṃ dviṣaḥ | pādenākramya hṛdaye japan mantraṃ nihanti tam || 16.30 tridhā sthaṇḍilam ālipya dikṣu kumbhān nidhāpayet | ekaviṃśatikṛtvas tu mantrayitvā pṛthak pṛthak || 16.31 madhye deveśam ārādhya payasā tān prapūrayet | mantreṇa pūjayitvā tu snāpayitvā[yec chrī]mṛ[ṛ]tadaye || 16.32 dīrghāyuṣyam avāpnoti sā putram aviśaṅkitam | vandhyā'pi labhate putraṃ strīḥ prayogān na saṃśayaḥ || 16.33 śatavāram imaṃ mantraṃ nityaṃ japati yo naraḥ | na vidhāto'sya kāryeṣu bhayaṃ vā jāyate kvacit || 16.34 mṛtyusthāneṣu durgeṣu bhaye vā pratyupasthite | imam āvartayen mantraṃ nāvasidati sādhakaḥ || 16.35 rikto'pi sarvato martyo mantram āvartayann imam | udyogam antareṇāpi labhate siddhim īpsitām || 16.36 sudarśanasya mantrasya kathayanty akṣarāṇi ṣaṭ | aiśvaryam īpsitaṃ sarvaṃ tasyābhyāsena sidhyati || 16.37 rājyakāmaḥ samāvartya parvatāgraṃ jalānvitam | ṣaḍakṣaraṃ japen mantraṃ pūrvasevā bhaved iyam || 16.38 padmāni juhuyād agnau nityaṃ bilvena vā naraḥ | ayutaṃ niyutaṃ vā pi tataḥ śrīr upasarpati || 16.39 aśaktas tu japed etat dīrghakālam atandritaḥ | devaṃ satatam ārādhya rājyam asya bhaviṣyati || 16.40 śatrubhir badhyamānas tu vaiṣṇavo juhuyāt sadā | vibhītakasamidbhis tu śatrupakṣo'sya śīryate || 16.41 śātravān jetukāmaś ca juhuyāt sādhakaḥ svayam | sahasraparam etena śatruṃ jayati nirbhayaḥ || 16.42 ṣaḍakṣaraṃ dvādaśāraṃ vācaṃ kṛtvā japed imam | sauvarṇam athavā tāmraṃ nihitaṃ sarvataḥ śubham || 16.43 upari sthāpayed gehe nityam ārādhayec ca tam | japec ca satataṃ mantraṃ nāsya kiṃcid bhayaṃ bhavet || 16.44 japet sudarśanaṃ mantraṃ nāsya kiṃcid bhayaṃ bhavet | japet sudarśanaṃ mantraṃ satataṃ yo mahāmatiḥ || 16.45 taṃ siṃham iva manyante prakṣīṇam api śātravaḥ | cakrasya nābhimadhyastham ātmānaṃ bhāvayan japet || 16.46 kevalo'pi na saṅgrāme parājayam avāpnuyāt | dhārayan pāṇinā cakraṃ bhrāmayan satataṃ japet || 16.47 tasyāṃ diśi mukhaṃ kṛtvā śatrusenā nivartate | prāpte janapadavyādhau rākṣasair vā bhayekṛte || 16.48 apāmārgasamiddhomāt sarvaṃ samupaśāmyati | cakramadhyastham ātmānaṃ dhyātvā paśyed gṛhārditaḥ || 16.49 amarṣeṇa japen mantraṃ saśīghram abhisarpati | yo'sāv aṣṭākṣaro mantraḥ prokto nārāyaṇāśrayaḥ || 16.50 acintyāḥ siddhayas tena sādhyante sādhakottamaiḥ | aṣṭākṣaraṃ japen mantraṃ pūrvasevā bhaved iyam || 16.51 tatas tu vaiṣṇavaḥ svānte nityaṃ maunayuto japet | saṃvatsarajapād eva sādhako niyatendriyaḥ || 16.52 niṣkāmo devadevasya labhate rūpadarśanam | yāṃ devatām anudhyāya dhīmān mantram idaṃ japet || 16.53 ṣaṇmāsād eva tasyāś ca rūpaṃ paśyati cakṣuṣā | cāturmāsyajapād eva svarūpaṃ paśyati śriyaḥ || 16.54 yakṣāṇāṃ kiṃnarāṇāṃ ca martyānāṃ ca na saṃśayaḥ | śāpaṃ vā'nugrahaṃ vā'pi yasya yaḥ kartum icchati || 16.55 cāturmāsyajapād eva kurute sarvam īpsitam | devatānāṃ vaśīkāre rūpadarśana eva ca || 16.56 aṣṭākṣaraṃ japenn eva labhate siddhim īpsitām | niṣkāmo'pi japenn etad vaiṣṇavaḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ || 16.57 upāsyate sarvajanaiḥ kālajñānaṃ ca vindati || 16.58
iti śrīpāñcarātre paramasaṃhitāyāṃ kāmyo nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
atha saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ
rājāno rājamātrā vā durvṛttā durjanāśritāḥ | icchanto vaiṣṇavīṃ dīkṣāṃ kiṃ kuryuḥ kāyaśuddhaye || 17.1 na hi teṣāṃ tapaḥ kartum avakāśo'sti kaścana | na hi pāpābhibhūtena dīkṣā kāryā tu vaiṣṇavī || 17.2 paramaḥ īśvarasya samṛddhasya viṣṇubhaktasya dhīmataḥ | janmaprabhṛti saṃskāraḥ kāryo dīkṣā praveśane || 17.3 puṇyena hi śubhe kāle brāhmaṇānām anujñayā | kārayet kāścanamayau dvau kaṭāhau samau tataḥ || 17.4 pūrayitvā tayorekaṃ dadhnā madhu ghṛtena ca | ekānte nirjane sthāne śobhite sarvamaṅgalaiḥ || 17.5 snātamīśvaramācāryaḥ pāṇāvālambya pāṇinā | dehaṃ saṃhāramārgeṇa cintayitvā yathā kramam || 17.6 jīvakāmas tu taṃ dhyātvā hemagarbhaṃ praveśayet | apareṇa kaṭāhena chādayed upari svayam || 17.7 jīvaṃ prakṛtim āpannaṃ matvā'sīnas tato guruḥ | ātmānam api saṃhṛtya punar utpādya sarvataḥ || 17.8 jīvasya dehanirmāṇaṃ kṛtvā mantrair yathākramam | hemagarbhāt krameṇaivam upasthāpya punar ānayet || 17.9 kartuṃ janma bhaved asya mantravad deva nirmitam | tato'sya jātakarmāṇi sakalaṃ karma kārayet || 17.10 nāmadheyaṃ ca kartavyaṃ devānām asya kiṃcana | jātiśīlānurūpyeṇa vaiṣṇavānāṃ anujñayā || 17.11 caulopanayane cāsya kārayed vidhipūrvakam | tatas tu hemagarbhaṃ taṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradāpayet || 17.12 vaiṣṇavebhyo viśeṣeṇa vidvadbhi[dabhya?]ś ca viśeṣataḥ | traivarṇikaṃ svakair mantraiḥ sarvakarmāṇi kārayet || 17.13 śūdraṃ tu tantrajair mantrair dāsāntaṃ nāma ca smṛtam | upavītaṃ ca vastraṃ ca guṇamantreṇa yojayet || 17.14 uttarīyopavīte ca pūjākāle tu nānyadā | na śūdrasya paraṃ bījaṃ jape dhyāne ca kalpayet || 17.15 na mantroccāraṇād doṣaḥ karmayogasya sammataḥ | tīvrabhakto bhaved yas tu vidyā dharmarataḥ śuciḥ || 17.16 taṃ śūdram api sarvatra yojayed apramādanam | tasyāpi nācārya padaṃ dīkṣāsu sthāpane'pivā || 17.17 kalpayet paṅktimadhye ca yajane yājane'pi vā | anyena vaiṣṇavenaiva devaṃ śūdraḥ prapūjayet || 17.18 śuśrūṣeta svayaṃ tatra pūjayā tosayet tathā | evaṃ dvādaśa varṣāṇī pūjayitvā dine dine || 17.19 svayaṃ pūjāṃ punaḥ kuryān naivaṃ bhavati kilbiṣī | upanītam athācāryaḥ śraddhāsahitam īśvaram || 17.20 dīkṣayed vidhinā sarvaṃ śikṣayitvā yathāvidhi | sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ vāpi pātraṃ sarvatra yojayet || 17.21 tatrādhivāsya taṃ bhūyas tulābhāraṃ prapūrayet | ātmamāna samo mānaḥ kṛtvā kāñcanam uttamam || 17.22 vidvadbhyo dakṣiṇāṃ datvā śuddho bhavati sarvataḥ | taṃ punar dīkṣayed vidvān mantramudrāś ca śikṣayet || 17.23 kalpayed upadeśāṃś ca samayācāram eva ca | ācārāṇāṃ tu vaikalyam arthadānena pūrayet || 17.24 naimittikāni karmāṇi mahādānena sarvaśaḥ | varṣe varṣe tulābhāraṃ yo dadāti mahādhanaḥ || 17.25 saṃvatsaraprayogāt sa viṣṇoḥ sāyujyam ṛcchati | śaktimantaṃ ca bhaktaṃ ca dvādaśyāṃ māsi māsi ca || 17.26 snātvā prāṅmukham ācārya[ḥ?] carmamadhye niveśayet | kṛṣṇasārājine vipraṃ vyāghracarmaṇi bhūmipam || 17.27 ajine raurave vaiśyaṃ śūdraṃ tasmiṃś ca carmaṇi | tatropaveśya kalaśai ratnavadbhir hiraṇyamayaiḥ || 17.28 tīrthatoyena saṃpūrṇaiḥ svayam evābhiṣecayet | pūrvaṃ saṃhṛtya cotpādya sarvamantrair anukramāt || 17.29 mūrtimantraiḥ kramād eva sṛṣṭimārgeṇa sarvadā | abhiṣicya ca kurvīta mantrair asya vibhūṣaṇam || 17.30 sukhāsīnaṃ tam ācāryaḥ śikṣayed evam agrataḥ | vaiṣṇavo'si bhajethās tvaṃ viṣṇum evāgra [śra]yā dhiyā || 17.31 śraddhayā parayopetas tadguṇān eva kīrtayet | naca śakyaṃ tapobhir vā pāpaṃ nāśayituṃ tvayā || 17.32 yadi dāne'py aśakyas tvam andhe tamasi majjasi | yad dadāti viśiṣṭebhyo yac cā[c ca] bhuṅkte bhavārthanam[rjitam] || 17.33 tāvad eva tava vyaktaṃ śeṣaṃ ta[ka?]syāpi rakṣasi | nī[dī]yamānaṃtu viprebhyo hane[havane] vidhivartanam || 17.34 vaiṣṇave caraṇe sākṣāt puṣpanyāsam anusmaret | na viśvāsas tvayā kāryaḥ putradāradhanādiṣu || 17.35 kārya eva tu viśvāsaḥ puruṣottamapādayoḥ | yu[bu]ddhakāle tathā svapne viṣameṣv aviṣameṣu ca || 17.36 tava nānyaṃ prapaśyāmi taṃ vinā puruṣottamam | tasmāt samayam ācāraṃ vratāni niyamāṃs tathā || 17.37 pūjanaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca nāpady api parityaja | ity ukto guṇavān svāmī praṇipatya kṛtāñjaliḥ || 17.38 sarvam evaṃ karomīti gurave vinivedayet | dhanadānena mānena pūjayec ca tato gurum || 17.39 sarvakārye puraskuryād gauraveṇa ca vartayet | sahāyān iva tacchiṣyān anyān api samācaret || 17.40 viṣṇubhaktān viśiṣṭāṃś ca dūrād eva vicārayet | āgatānāṃ priyaḥ kārya aśanācchādanādiṣu || 17.41 viśvāsāc chruṇuyāc caināṃ grahasyapritya[nān grāhayasva pri]yāṃs tathā | satataṃ ca japen mantram ekānte vaiṣṇavaṃ param || 17.42 arcayec ca svayaṃ devaṃ śaktaḥ svāmī tu dīkṣitaḥ | pratimāṃ lakṣaṇopetāṃ kārayitvā hiraṇmayīm || 17.43 sauvarṇāni ca pātrāṇi śaṅkhamuktimayāni ca | dīkṣitān eva kurvīta pūjāyāṃ paricārakān || 17.44 pūjānte nityadānaṃ ca kuryād ahar ahar nṛpaḥ | hiraṇyam annapānaṃ ca mukhavāsāmbarāṇi ca || 17.45 anyena pūjayed devam aśaktaḥ svayam arcane | arcanānte hiraṇyaṃ ca tasmai deyam asaṃśayam || 17.46 anyathā pūjakasyaiva devapūjāphalaṃ bhavet | vaiṣṇaveṣv adhivāseṣu pūjādravyaṃ ca dāpayet || 17.47 devabhogāṃś ca saṃrakṣed duṣṭanigrahatatparaḥ | viṣṇupādāśrayaṃ kṛtvā śapathaṃ kāraṇe kvacit || 17.48 na vyājam ācaret kiṃcit kāmaṃ tu śapathāntare | kāryaṃ jānāti rikteti nityanaimittike'pivā || 17.49 ācāryavihitaṃ dānaṃ kṛtvā tat paripūjayet | dānena pāpaṃ vinuded ānenārogyam ānayet || 17.50 dānenācāryam anvicchet dānena param arcayet | rājā vā rājatulyo vā kurvann evaṃ dine dine || 17.51 ihalokasukhaṃ bhuṅktvā viṣṇuloke mahīyate || 17.52
iti śrīpāñcarātre paramasaṃhitāyāṃ īśvaro nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ
athāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ
brahmā ye narā dhanadhānyena samṛddhā jñānavarjitāḥ | bhaktimanto mahotsāhāḥ kiṃ teṣāṃ saṃsṛtir bhavet || 18.1 na hi te paramaṃ devaṃ karmaṇā manasā girā | śaktāḥ pūjayituṃ tasmāt brūhi teṣāṃ mahad dhitam || 18.2 paramaḥ puṃsām akṛtavidyānāṃ bhaktānāṃ dhanināṃ tathā | sthāpanād devadevasya vihitaṃ siddhir uttamam || 18.3 viduṣām api mukhyānāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ phalārthinām | bhavaty eva parā siddhiḥ sthāpanāt parameṣṭhinaḥ || 18.4 ye sthāpayanti deveśaṃ prāsāde vidhipūrvakam | rājānas te bhaviṣyanti bhūmipānām adhīśvarāḥ || 18.5 athavā guṇasampūrṇe vaṃśe śreṣṭhe mahātmanām | jāyante kṛtavidyāś ca suvṛttā dīrghajīvinaḥ || 18.6 athavā kāmitāṃ siddhiṃ labhante nātra saṃśayaḥ | na tu devaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya na phalaṃ vindate naraḥ || 18.7 iṣṭakā dārupāṣāṇān sthāpanārthaṃ samāhṛtān | pūjādravyāṇi devasya tāny avai[ve]hi pitāmaha || 18.8 prayatante tu ye tatra sthāpanārthaṃ yathābalam | prāsādakāraṇārthaṃ vā sa teṣāṃ yāga ucyate || 18.9 upakurvanti ye śaktyā vacasā yojayanti ye | teṣām api phalaṃ brahman sthāpanād upajāyate || 18.10 brahmā kathaṃ sa paramo devaḥ sthāpyate bhuvi mānuṣaiḥ | saṃsārīva kuṭumbīva sarvadā gṛham āśritāḥ || 18.11 paramaḥ na kenacid asau devaḥ sthāpyate rakṣyate'pi vā | bhaktānām anugṛhṇāti pūjāmātraṃ sa kevalam || 18.12 kiṃkarās tu vasantyeṣu sthāneṣu vividhāḥ pṛthak | yogasiddhim anuprāptā ye narāḥ puṇyakarmabhiḥ || 18.13 bhagavān eva tān sarvān niveśayati sadmasu | bhaktānām anukampārthaṃ nānāśīlaguṇodayān || 18.14 teṣāṃ tu pūjanāt prīto bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ | narāṇāṃ kurute siddhiṃ yathācāraṃ yathāguṇam || 18.15 tasmāt te kathayiṣyāmi sthāpanasya paraṃ kramam | yajñād vā labhate siddhiṃ vaiṣṇavaḥ paramaṃ hitam || 18.16 prāsādo bhavanaṃ ceti dvividhaṃ sthānam ucyate | yatrāsau sthāpito devaḥ puruṣāṇāṃ prasīdati || 18.17 prāsāde sthāpitaḥ sarvān anugṛhṇāti pūjakān | sthāpito bhavane teṣu poṣayaty ātmanaḥ kulam || 18.18 iṣṭakā dārupāṣāṇaiḥ kārayed devamandiram | garbhāgāraṃ ca tanmadhye sthāpayet tatra mādhavam || 18.19 prāsādā vividhāḥ proktāḥ śilpavidyāviśāradaiḥ | caturaśrāś ca vṛttāś ca sāmyena viṣameṇa ca || 18.20 teṣu nityā dhruvāś cāpi jñeyā brahma[n] mahābalāḥ | madhyamāś cādhamāś caiva sthitikālena kīrtitāḥ || 18.21 dārubhya iṣṭakāḥ pakvā iṣṭakābhyo ghanāḥ śilāḥ | tiṣṭhanti suciraṃ kālaṃ phalam eṣāṃ kramāt sthitam || 18.22 pratimāṃ tu vidhānena kārayitvā salakṣaṇām | sthāpayet phalasidhyarthaṃ kāle prāpte suśobhane || 18.23 suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ kāṣṭhapāṣāṇamṛttikā | dravyāṇi pratimāyās tu pūrvaṃ pūrvavad eva vā || 18.24 sādhako racayitvādau sālaṃkāraṃ samaṃtataḥ | pūrvato garuḍasyāpi bhavanaṃ kārayed budhaḥ || 18.25 mātaṇāṃ maṇṭapaṃ cāpi dakṣiṇena prakalpayet | diśāsu lokapālānāṃ śilāpīṭhāni kārayet || 18.26 īśānasomayor madhye viṣvaksenasya maṇḍapam | prākāraṃ tu bahiḥ kṛtvā dvāradeśe ca gopuram || 18.27 ācāryaṃ varayet paścāt subṛttaṃ tantrapāragam | etat sarvaṃ kramāt kṛtvā mūrtipān parigṛhya ca || 18.28 nakṣatrāṇi parīkṣeta tithirāśigrahās tathā | yady ete yajamānasya saṃbhavanti śubhāvahāḥ || 18.29 tadā bhāgavat ācāryaḥ prārabhetādhivāsanam | bahavo yajamānāś cet sthāpakasya puraḥsarāḥ || 18.30 tatrāpi jātayogena śubhavṛddhiṃ nirūpayet | balino rāśayo grāhyāḥ śubhagrahabalasthitāḥ || 18.31 aviṣṭyariktās tithayo nakṣatrāṇi sthirāṇi ca | nimittāni parīkṣyāgre śakunāni śubhā giraḥ || 18.32 gṛhṇīyāt dhanadānena pratimāṃ lakṣaṇānvitām | prāsādasyāgrtaḥ kuryād adhivāsanamaṇḍapam || 18.33 śubhaṃ sarvatra vihitaṃ snānapīṭhasamanvitam | jalādhivāsanārthaṃ ca sthānam anyat prakalpayet || 18.34 toyapūrṇena pātreṇa saṃyutaṃ sarvatovṛtam | nadīṣu devakhāteṣu taḍāge nirjhare hrade || 18.35 saṃbhave sati kurvīta jalāvāsaṃ yathāvidhi | prāsāda dvāramānena bimbamānaṃ prakalpayet || 18.36 bimbamānānurūpaṃ vā prāsādaṃ kārayed budhaḥ | viprān dvādaśavāṣṭau vā caturo vā guṇānvitān || 18.37 vaiṣṇavān mūrtipān kuryād ācāryavacane sthitān | pratyekam eva sarveṣāṃ homadravyāṇi kalpayet || 18.38 evaṃ kṛtvā tu biṃbasya jalāvāsaṃ prakalpayet | trirātram ekarātraṃ[vā] purastād adhivāsayet || 18.39 ācāryo mūrtipaiḥ sārdhaṃ vastrālaṃkārabhūṣitam | sthāpanasya tu pūrvedyur upavāsaparo bhavet || 18.40 aparāhṇe tu saṃprāpte biṃbaṃ prakṣālya vāriṇā | parīkṣya lakṣaṇaṃ samyak brāhmaṇān svasti vācya ca || 18.41 sadarbhair ahatair vastraiḥ sarvataḥ chādayed guruḥ | sthānaṃ jalādhivāsasya nītvā sahamūrtipaiḥ || 18.42 ātmanyāsaṃ kramāt kṛtvā sakalīkaraṇaṃ tathā | lokapālān bahir dhṛtvā sthānasya tu samantataḥ || 18.43 arcāṃ saṃhāramārgeṇa nadyās toyaṃ praveśayet | pañca mantraiḥ kramād evaṃ rakṣāṃ kuryāc ca sarvataḥ || 18.44 atha rātryāṃ vyatītāyāṃ sarvamaṅgalasaṃyutam | kuryāt toraṇavinyāsaṃ maṇḍapasya diśāṃ mukhe || 18.45 kalaśān dvārapārśveṣu pari[vāri]pūrṇān nidhāpayet | āliptapallavair yuktān vārimantreṇa sarvaśaḥ || 18.46 patākādhvajavinyāsaṃ vāyumantreṇa kalpayet | evaṃ kṛtvā samānīya biṃbaṃ salilamadhyataḥ || 18.47 tūrya vāditra nirghoṣaiḥ prāviśet snānamaṇḍapam | sthāpayitvā tu śayyāyām arcāṃ prākchirasāṃ guruḥ || 18.48 dṛṣṭim uddhāṭyet pūrvaṃ sūcyā'cāryaḥ śitānayā | paścāt tu pūjitaḥ śilpī kuryāc chastreṇa śilpavit || 18.49 unmīlya nayane samyak ghṛtena madhunā tathā | samabhyarcya viśuddhyarthaṃ kārayet snānam aṃbhasā || 18.50 prāṅmukhaṃ snānapīṭhasthaṃ snāpayet tam udaṅmukhaḥ | siddhārthataṇḍulaiḥ piṣṭaiḥ pañcagavyaiḥ krameṇa ca || 18.51 ācchādya snāpayet paścāt pañcamantraiḥ samantataḥ | sarittīrthanagāgrebhyo valmīka vṛṣaśṛṅgataḥ || 18.52 varāhagajadantābhyāṃ khatām ādāya mṛttikām | yathāsaṃbhavato vāpi kṛtvā tanmātramantritām || 18.53 mṛdam ālipya kurvīta snānaṃ salilavidyayā | tato gandhodakaiḥ snānaṃ kārayet kṣitividyayā || 18.54 tīrthāṃbhasā ca toyena toyaiś caiva tu tejasā | vāyūnāṃ divyanu[tyāca?] snāpayitvā samaṃtataḥ || 18.55 snāpayitvā samabhyarcya gandhair api navaiḥ śubhaiḥ | sparśamantreṇa vastre dve dadyād yajñopavītikam || 18.56 dadyād ābharaṇaṃ sarvaṃ majjanaṃ puruṣātmanā | viśvamantreṇa mālyāṃ ca prāvāraṃ guṇavidyayā || 18.57 dīpaṃ ca tejasā datvā chatraṃ ca kṣitividyayā | datvopari vitānaṃ ca cāmarāṇi ca vayunā || 18.58 evaṃ kṛtvā nayed biṃbam adhivāsanamaṇḍapam | mṛduśayyāsamāyuktaṃ dhūpadīpasamanvitam || 18.59 yāgopakaraṇādyaṃ ca vaiṣṇavair upaśobhitam | sthāpayitvā tato biṃbaṃ śayyāyāṃ dakṣiṇāmukham || 18.60 mantranyāsaṃ prakurvīta pralayodayasaṃyutam | ātmanirvṛtimāyāṃ ca sarvamantrasamanvitām || 18.61 kāryaiś ca kāraṇaiś caiva saṃyuktaṃ vidhipūrvakam | śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāpadmaṃ kalpayitvā ca mudrayā || 18.62 kuryād āvāhanaṃ viṣṇoḥ pañca mantraiḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ | sānnidhyaṃ sarvakāleṣu saṃprārthya pratipūjayet || 18.63 arghyapādyanivedyāni datvā mantrair yathāvidhi | pūjayitvā tato devaṃ parihomaṃ samācaret || 18.64 kṛtvā tu trīṇi kuṇḍāni dikṣu kṛtvā tu mūrtipān | juhuyat dvādaśa śreṣṭhān aṣṭhau catvāra eva vā || 18.65 vṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā kuṇḍaṃ sarvatra kārayet | kṛtvā tu madhyataḥ kuṇḍam ācāryo juhuyāt punaḥ || 18.66 kuśān āstīrya pātraṇi sadhayitvā yathāvidhi | havir ājyaṃ ca saṃskṛtya juhuyuḥ sarvadevatāḥ || 18.67 pakvatu mūrtipāpā[lā]nāṃ dvādaśānāṃ vidhīyate | madhye tu devadevasya mantreṇa juhuyād dhaviḥ || 18.68 sarveṣāṃ sadṛśaḥ kalpo bhedo digdevatāvaśāt | agnimadhye mahāpadmaṃ dhyātvā kesarapatriṇam || 18.69 tatrasthāṃ devatāṃ dhyātvā homaṃ kuryus tato dvijāḥ | praṅmukhā juhuyuḥ sarve sottarīyaṃ samāhitāḥ || 18.70 tato homāvasāne tu tebhyo datvā tu dakṣiṇām | arghyaṃ datvā ca devāya chādayed vasanaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 18.71 kṛtvopari vitānaṃ ca bahiḥ sarvaṃ pariśrayet | pīṭhaṃ brahmaśilāṃ cāpi pūjayitvā'dhivāsayet || 18.72 nṛttagītādibhis tatra kuryāj jāgaraṇaṃ niśi | rakṣāṃ ca sarvataḥ kuryād adhivāsanamaṇḍape || 18.73 ācāryas tūpavāsena devapārśve niśāṃ nayet || 18.74 iti te sarvam ākhyātam adhivāsanam uttamam | ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi sthāpanaṃ vidhicoditam || 18.75
iti śrīpāñcarātre paramasaṃhitāyāṃ adhivāsanaṃ nāma aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ
athaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
brahmā sthāpito'pi kathaṃ devaḥ sthāneṣu vidhinā naraiḥ | kvacit kathaṃcid aiśvaryaṃ sānnidhyaṃ ca kariṣyati || 19.1 paramaḥ deśasya guṇadoṣābhyāṃ kālasya puruṣasya ca | prāsādasya ca biṃbasya sthāpanaṃ vidyate bhuvi || 19.2 eteṣu doṣayukteṣu devasya sthāpane mate | śūnyaṃ bhavati sarvatra rākṣasair vā 'bhibhūyate || 19.3 deśe durjanabhūyiṣṭhe viprakṛṣṭajale'pi ca | nānā vyādhisamākīrṇe na devaṃ sthāpayed budhaḥ || 19.4 na rātrau sthāpayed devaṃ pāpagrahabale tathā | ugre ca tithinakṣatre sūrye cādṛṣṭamaṇḍale || 19.5 nāgṛhastho na cāvidvān nāvipro nopajīvikaḥ | na ca nyūnāṅgaritkāṅgaḥ sthāpayet puruṣottamam || 19.6 kṛtaparyuṣite jīrṇe mānahīnopajīvikam | karmāntareṇa bhūyiṣṭhe nāgāre sthāpayed dhiram || 19.7 nodvāsitaṃ na bhagnaṃ ca pramāṇavivarjitam | na garbhayuktaṃ jīrṇaṃ vā sthāpayed biṃbam ācaret || 19.8 evam eteṣu duṣṭeṣu devasya sthāpane kṛte | yakṣarakṣaḥpiśācānāṃ sannivāso bhaviṣyati || 19.9 yadakṛddevadevasya prasādam avadhārayet | tadā tad doṣayuktaṃ ca guṇayuktaṃ bhaviṣyati || 19.10 eteṣu guṇayukteṣu sthāpakaḥ prātar utthitaḥ | snātvācamya śucir bhūtvā vastrālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ || 19.11 mūrtipaiḥ sārdham āgatya maṇḍapasya pradakṣiṇam | āsīno dakṣiṇe pārśve devasya prāṅmukhaḥ śuciḥ || 19.12 nyāsamārgaṃ prayuñjīta svaśarīre samantrakam | prāsādaṃ śodhayet paścāt bahir antaś ca sarvaśaḥ || 19.13 toraṇadhvajavinyāsaṃ sapatākaṃ prayojayet | kalaśān sthāpayet paścāt dvāradeśeṣu sarvataḥ || 19.14 dravyāṇi pūjanārthāni homārthāni ca saṃharet | ratnāni dhātubījāni samuccitya pṛthak pṛthak || 19.15 tūryavāditrahastāṃś ca saṃharet kuśalān narān | etat sarvaṃ samānīya nimittāny upalakṣya ca || 19.16 sthānāni devatānāṃ ca pratipūjya yathātatham | sthāpanasya vidhiṃ kuryād ācāryaḥ saha mūrtipaiḥ || 19.17 duḥsvapnadarśane jāte durnimittāgame tathā | maṇḍape vahnim ādīpya prāyaścittāni kārayet || 19.18 juhuyāt pañca mantrais tu ājyam eva kramāt kramāt | daśakṛtvaḥ śataṃ vāpi sahasraṃ vā yathākramam || 19.19 puṇyāha jayaghoṣaiś ca viprāṇāṃ dhvanibhis tathā | ūnaṃ vā vyatiriktaṃ vā vyastaṃ vā pratipūrayet || 19.20 tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā devadevaṃ kutāñjaliḥ | labdhānujño bahiḥ kuryāt prāsādaṃ ca pradakṣiṇam || 19.21 āntradṛṣṭyā samālokya garbhāgāraṃ punas tadā | sarvaṃ vā'kṣatadūrvābhiḥ samantāt vikiret punaḥ || 19.22 astramantreṇa bhūyaś ca mārjayed vāyuvidyayā | kārayitvā kuśair eva mārjanaṃ mūrtipaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 19.23 nirasya mārjanīṃ pāṇiṃ prakṣālya salilaiḥ śubhaiḥ | navapātropanītena prāsādasya samantataḥ || 19.24 lepayed gavyatoyena dīkṣitaiḥ paricārakaiḥ | astrābhimantritais toyais tadgṛhaṃ prokṣayet svayam || 19.25 kuśāgrākṣatadūrvābhir vikiret pañcaśaktibhiḥ | aṣṭākṣareṇa mantreṇa dhūpaṃ sarvatra yojayet || 19.26 dīpaṃ ca tejasā kuryāt dikṣu sarvāsu sādhakaḥ | garbhāgārāntare caivaṃ kṛtvā mudrāṃ prakāśya ca || 19.27 dakṣiṇena bahirdvāraṃ saikate sthaṇḍile guruḥ | agnim ādīpya juhuyāt pañcopaniṣadā ghṛtam || 19.28 sahasraṃ śatakṛtvo vā satataṃ vāstuśāntaye | apāmārgasya samidhaḥ śamyāyāḥ khadirasya ca || 19.29 yakṣarakṣaḥpiśācānāṃ śāntyaitaj juhuyāt punaḥ | mukhamantrais tribhiś cāpi hutvā śeṣaṃ samāpya ca || 19.30 na[ca?] ndanasya rasenāktaṃ gṛhṇīyāt sūtram añjasā | garbhāgārāntare tena diṅmānaṃ vidhinā caret || 19.31 pātayitvā diśāṃ sūtraṃ vidiśāṃ ca sahānugaiḥ | someśānantare sūtraṃ yāmyanair ṛtayoḥ kṣipet || 19.32 biṃbavṛttam avṛttasya pañcaviṃśati bhāgaśaḥ | sūtrayogapadaṃ kramya nirdiśet sthāpanāspadam || 19.33 evam ṛddhikaraṃ prāhuḥ sthāpanāt vaiṣṇavā narāḥ | sūtrayoge tu vāñchanti madhyamāṃ siddhim īpsitām || 19.34 nyūne vā'py adhike vāpi pramāṇe sthāpane kṛte | sthāpana[ka?]sya vināśaḥ syāt yajamānasya cānvaham || 19.35 paścimābhimukhasyāpi devasyā ya mavaḥ kramaḥ | tenaiva sūtrapātena kalpanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || 19.36 kṛtvaivaṃ sthāpanakṣetraṃ biṃbavṛttaṃ pramāya ca | devatānāṃ ca bāhyānāṃ sthāpanāspadam uddiśet || 19.37 devapārśvaṃ tato gatvā datvā puṣpāñjaliṃ pade | pīṭhaṃ brahmaśilāvītiṃ dīkṣitair ānayed gṛham || 19.38 veśmapradakṣiṇaṃ nītvā garbhāgāraṃ ca sarvataḥ | sarvaṃ praveśayet dravyaṃ nānyathā sthāpane[naṃ?] hareḥ || 19.39 svayaṃ pratyaṅmukho bhūtvā tāṃ tu brahmamayīṃ śilām | sthāpanāspadamadhye tu sthāpayet triguṇātmanā || 19.40 tāṃ pūjayitvā gandhādyai ratnabījāni nikṣipet | dikṣu sarvāsu madhye ca garteṣu navasu svayam || 19.41 sthāpakonikṣiped dravyaṃ mantreṇādāya pāṇinā | nikṣipet sarvagarteṣu tejoru[kama] m athāgrataḥ || 19.42 vajraṃ ca padmarāgaṃ ca vaiḍūryaṃ nīlam eva ca | mauktikaṃ puṣparāgaṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ maratakaṃ tathā || 19.43 sphaṭikaṃ cānupūrvyeṇa dikṣu madhye ca nikṣipet | aṣṭākṣaraiś ca varṇais tu samastena ca nikṣipet || 19.44 tālaṃ śilām añjanaṃ ca kāsīsaṃ pātaraṃ[radaṃ?] tathā | saurāṣṭraṃ rocanaṃ cāpi mākṣipaṃ vidrumaṃ tathā || 19.45 vrīhi māṣagavībhiś ca tilān godhūmakān yavān | [tṛṇa?] priyaṅgumudgāś ca nikṣipet pūrvavat kramāt || 19.46 nagartādadhikaṃ dravyaṃ naconaṃ kalpayet kvacit | śilātalapramāṇena nikṣipet kuśalo guruḥ || 19.47 sarvadravyagaṇaṃ madhye kecid āhur vibhūtaye | na ca vai vaiṣṇavaḥ kuryāt pañcarātravicakṣaṇaḥ || 19.48 āraṇyānāṃ ca bījānāṃ nikṣepo na praśasyate | grāmavṛddhis tathā na syāt vanavāsena nikṣipet || 19.49 śilābhir iṣṭakābhir vā kṛtvā pīṭhasya gocaram | sāmyena sthāpayet pīṭhaṃ pīṭhamantrair yathākramam || 19.50 ..ṣa[ana?]ntāstaraṇādīni tatra dhyātvā samantrakam | pūjāvāripathaṃ kṛtvā somadiṅmukhapūrvataḥ || 19.51 arcayitvā ca gandhādyair evaṃ pīṭham avasthitam | chādayitvā'hatair vastrai rakṣāṃ kṛtvā ca sarvataḥ || 19.52 sthāpakas tu bahir gatvā saha bhāgavatair naraiḥ | vighneśasya śivasyāpi pūjeyed āspadaṃ śubham || 19.53 dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi tayoḥ pūrva paścimasaṃsthayoḥ | prāsādadvārasāṃnidhye garuḍasyāpi kalpayet || 19.54 pṛṣṭhabhāge tv anantasya mātṛṇāṃ dakṣiṇena ca | dikpatīnāṃ diśāsv eva sthanāni parikalpayet || 19.55 prākāraveśmanor madhye gandhapuṣpaiś ca pūjayet | someśānāntare kuryād viṣvaksenasya cāspadam || 19.56 prākārasyāvidūreṇa devanirmālyadhāriṇam | prākārasya bahiḥpīṭhaṃ balidānārtham eva ca || 19.57 pūjāpīṭhasamaṃ kuryād devasya purataḥ sthitam | devatānāṃ vidhāyaivaṃ sthānāni susamāhitaḥ || 19.58 devapārśvaṃ samāsādya pūjāṃ kuryād garīyasīm | pūrvaṃ kṛtva'tmani nyāsaṃ paścād deve samācaret || 19.59 tatrainaṃ sakalaṃ kṛtyamantreṇa vāhya pūjayet | akṣatair gandhapuṣpaiś ca dhūpadīpavibhūṣaṇaiḥ || 19.60 bhakṣyabhojyanivedyaiś ca saṃpūjya vidhivad dharim | ahatair vasanaiḥ lakṣaṇaiḥ samantāt pariveṣṭayet || 19.61 tato devasya mahato [purato?] yantram ekaṃ vidhāya ca | dīkṣitair mūrtipair juṣṭāṃ śibikāṃ toraṇānvitām || 19.62 abhyanujñāṃ ca yācitvā yantram āropayed dharim | tataḥ stotrāni saṃkīrtya veśma kuryāt pradakṣiṇam || 19.63 cāmaraiḥ kalaśaiḥ chatrair vitānair dhvajayaṣṭibhiḥ | dīpikabhiś ca dhūpaiś ca śaṅkhadundubhir niḥsvanaiḥ || 19.64 nṛttagītādṛhāsaiś ca viśalaṃ kuryur utsavam | ācāryo vāgyato gacchet yānam ālambya pāṇinā || 19.65 devān eva dhiyā dhyāyed devasya paricārakān | ādityān marutān sādhyān vasūn rudrān ṛbhūṃs tathā || 19.66 aśvināv uragān siddhān grahanakṣatratārakān | evaṃ dhyātvā'pramādena veśma nītva pradakṣiṇam || 19.67 dvāradeśe tu saṃprāpte dadyad arghyaṃ yathāvidhi | pāduke ca nave dadyāt purataḥ sparśavidyayā || 19.68 garbhāgārasya dvāre tu datvārdhyaṃ mantrapūrvakam | ataḥ[antaḥ?] praveśayed devaṃ dīkṣitair vyomavidyayā || 19.69 diṅmātreṇa parikramya devapīṭhaṃ pradakṣiṇam | avatārya śanair yantrasthāpane yatnam ācaret || 19.70 muhurte śobhane prāpte brāhmaṇānām anujñayā | tūryavāditranirdhoṣair dhūpadīpaiś ca saṃkulaiḥ || 19.71 ācāryaḥ purataḥ sthitvā pūrveṇa sthāpayed dharim | pīṭhamadhyagate garte bimbaśaṅkur yathāsthitam || 19.72 ūrdhvalambitasūtreṇa sthitiś cānyasamā yathā | sthāpayitvā tathā devaṃ mudrābhedaṃ pradarśya ca || 19.73 sāmnidhyam arthayed budhyā sarvakālaṃ praṇamya ca | aṣṭākṣareṇa dadyāt tu mālām asmai kṛtāñjaliḥ || 19.74 āsanaṃ pīṭham uddiśya pādyācamanapūrvakam | arghyaṃ datvā vidhānena pradadyān mukhavāsakam || 19.75 cāmare ca vitānaṃ ca dadyāt puṣpāñjaliṃ tathā | tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtyaprītidānāni dāpayet || 19.76 pūjādravyāṇy alaṃkārān vāhanaṃ bhūmim eva ca | prītidānaṃ tu yo dadyāt vaiṣṇave sthāpane kṛte || 19.77 devasya bahusāhasraṃ parajanmani jāyate | tataḥ pracchādya deveśaṃ dukūlakṣaumapaṭṭakaiḥ || 19.78 saṃvṛtya purato dvāraṃ niṣkramya saha dīkṣitaiḥ | ācāryaḥ parivārāṃś ca sthāpayed asya sarvataḥ || 19.79 vainateyam anantaṃ ca pīṭhasthau vaiṣṇavāv ubhau | tāṃ tāṃ pratikṛtiṃ kṛtvā devapādakṛtānanau || 19.80 hastivaktraṃ gaṇapatiṃ liṅgamūrtiṃ ca śaṅkaram | sthāpayed diśi yāmyāyāṃ dakṣiṇābhimukhāv ubhau || 19.81 sarve pīṭhaśilāḥ sthāpyā niścalāḥ sarvataḥ samāḥ | gandhmālāvibhūṣābhiḥ pūjanīyāś ca yatnataḥ || 19.82 vastrair ācchādya sarvāṃś ca prāgādikramam āsthitān | śilābhir iṣṭakābhir vā sthāpayed dikṣu dikpatīn || 19.83 vīrabhadraṃ vighnaṃ ca sthāpayitvāntapārśvayoḥ | sthāpayet paṅktirūpeṇa mātrḥ sapta yathāvidhi || 19.84 abhyarcya balipīṭhaṃ ca śiṣṭā bāhyāś ca devatāḥ | āvāhya manasā'cāryo yajamānaṃ samādiśet || 19.85 vaiṣṇavān paṇḍitāṃś capi prītidānena toṣayet | bhakṣyabhojyānnapānaiś ca sarvam eva mahājanam || 19.86 vāsāṃsi mukhavāsāṃś ca yathotsāhaṃ pradapayet | sarvaṃ parijanaṃ cāpi yatnena paritoṣayet || 19.87 yajamāno'pi tat sarvam evam ācāryacoditam | devabhaktyā ca kurvīta divārātraṃ ca santatam || 19.88 saṃvṛtya sādhako dvāraṃ rakṣāṃ kṛtvā ca puṣpakalām | bahir gatvā'nnapānāni dakṣiṇāṃ ca pradāpayet || 19.89 trirātraṃ devadevasya sthāpitasya navāspade | pūjanaṃ nācared vidvān dakṣiṇā tatra codyate || 19.90 yad dadāti dhanāny eṣaḥ pātrāpātraparīkṣayā | sāmānyenānnapānena tenāsya prīyate hariḥ || 19.91 yas tu rogā bhaviṣyanti bandhūnāṃ ca mahad bhayam || 19.92 tasmād annādya bhuyiṣṭhaṃ dakṣiṇābhir virājitam | sthāpanaṃ kārayed vidvān acyutasya vivṛddhaye || 19.93
iti śrīpāñcarātre paramasaṃhitāyāṃ sthāpanaṃ nāma ekonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
atha viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
brahmā agnikāryavidhiṃ brūhi sarvatra puruṣottama | pūjanena ca saṃbandhaṃ tasyopakaraṇāni ca || 20.1 paramaḥ agnikāryaṃ pravakṣyāmi sāmānyena pitāmaha | dīkṣāyāṃ sthāpane cāpi nityanaimittike tathā || 20.2 ājyapātraṃ carusthālī prokṣaṇīḥ samidhaḥ kuśān | sikatās taṇḍulaṃ toyaṃ darvīparidhayaḥ sruvaḥ || 20.3 aṅgāraṃ vyajanaṃ kūrcaṃ śuṣkakāṣṭhāni mekṣaṇam | gandhapuṣpādi caitasya dravyopakaraṇakramam || 20.4 evaṃ dravyāṇy upānīya vahnisthānasya pārśvataḥ | ārabheta hareḥ pūjāṃ tantramārgeṇa sādhakaḥ || 20.5 devam āvāhya datvā'rghyaṃ mukhavāsaṃ pradāya ca | labdhānujñaḥ parāvṛtya gatvā dakṣiṇato hareḥ || 20.6 ābhimukhyena kurvīta vahneḥ sthānaṃ manoharam | maṇḍalaṃ vahnikuṇḍaṃ tu dīkṣāyāṃ hastasammitam || 20.7 kuryāt sthaṇḍilam anyatra saikataṃ caturaśrakam | astreṇoddhṛtya tāṃ bhūmi śuṣke[ddhena?]ṇa prokṣya vāriṇā || 20.8 vistārya sikatā dikṣu pṛthivyāṃ sarvataḥ samāḥ | ahaṃkārair likhitvā prāk guṇair uttarato likhet || 20.9 pāṇiṃ prakṣālya toyena vahnim ādāya tejasā | datvā pṛthivyāḥ kāṣṭhāni dīpayed vāyuvidyayā || 20.10 samantāc cainam abhyukṣya toyam ādāya pāṇinā | vāsudevādibhir mantraiḥ kuśān dikṣu nidhāpayet || 20.11 agner uttarato hy enaṃ nikṣipya sparśavidyayā | tatra dravyāṇi sarvāṇi dvandvarūpeṇa sādhayet || 20.12 carusthāne ca tatsthālyau darvīṃ ca sruvam eva ca | ājyasthālīṃ samitpuṣpaṃ taṇḍulaṃ mekṣaṇaṃ tathā || 20.13 dvandvarūpāṇi saṃbhṛtya sādhayec camasāṃ pṛthak | kūrcaṃ dakṣiṇato vahner nidadyād brahmavidyayā || 20.14 uttareṇa ca saṃpūrṇaṃ nivṛttayā toyabhājanam | kṛtvā pavitraṃ vikhena [vilikhet] badhvā sāgraṃ kuśadvayam || 20.15 toyapātre jalaṃ siktvā tenotpūya guṇais tribhiḥ | uttānīkṛtya pātrāṇi prokṣayet tena vāriṇā || 20.16 carupātraṃ samādāya taṇḍulān muṣṭinā kṣipet | catur eva tu dharmādyair jalaṃ siktvā ca pāṇinā || 20.17 mantreṇānna[gnāva?]m adhiśritya vījayet vyajanena tu | yantreṇāgnāv adhiśritya vījayet vyajanānilaiḥ | ājyapātre niṣicyājyaṃ sapavitreṇa tejasā || 20.18 nidhāyottarato vahner darbhān ādīpya sparśayet | kuśāgre dve ca tatraiva nikṣipet parameṣṭhinā || 20.19 pradīpya tejasā bhūyo veṣṭayet tad dhavirdvayam | dagdhān api vidhāyāgnau guṇair utpūya tad dhṛtam || 20.20 pavitram agnau visrasya nikṣipya parameṣṭhinā | darvīsruvaṃ kuśāgrāṇi vahnāv ādīpya tejasā || 20.21 sparśamantreṇa saṃmṛjya dhruva[sruca?]m antar bahis tathā | prakṣalya sruvam apy evaṃ darbhān agnau vinikṣipet || 20.22 sruveṇājyaṃ carau siktvā carum udvāsayed udak | tatrāpi kāryavicchedarakṣāṃ kuryāt samaṃtataḥ || 20.23 devapārśvaṃ samāsādya pūjanākramam ācaret | toyaṃ pradāya camasā dantakāṣṭhaṃ samarpayet || 20.24 jalaṃ datvā ca tenaiva gandhamalaka[mālyaka?]m ādiśet | nirmālyamānaṃ dhyātvā ca viṣvaksenāya pārśvataḥ || 20.25 pīṭhād utthāpya deveśaṃ pādukābhyām upāsakaḥ | snānabhūmim upānīya manasā snānam arpayet || 20.26 abhiṣiñced rajaḥ śaktyā dadyāt sparśena kañcukam | tamasāc chādanaṃ dadyād gandhakalkaṃ samaṃtataḥ || 20.27 abhiṣicya tathā bhūyaḥ kalaśair dvādaśāparaiḥ | pañcopaniṣadā śāntiṃ pañcakṛtvaḥ samācaret || 20.28 pādyam ācamanīyaṃ ca datvā sthāpyaṃ pratigrahe | aṣṭābhiḥ kalaśair enam abhiṣicya samaṃtataḥ || 20.29 mūlamantrai stribhiḥ paścāt śāntiṃ kṛtvā catuḥ śatam | vastrair ācchādayet tasya sparśenāṅgāni sarvaśaḥ || 20.30 upavītaṃ tato dadyāt triguṇena trivṛtkṛtam | uttarīyaṃ tataḥ pītaṃ pradadyāt sparśavidyayā || 20.31 pādyādi datvā śirasaḥ snānagandhena yojayet | toyaṃ datvā'ṅgarageṇa dehaṃ tenaiva lepayet || 20.32 vāri datvā nave vastre punar dadyād yathā purā | channavīraṃ tato dadyāt triguṇe naikakāñcanam || 20.33 kuṇḍale karṇamudre ca nīvībandhanam aṅgade | valaye kaṭake cobhe aṅgulīyāni ca kramāt || 20.34 kukṣibandhaṃ gulphabandhaṃ bāhubandhaṃ śikhāmaṇim | uṣṇīṣaṃ ca tato dadyāt laṃbasūtraṃ ca vāsikām || 20.35 kusumāni srajaṃ mālāṃ sarvaṃ rūpasya vidyayā | śrīvatsaṃ kaustubhaṃ cāsya vanamālāṃ ca śāśvatīm || 20.36 tathaiva dadyān manasā śaṅkhacakrādi mudrayā | ādarśaṃ rūpamantreṇa nayan āñjanam eva ca || 20.37 dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca datvā'smai pādyācamanam arpayet | samarpya pāduke cainaṃ pīṭhadeśaṃ samānayet || 20.38 ardhyaṃ dadyād yathānyāyaṃ punar ācamanaṃ tathā | mākṣikāṃ śarkarā sarpiḥ dadhikṣīraṃ ca pañcamam || 20.39 parameṣṭhyādibhir mantrair miśrayitvā samaṃtataḥ | madhuparkaṃ rasenāsmai pāṇibhyāṃ pratipādayet || 20.40 vāri datvā nave pātre kṛtopastarane śucau | caros tribhāgam ādāya siktvā'jyena nivedayet || 20.41 vāri datvā'paraiḥ pātraiḥ bhakṣya bhojyādikaṃ pṛthak | kālapakvaṃ ca tenaiva pūrvavat pratipādayet || 20.42 kiṃcit tūparamet tatra pañca mantrān japan budhaḥ | vāri datvā'paraiḥ pātrair mukhāvāsaṃ samarpayet || 20.43 stotraṃ kṛtvā praṇamyainaṃ diśi kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam | bhītavat pūjayitvaivaṃ rājavat puruṣottamam || 20.44 ājñāṃ ca satvamantreṇa yācitvā'streṇa gopayet | agnipātram upāsādya yācayitvā kramāt punaḥ || 20.45 guṇais triparidhīn nyasya pṛthivyāṃ dakṣiṇottare | gandhapuṣpair alaṃkṛtya dikpatīn dikṣu saṃgatān || 20.46 yugalaiḥ svair namaskārair abhyanujñāpayet dvijān | pañcaviṃśatim ādāya samidhaḥ sarpiṣokṣitāḥ || 20.47 aṣṭākṣareṇa mantreṇa svāhāntena sakṛt kṣipet | ahaṃkārais tribhiḥ kṛtvā pariṣekaṃ guṇena ca || 20.48 tasmin ratnau[nnagnau?]pradīpte ca dhyātvā padmaṃ sakarṇikam | pūrvoditena mārgeṇa devam āvāhayet param || 20.49 ardhyaṃ pradāya manasā sruveṇa juhuyād ghṛtam | pīṭhamantraiḥ krameṇaiva svāhākārasamanvitaiḥ || 20.50 tato darvyām upastirya caroḥ piṇḍaṃ nidhāya ca | abhidhāryā tha mantreṇa juhuyād avikampitam || 20.51 sruvāhutīś ca tenaiva juhuyāt dvādaśa kramāt | vāsudevena cāpy evam aṣṭāv aṣṭākṣareṇa ca || 20.52 punas tu darvyā juhuyāc caroḥ piṇḍaṃ ghṛtānvitam | rudramantreṇa darvīṃ tu prakṣālya visṛjet punaḥ || 20.53 ekāṃ samīdham ādāya sruveṇa juhuyād ghṛtam | mūrtiśaktyādibhir mantrair lokapālāvasānikaiḥ || 20.54 prāyaścittani juhuyāt pañcopaniṣadā punaḥ | pañcakṛtvas tad antena ghṛtadhārāṃ nidhāpayet || 20.55 agnikāryam idaṃ vidvān brāhmaṇaḥ kartum arhati | kṣatriyo vā guṇair yukto vaiśyo vā'pi bahuśrutaḥ || 20.56 nāgnikāryaṃ prayuñjīta śūdro vidvān api kvacit | dīkṣitaḥ paṇḍito vidvān kāmamanyena kārayet || 20.57 brāhmaṇo'pi durācāraḥ kṣatriyo'pi tathāvidhaḥ | agnikāryaṃ prayuñjānaḥ prāpnoti paramāpadam || 20.58 naimittikeṣu kāmyeṣu dīkṣāsu sthāpaneṣu ca | agnikāryaṃ prayuñjīta nānyatra yadi na prabhuḥ || 20.59 parihomeṣu sarveṣām ayam eva vidhir mataḥ | dikpatīnāṃ tu juhuyān nāmabhiḥ svair ghṛtāhutīḥ || 20.60 dīkṣitā eva juhuyuḥ parihomaṃ dvijottamāḥ | ācāryapadam ārūḍhā dakṣiṇābhiś ca toṣitāḥ || 20.61 ācāryeṇa niyoktavyās ta eva paricārakāḥ | dīkṣāyāṃ sthāpane cāpi nānye tantreṣu dūṣaṇāt || 20.62 aniśaṃ vidhinā kurvann agnikāryam upāsakaḥ | vināśayati pāpāni siddhim aṣṭau ca gacchati || 20.63
iti śrīpāñcarātre paramasaṃhitāyāṃ agnikāryaṃ nāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
athaikaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
brahmā sthāpitasya mukundasya trirātraṃ kiṃ vidhīyate | tadante ca kathaṃ pūjā kartavyā tāṃ bravīhi me || 21.1 paramaḥ sthāpayitvā tathā devaṃ parihomaṃ vidhāya ca | annapānadhanādīni pradadyāt sa ca[dadyād utsava?] pūrvakam || 21.2 bahiś ca vikired annaṃ sarvebhyaḥ sarvasandhiṣu | trirātrāpagame yatnaṃ snapanāya samācaret || 21.3 ubhayor dvārayor madhye vediṃ kuryāc catuṣkarīm | sarvatra sikatākīrṇāṃ vitānenopaśobhitām || 21.4 tasyāṃ kuṃbhān prati dravyam ācāryaḥ sādhayen navān | sauvarṇān rājatān tāmrān mṛṇmayān vā vibhūṣitān || 21.5 vedyāṃ vastrāṇi vistīrya teṣu pātrāṇi sādhayet | sādayitvā pavitreṇa toyam utpūya tān punaḥ || 21.6 uttānān prokṣayet kuṃbhān trir eva parameṣṭhinā | tatas tu dravyaiḥ snapanair vastrapūtaiḥ parīkṣitaiḥ || 21.7 ācāryaḥ pūrayet sarvān āvāhyāvāhya mūrtipaiḥ | pañcādau pañcagavyena pañcopaniṣadā kramāt || 21.8 sarvair ekaṃ punaḥ kumbhaṃ kuśatoyena cāparam | madhu tailekṣutoyaiś ca garbhabhedaiḥ prapūrayet || 21.9 kṣetratīrthāc ca śailebhyaḥ sūkarākhubilāt tathā | valmīkād vṛṣaśṛṅgāc ca mṛdam ādāya pūrayet || 21.10 pūrayitvā'tha tān kuṃbhān pūrayet puṣpapallavaiḥ | gandhai ratnaiś ca mālyaiś ca yathāvibhavam eva vā || 21.11 pūjādravyāṇi sarvāṇi śodhanāny upapādayet | veder anyatrayuktābhir dī[ni dī?] kṣitaiḥ paricārakaiḥ || 21.12 garbhāgaram atha prāpya dvāram utpāṭya vāyunā | ācchādanādi devasya viśvenāpanayed bahiḥ || 21.13 visṛjya devaṃ prathamaṃ nairmālyam apanīya ca | ācāryaḥ snāpayed dravyam āvāhayāvāhya dīkṣitaiḥ || 21.14 snapanāyopakḷptāni yāni vedyāṃ kramāt purā | uddhṛtya tāni snapayet devabiṃba viśuddhaye || 21.15 prathamaṃ pañcagavyena pañcopaniṣadā kramāt | ma[dhvā?] dhyādibhir guṇaiḥ paścād vanaspatirasadvayaiḥ || 21.16 gandhamātrādikāḥ pañca mano'haṃkārabuddhayaḥ | aṣṭakānāṃ ghṛ[smṛ?]tā mantrā ṣaṭkānāṃ ca ṣaḍādikāḥ || 21.17 [sātvikādi] trayā garvā guṇā vā parikīrtitāḥ | sarva dravya samūhasya pañcopaniṣadaḥ smṛtāḥ || 21.18 snāpayitvā'lpaśaḥ pūrvaṃ devam āvāhya mantravit | bhūyas tu snapanadravyaiḥ sarvair evābhiṣecayet || 21.19 śāntiṃ tīrthodakaiḥ kuryāt gandhapuṣpāmbubhis tathā | ratnatoyena cāpy ante śāntiṃ kuryād garīyasīm || 21.20 ebhir eva balaṃ[jala?] dravyaiḥ snāpayed aṅgadevatāḥ | evaṃ tu snapanaṃ kṛtvā pūjāmārgaṃ yathā purā || 21.21 ācāryaḥ sakalaṃ kuryād agnikāryeṇa saṃyutam | bhūtānāṃ balidānārthaṃ havir anyaṃ tu pācayet || 21.22 laukikāgnau vinā mantrais tena bāhyabaliḥ smṛtaḥ | agnikāryeṇa saṃyuktaṃ pūjādravyair manoharaiḥ || 21.23 ārādhanaṃ prayuñjīta yathāvibhavakalpitam | bhakṣyabhojyanivedyādi gandhapuṣpādikāni ca || 21.24 ujvalāni prayuñjīta snapane parameṣṭhinaḥ | tasyāvasāne kurvīta balidānaṃ vidhānataḥ || 21.25 kāñcanaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ pātram ādāya maṇḍalam | sāditaṃ prokṣitaṃ vedyāṃ sapavitreṇa vāriṇā || 21.26 kṛtvā tasmin dvitīyena kurvīta haviṣāsanam | tasmin niṣṭhāpayed biṃbaṃ devasya parameṣṭhinaḥ || 21.27 alābhe[ācāryaḥ?] kāñcanaṃ śuddhe ratnaṃ rajatam eva vā | gandhapuṣpādibhis tasya pūjāṃ kṛtvā manoramām || 21.28 dīkṣitasya tu tat pātraṃ śirasi sthāpayed guruḥ | pūrayed apare pātre haviḥ śeṣaṃ jalaplutam || 21.29 dhūpamuṣṭiṃ dhvajaṃ chatraṃ gṛhṇīyur apare tathā | śaṅkhadundubhighoṣeṇa garbhagehaṃ pradakṣiṇam || 21.30 prakramya devatāsthāne pāṇinā vikired balim | prāsādasya bahiś caiva prākārasya bahis tathā || 21.31 evam evaṃ parikramya balipīṭhaṃ pradakṣiṇam | bhūtebhyo nama ity eva tasmiṃś ca vikired balim || 21.32 punaḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā garbhāgāraṃ praviśya ca | pūjāpīṭhaikadeśe tu tadbiṃbam upapādayet || 21.33 anena balidānena pūjayed bāhyadevatāḥ | trisandhyam ekasandhyaṃ vā na tv idaṃ vyatipādayet || 21.34 sthāpitasya harer yatra balidānaṃ vihanyate | tatra sthāne na bhuñjīta vaiṣṇave saṃbhave sati || 21.35 balidānasya ye vighnaṃ kurvanti puruṣādhamāḥ | govadhena samānaṃte labhante pāpasañcayam || 21.36 sthāpitasya tu devasya balidānāntam arcanam | nopahanyād yathāśakti snapanaṃ tu nimittataḥ || 21.37 sthāpitasya caturthe'hni dvādaśyāṃ vipuvad dine | yātrānte rāhuyoge ca durnimittodaye tathā || 21.38 prāpte janapadavyādhau durbhikṣe śatrupīḍane | utsave cārdha vṛttau ca [tha vṛddhau tu?] ciralupte ca pūjane || 21.39 corapātakicaṇḍālakutsitasparśaneṣu ca | prāsādasthasya maraṇe duryaśaḥ sā bhavet tathā[saṃbhave tathā?] || 21.40 evam ādiṣu cānyeṣu nimitteṣu yathāyatham | snapanaṃ devadevasya kārayed vidhipūrvakam || 21.41 sarvaśāntikaraṃ hy etat sarvapāpapraṇāśanam | snapanaṃ padmanābhasya kartavyaṃ kuśalārthibhiḥ || 21.42 pātravastrādikaṃ sarvam ācāryāya samarpayet | yathā saṃbhavam anyac ca vaiṣṇavebhyaś ca dakṣiṇe[ṇām] || 21.43 caturthād divasād ūrdhvaṃ nityam ārādhayed dharim | agnikāryaṃ ca kurvīta [balidānaṃ ca deśikaḥ] || 21.44 yatra sthāne harir nityaṃ viṣṇubhaktair upāsyate | tatra naivopagacchanti piśācagraharākṣasāḥ || 21.45 yatropakaraṇaiḥ śuddhair nityam ārādhyate hariḥ | sukumārāḥ prajās tatra jāyante rogavarjitāḥ || 21.46 vyādhitā ye prapadyante tatsthānaṃ vaiṣṇavā narāḥ | te'pi rogād vimucyante labhante bheṣajān iva || 21.47 prāsāde sthāpitaṃ devaṃ sarvadā na prakāśayet | anyatrārcanavelāyā nahi tat prīyate hariḥ || 21.48 aśucidravyasaṃsargaṃ janasaṃsargam eva ca[vā?] | prāsāde varjayed viṣṇor lokopakaraṇāni ca || 21.49 nityam ārādhya saṃrakṣet pūjādravyāṇi vaiṣṇavaḥ | prāsādadvāramāvṛtya nirgacched icchayā bahiḥ || 21.50 sa evaṃ sthāpayed viṣṇuṃ prāsāde vidhipūrvakam | vargāt prāk cyavate nāsau yāvattaṃ nāpi naśyati || 21.51 kartāro yadi bhūyāṃsaḥ prāsādasya syur añjasā | [kāryāṇām api] bāhulyāt tatrāpi phalam edhate || 21.52 etat te sarvam ākhyātaṃ sthāpanaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ | ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi yātrām asya pitāmaha || 21.53
iti śrīpāñcarātre paramasaṃhitāyāṃ snapanaṃ nāma ekaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
atha dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
paramaḥ sthāpitasyāpi devasya yātrāvidhim ataḥ param | śruṇu brahman yathānyāyaṃ nimittaṃ śakunānvitam || 22.1 dviprakārā smṛtā yātrā devasya kamalodbhava | ādyā tīrthābhiṣekārthā dvitīyā vāstusiddhaye || 22.2 sthāpitaḥ puṇḍarikākṣaḥ prāsāde vaiṣṇavair naraiḥ | tīrthasnānāya netavyaḥ saṃbhaved yatra nimnagā || 22.3 sthāpitopy utsavān prāpya tīrthe snātvā gṛhaṃgataḥ | prasīdati parodevo nānyathā padmasaṃbhava || 22.4 jalādhivāsād ārabhya yajño'yaṃ vidhicoditaḥ | vijñeyo vaiṣṇavo nāma tīrthayātrāvasānikaḥ || 22.5 tatrādāv eva kurvīta nṛttagītasamanvitam | utsavaṃ dvādaśāhāni kāmam ūrdhvaṃ tu kārayet || 22.6 upaśrutir u[m u?]paśrutya śakunāny upalakṣya ca | nimittāni viditvā ca yātrāraṃbhaṃ prayojayet || 22.7 tithinakṣatrahirāś ca labhyante sadguṇā yadā | yajamānānulomye[kūlye]na diṅmukhasya ca sarvataḥ || 22.8 yadaitāni śubhāny eva saṃbhavanti kadācana | tadā yātrāṃ prayuñjīta vidhimārgeṇa śārṅgiṇaḥ || 22.9 yasmin japati[bhavati] nakṣatre sarvam etad guṇānvitam | tasya kurvīta pūrvedyur utsavaṃ bahuvistaram || 22.10 chattrair dhvajapaṭaiḥ śubhraiḥ ketuyaṣṭiśirodhṛtaiḥ | toraṇair dīpikāstaṃbhair diṅmukhāni vibhūṣayet || 22.11 sarvāsāṃ devatānāṃ ca tasmin sthāne viśeṣataḥ | kārayen mahatīṃ pūjāṃ carubhir balibhis tathā || 22.12 tatra sāyaṃ prakurvīta grāmānte ca mahābalim | śaṅkhadundubhir nirghoṣair mahājana puraskṛtam || 22.13 bhakṣyabhojyānnapānāni vikiret sarvavartmasu | ārāmeṣu vanānteṣu devatāyataneṣu ca || 22.14 evaṃ mahābaliṃ datvā kṛtvā rātrau mahotsavam | ācāryaḥ prātar utthāya snātvā devaṃ samarcayet || 22.15 tasyāvasāne devasya yātrārthaṃ biṃbam ānayet | kāñcanaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ na tv anyattatra codyate || 22.16 śaṅkhacakrasamāyuktam alpakāyaṃ manoramam | rathaṃ vā kuñjaraṃ vā'sya yātrāvahanam ānayet || 22.17 nānā vāditrakuśalān bahūṃś ca paricārakān | chatradhvajavitānāṃś ca bherīpaṭahatālakān || 22.18 śilpinaḥ sevakāṃś cāpi gaṇikā devadāsikāḥ | evam etat samānīya muhūrte śobhane guruḥ || 22.19 śiṣyaiś caturbhiḥ saṃyuktaḥ prāptānujño dvijottamaiḥ | devaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya praṇipatya puraḥsthitam || 22.20 tīrthayātrāṃ kuruṣveti kāryaṃ vijñāpayec chanaiḥ | tataḥ saṃhṛtya tadbiṃbam utpādya vidhipūrvakam || 22.21 tasminn āvahayed devaṃ pūjākāle yathoditam | āvāhitam anusmṛtya datvā'rdhyaṃ vidhipūrvakam || 22.22 chādayed aṃśukenaiva mahatena daśāvatā | dakṣiṇena tam ādāya pāṇinā vāgyataḥ svayam || 22.23 śiṣyaiḥ parivṛto gacched garbhāgārādbahiḥ punaḥ | udapātraṃ vahed ekaṃ chatram ekaḥ samucchritam || 22.24 yāgopakaraṇāny eko havir ekaś ca dhārayet | bahir niṣkramya ghoṣeṇa mahatāvāgyataḥ svayam || 22.25 sannidhānaṃ samāsādya kuñjarasya rathasya vā | garuḍaṃ vāhayitvainam āroheyur anākulāḥ || 22.26 tatra te vāgyatāḥ sarve sottarīyāḥ svalaṃkṛtāḥ | mahājanena saṃvītā gaccheyur yatra nimnagāḥ || 22.27 diṅmantreṇa bahir grāmaṃ kṛtvā pūrvaṃ pradakṣiṇam | nirgacched yojanā darvā gata ūrdhvaṃ tu varjayet || 22.28 antarāle mahāghoṣa gīta nṛtta praṇāditaiḥ | vāhanair vividhaiś cāpi kurvīran devatuṣṭaye || 22.29 tīrthapārśvaṃ samāsādya vediṃ pūrvaṃ tu kārayet | vāhanād avatāryainaṃ tasyām eva niveśayet || 22.30 haviś ca śra[dā?]payet tatra pāyasaṃ vijane kvacit | pādyam ācamanaṃ cāsmai datvā'rdhyaṃ pratipādya ca || 22.31 sarveṇādāya mātaṅgam āropya saritaṃ nayet | vārimantreṇa tīrthāni tatrāvāhya samaṃtataḥ || 22.32 parameṣṭhyātmanā majjet taṃ gṛhītvā trir aṃbhasi | nivṛtya vedyāṃ dadyāc ca pādyam ācamanaṃ tathā || 22.33 prokṣayet pañcabhir mantraiḥ kuśapāṇiḥ samāhitaḥ | punar apy enam ādāya toye kṛtvā'ghamarṣaṇam[ṇān?] || 22.34 mahājanaiḥ sahas nāyāt brāhmaṇānāṃ tu vaṅnayān[vāñchayā] | uttīrya devam ānīya gandhapuṣpaiḥ samarcayet || 22.35 pādyam arghyaṃ nivedyaṃ ca datvā'smai vidhipūrvakam | tasmād ante tam ādāya pūrvavad vāhanaṃ nayet || 22.36 tam āruhya yathā pūrvaṃ nivartetāvilambitam | yātrādivasa evainaṃ prāsādaṃ harim ānayet || 22.37 anyathā hi mahān doṣo kartrṇāṃ bhavati dhruvam | āgatya pūrvavad ga[t kṛ]tvā gatvā garbhagṛhāntare || 22.38 mūlabimbe paraṃ devaṃ sarveṇa pratiropayet | gandhapuṣpodakair devaṃ budhyāvāhya samantrakam || 22.39 snāpayet tena tadbiṃbaṃ yātrābhāvaṃ [dāvantata]tatas tataḥ | alaṃ[evaṃ]kṛtvā samārādhya datvā'rdhyaṃ praṇipalya ca || 22.40 garbhāgāraṃ samāvṛtya svecchayā niṣpated bahiḥ | bhakṣyabhojyānnapānaiś ca brāhmaṇāṃs tarpayed bahiḥ || 22.41 āśiṣo vācayed viprair annadānena toṣitaiḥ | ācāryāya saśiṣyāya datvā tatraiva dakṣiṇaṃ || 22.42 visṛjed evam ākhyātaṃ tīrthasnānaṃ mayā tava | dvitīyām api te yātrāṃ kathayiṣyāmi śārṅgiṇaḥ || 22.43 yasyāṃ nimittam uddiṣṭaṃ vāstunirmāṇamāditaḥ | prāsāde śithile bhagne garbhāgāre'pi vā hareḥ || 22.44 chinne jīrṇe'pivā bimbe yātrāṃ devasya kārayet | prāg udag vā gṛhaṃ kṛtvā kāṣṭhair abhinavaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 22.45 pretya dvāraṃ su saṃguptaṃ caturaśraṃ manoramam | pīṭhaṃ kāṣṭhamayaṃ tasya madhyadeśe nidhāpayet || 22.46 tasmin lohamayaṃ biṃbam alpakāyaṃ caturbhujam | citraṃ kṛtvā samāsthāya niścalaṃ kārayet punaḥ || 22.47 atha puṇye'hani prāpte pūjayitvā dvijottamān | puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā ca śāntiṃ kṛtvā viśuddhaye || 22.48 ādadīta mahatpātraṃ sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tathā | tāmraṃ vā tatra nikṣipya hemaratnāni śaktitaḥ || 22.49 gandhapuṣpākṣatādīni pavitrāṇi ca sarvataḥ | śuddhena vāriṇā pūrvaṃ kṛtvā'laṃkṛtya sarvataḥ || 22.50 devasyārādhanaṃ kuryād yatnena mahatā punaḥ | tasyāvasāne nirgacched ācāryo bhavanaṃ navam || 22.51 sarvatas tad alaṃkṛtya gandha puṣpāṅkurādibhiḥ | antaḥ praviśya kurvīta śārīraṃ dhyānam ātmanaḥ || 22.52 tatra yogamayaṃ pīṭhaṃ dhyātvā biṃbaṃ ca pūrvavat | arvāg āvāhanaṃ kṛtvā rakṣāṃ kṛtvā bahir vrajet || 22.53 prāsāda dvāram āsādya praṣṭavyās tasya kārakāḥ | kiyantaṃ kālam etasminn alpagehe janārdanaḥ || 22.54 kliṣṭavāse nivasati krodhaṃ necchet tathā budhaḥ | tato'rvāg api nirdeśyaḥ tasmāt kālo'pi tair naraiḥ || 22.55 māsādūrdhvaṃ tu nirdeśya tato'rvāg i[ti?] neṣyate | atha taṃ pātram ādāya garbhāgāraṃ praviśya ca || 22.56 tasminn āvāhayed devaṃ sarveṇa puruṣottamam | tair uktaṃ manasā dhyātvā kālanirdeśamañjasā || 22.57 tat pātraṃ mūrdhni vinyasya śaṅkhadundubhi niḥsvanaiḥ | pradakṣiṇaṃ parikramya gacched abhinavaṃ gṛham || 22.58 tac ca pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā gacched antaḥ samāhitaḥ | brāhmaṇān apy anujñāpya kālam uktvā puroditam || 22.59 pañcopaniṣadān[dā?] dhyātvā sarveṇa dhyāyayed dharim | sannidhyam arthayitvā ca pādyadānāni pūrvavat || 22.60 kurvīta sakalaṃ mantrair agnikāryasamanvitam | tasyāvasāne sarveṣām annapānāni dāpayet || 22.61 dakṣiṇāṃ ca yathāśakti vācayed āśiṣas tathā | ratnadhātunidhānādi nātra kurvīta mantravit || 22.62 sthāpanaṃ mukhyam eva syāt yat kṛtaṃ tena vartmanā | tasmān nidhānarahitaṃ kṣudropakaraṇānvitam || 22.63 kleśavāsam iva prāptaṃ kalpayet kāryasiddhaye | prāsāde garbhagehe vā punar utpādite śubhe || 22.64 udapātre tathaivainam āvāhya sthāpayet punaḥ |
