pratimāyāṃ tu naṣṭāyāṃ brāhmaṇānām anujñayā || 22.65 ācāryaḥ prāṅmukho bhūtvā viṣvaksenamanāḥ svayam | gatvā tūtthāpayed biṃbaṃ paricārakasaṃvṛtam || 22.66 svayam eva tu gṛhṇīyān mūlaratnāni sarvaśaḥ | yānam āropya tad biṃbaṃ nītvā saha jalāśaye || 22.67 tasya madhyetu visṛjed viṣvaksenam anu smaran | kārayitvā navām anyāṃ pratimāṃ lakṣaṇānvitām || 22.68 jalādhivāsanādy eva tantracoditam ācaret | biṃbaṃ saṃskāram ācāryaḥ sarvam āvāhanād vinā || 22.69 kṛtvā pīṭhaṃ ca kurvīta ratnadhātunidhāpanaiḥ | tatra biṃbaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya niścalaṃ kārayet punaḥ || 22.70 yogapīṭhaṃ tato dhyātvā devavigraham eva ca | bāhyāgārāt tato devam udapātre samāhvayet || 22.71 muhūrte śobhane prāpte tad biṃbaṃ na tu śodhayet | anaṣṭe mūlabiṃbe tu vāstu nirmāya sarvataḥ || 22.72 pañcagavyādibhir dravyaiḥ kṣālayitvā samaṃtataḥ | tasminn evodapātre tu devam āhūya yojayet || 22.73 biṃbānāṃ bhagnajīrṇānāṃ dūṣitānāṃ ca kaśmalaiḥ | udvāsanaṃ prayuñjīta nānyathā bimbam uddharet || 22.74 ity evaṃ dviḥ prakārāpi yātrā devasya kīrtitā | ānupūrvyeṇa te brahman kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotum icchasi || 22.75
iti śrīpāñcarātre paramasaṃhitāyāṃ yātrā nāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
atha trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
brahmā bimbānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ brūhi pramāṇaiḥ sakalaiḥ saha | aṅgapratyaṅgavinyāsaṃ pīṭha lakṣaṇasaṃyutam || 23.1 paramaḥ suvarṇādīni bimbasya dravyāṇi kathitāni te | śodhayitvā'gratas tāni śilpibhiḥ kārayed dṛḍham || 23.2 drāvayitvā sakṛtsiktaṃ(kthaṃ?) suvarṇaṃ sarvato dhanam | devabimbam upādeyam anyathā na śubhāv aham || 23.3 khadiraḥ panasaś cāpi madhūkaś candanaṃ tathā | saralo devadāruś ca jātīkāṣṭhās tathā'sanaḥ || 23.4 timiśaś candanaś ceti praśastā vṛkṣajātayaḥ | ṛjusnigdhasamākārā na śikhā nirvṛṇā ghanāḥ || 23.5 paripakvā navā śuṣkā vṛkṣachedāḥ śubhāvahāḥ | supraśaste śucau deśe khanitvā bhūmim uddhṛtā || 23.6 śītalā tu śilāgrāhyā duṣṭalakṣaṇa varjitā | iṣṭvā[duṣṭā?] garbhavatī jñeyā bhidyate śithiladhvaniḥ || 23.7 maṇḍalaiś ca tridhā hy eva nānāvarṇā ca kīrtyate | kākagṛdhrakapiśvānasarpavṛścikamūṣikāḥ || 23.8 yadi cihnena lakṣyante talāyāṃ sā na śobhanam | anyena dūṣitā bhāvāt lakṣyante yadi kutra cit || 23.9 aṣṭagarbhā tu sā jñeyā kulakṣayakarī śilā | śaṅkhacakragadāpadmachatratoraṇavāraṇāḥ || 23.10 siṃhasūkarasāraṅgaśrīvatsāṅkuśakuṇḍikāḥ | dṛśyante yadi pāṣāṇe tad bhaviṣyati śobhane[naḥ?] || 23.11 anyāni ca śubhāny eva aśubhāny aśubhāni ca | śilāyāṃ kṣālitāyāṃ tu yadi kiṃcin na labhyate || 23.12 madhyamā sā śilā jñeyā sarvatra suṣa[sa?]mā ghanā | rūpato yadi lakṣyante tilataṇḍulavālukāḥ || 23.13 na ca rekhāpradeśeṣu vijñeyā sā'pi madhyamā | śilpīnāṃ ca pramādena vātātapavaśena ca || 23.14 śilākāṣṭhāni bālūkādāruṇair api tāḍanaiḥ | gandhe varṇe tathā sparśe śabde ca yadi kiṃcana || 23.15 lakṣyante na kvacid draṣṭuṃ sarva varṇeṣu sā śubhā | mṛttikāpy evam eva syād uktakarma yathā bhavet || 23.16 akutsitād āyatanād uddhṛtā sā tu śobhanā | evam ebhiḥ śubhair dravyai rūpaṃ devasya yat kṛtam || 23.17 tantre yaṃ bimbam arcati beraṃ ca pratimeti ca | prāsāde bhavane cāpi pramāṇaṃ tasya bhidyate || 23.18 jaṅgamasyāpi sarvasya citre lekhārpitasya ca | pramāṇaṃ trividhaṃ proktaṃ tasya śāstre pitāmaha || 23.19 ūrdhvaṃ tiryak samantāc ca tad biṃbaṃ yena mīyate | unmānaṃ prathamaṃ proktaṃ vimānaṃ tad anantaram || 23.20 tṛtīyaṃ parimāṇaṃ tu śāstre'smin kamalodbhava | tribhir etaiḥ pramāṇais tu yat paricchinnamañjasā || 23.21 tac citram iti vijñeyaṃ pūjanīyaṃ ca paṇḍitaiḥ | parimāṇārdha niṣpannam acitraṃ vandyam iṣyate || 23.22 citrābhāsam iti prāhuḥ parimāṇa vivarjitam | bhaktānāṃ darśanārthāya kriyate yan manoramam || 23.23 varṇakaiḥ paṭakuḍyādau tad āhur bhaktivardhanām | vardhanāṃ arbhakāṇāṃ ca strīṇāṃ ca hṛdayaṃ gamam || 23.24 acitraṃ sthāpayet kṛtvā kāṣṭhena śilayāpi vā | prāsāde sthāpayec citraṃ bhavane vā vibhūtaye || 23.25 jaṅgamaṃ vā 'rcayen nityam āvāhya ca visṛjya ca | vātāyanapathaṃ gatvā ye bhānti ravir aśmayaḥ || 23.26 tatra sūkṣmaṃ visarpanto reṇavaḥ paramāṇavaḥ | paramāṇvaṣṭakaṃ keśo likhyā keśāṣṭakaṃ bhavet || 23.27 likhyāṣṭakaṃ bhaved yūkā tathā yūkāṣṭakaṃ yavā | aṅgulaṃ prāhur aṣṭābhir yavaiḥ pramitamañjasā || 23.28 tālaṃ vitastim apy āhur dvādaśaṅgulasammitam | tāle dve hastam icchanti pañcahastaṃ tu pūruṣam || 23.29 pañcahasta pramāṇāt tu nāyi[dhi?]kaṃ biṃbam iṣyate | ekahastān na ca nyūnaṃ prāsāde sthāpyate hi me || 23.30 bhavane sthāpyamānaṃ tu naikahastāt paraṃ bhavet | vindhyāyāṃ ca..... || 23.31 śarīranyāsakāle ca namaskāre ca tarpaṇe | maunaṃ kuryāt prayatnena nāpnoti phalam anyathā || 23.32 [sauvarṇo rājatas tāmro khādirovā sruvo bhavet | ādyam aiśvaryasidhyarthaṃ rājataṃ kīrtivardhanam || 23.33 tāmraṃ śāntikaraṃ proktaṃ khādiraṃ vasuvardhanam | dvādaśāṅgulamāyāmaṃ mūlaviṣkaṃbhamadguṇam[ṅgulam?] || 23.34 viṣkaṃbhāt dviguṇaṃ vṛttaṃ viṣkaṃbhasya dalaṃ guṇe [gale] | yavamānāv ubhau gartau garte vṛttau pṛthak pṛthak || 23.35 viṣkaṃbhāt pādahīnaṃ syād garbhasīmāya vā dalam | gopuccha sadṛśaṃ daṇḍaṃ nāsikāpuṭavat puṭam || 23.36 sruvasya kārayed vidvān srucaṃ ca samam āyatam | viṣkaṃbhāt triguṇaṃ vṛttaṃ viṣkaṃbhāt dviguṇaṃ galam || 23.37 bhāgān kuryāt punaḥ pañca dvibhāgaṃ cānanaṃ bhavet | daṇḍamānaṃ bhavec cheṣaṃ gartavṛttaṃ mukhād dalam || 23.38 ubhoṣṭha sadṛśaṃ tv agryam ājyamārgaṃ ca kārayet | yavamānaṃ bhaven mūlaṃ yavārdhaṃ cāgramiṣyate || 23.39 bhojanādiṣu sarveṣu dadyād agryam atīndriyaḥ | abhidhāryābhimṛśyā'pi mantram aṣṭākṣaraṃ japet || 23.40 uktvā paramahaṃsaṃ ca śuddhabhūmau nidhāpayet | dadyāc cheṣaṃ[devaṃ?] vidhānena tena naśyanti[ti] kilbiṣam || 23.41 upasthāya rasenānnam abhimṛśya tathāṃbhasā | vāyumantrais tu bhuñjīta pañca prāṇāhutīr budhaḥ || 23.42 prāṇāpānas tathā vyānaudānaṃ ca samānavān | vāyumantreṇa vijñeyā pañca mantrā svanāmabhiḥ || 23.43 bhuktvā toyaṃ pibet tena hastaśuddhiṃ ca kārayet | arcayitvā paraṃ devaṃ nityam avyagrayā dhiyā || 23.44 stutikāle tu saṃprāpte stotram etad udāharet || 45 jitaṃ te puṇḍarīkākṣa namas te viśvabhāvana | namaste'stu hṛṣīkeśa mahāpuruṣa pūrvaja || 23.46 devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca sāmānyam adhidaivatam | sarvadā caraṇadvandvaṃ vrajāmi śaraṇaṃ tava || 23.47 ekas tvam asi lokasya sraṣṭā saṃhārakas tathā | adhyakṣā cānumantā ca guṇamāyā samāvṛtaḥ || 23.48 saṃsāra sāgaraṃ ghoram anantakleśabhājanam | tvām eva śaraṇaṃ prāpya nistaranti manīṣiṇaḥ || ] [manasvinaḥ || ] 23.49 [itaḥ prabhṛti granthapātānto bhāgaḥ ekonatriṃśe adhyāye karmaśeṣaprakaraṇe paridṛśyate bimbalakṣaṇādhyāye asya anaucityam iva bhāti ataḥ tatraiva draṣṭavyaḥ |] na te rūpaṃ nacākāro nāyudhāni na cāspadam | tathāpi puruṣākāro bhaktānāṃ tvaṃ prakāśase || 23.50 naiva kiṃcit parokṣaṃ te pratyakṣo'pi na kasya cit | naiva kiṃcid asiddhaṃ te na ca siddho'si kasyacit || 23.51 kāryāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ pūrvaṃ vacasāṃ vāca[cya?]m uttamam | yogināṃ paramāsiddhir na paraṃ te paraṃ viduḥ || 23.52 ahaṃ bhīto'smi deveśa saṃsāre'smin bhayāvahe | pāhi māṃ puṇḍarīkākṣa na jāne śaraṇaṃ param || 23.53 kāleṣv api ca sarveṣu dikṣu sarvāsu vā'cyuta | śarīre ca gatau cāpi vardhate me mahadbhayam || 23.54 tvatpādakamalād anyaṃ na me janmāntareṣv api | nimittaṃ kuśalasyāsti yena gacchāmi sadgatim || 23.55 vijñānaṃ yad idaṃ prāptaṃ yad idaṃ sthānamārjitam | janmāntare'pi me deva mābhūdasya parikṣayaḥ || 23.56 durgatāv api jātāyāṃ tvadgato me manorathaḥ | yadi nāśaṃ na vindeta tāvatā'smi kṛtī sadā || 23.57 na kāma kaluṣaṃ cittaṃ mama te pādayoḥ sthitam | kāmaye vaiṣṇavatvaṃ tu sarvajanmasu kevalam || 23.58 ity eva manayāstutyā stutvā devaṃ divaṃ dine dine | kiṃkaro'smīti cātmānaṃ devāyaivaṃ nivedayet || 23.59 pūjādravyāv aśeṣeṇa pūjayed ātmanas tanum | pūjāpīṭhopakaṇṭhe tu svayam āsīta viṣṭare || 23.60 yathā narāṇām utkṛṣṭaṃ yathā vā paramaṃ gurum | ārādhayati yatnena tathā devaṃ ta[sa?]m arcayet || 23.61 agnikārye tu homasya trīṇi dravyāṇi padmaja | samidho havir ājyaṃ ca tair nityaṃ homam ācaret || 23.62 puṣpāṇi lokapālānāṃ diśāsu vidiśāsu ca | pūjā dravyāṇi yojyāni sarvadā homam ācaret || 23.63 kāmye naimittike cāpi pakvahomo vidhīyate | ataḥ paraṃ granthapātaḥ
iti śrī pāñcarātre paramasaṃhitāyāṃ bimbalakṣaṇaṃ nāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ |
atha caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
nidrayā pīḍyate yad vā garvaṃ vā pratipadyate | yathaita..ṇa yātreṇa sidhyatībhīpsitaṃ mama || 24.1 svecchayā kṛtam apy evaṃ hantuṃ śaknoti kilbiṣam | evaṃ cintayatas tasya nādharme vartate matiḥ || 24.2 indriyāṇāṃ svabhāvena sukham evānudhāvati | tasmād vidvān upāsīta na rūpaṃ pāramārthikam || 24.3 acyutasya parokṣaṃ tad iti kiṃ ta(ci?)d anusmaret | aupakārikam evāsya rūpam ārādhayed budhaḥ || 24.4 anudhyāyan vadec cāpi tathāsyuramite matī (yathāsya ramate matiḥ?) | tasmād ākāram uddiṣṭaṃ na parityajya paṇḍitaḥ || 24.5 paraṃ devam upāsīta muktayaiva phalāya vā | svarūpaṃ cāsya tantre'smin kathitaṃ yan mayā tava || 24.6 tad eva pūjayen nityaṃ na tu buddhivikalpitam | abhiṣeke svadehasya śāntimājñā[mantrān?] prayojayet || 24.7 guptyartham ātmarakṣāyāṃ dravyaśuddhau ca pāvanāt | samid ājyaṃ na homeṣu yojayed devatāśrayāt || 24.8 kathitenaiva rūpeṇa dhyāyeta tam aharniśam | yathā prasādam ākāṃkṣan seveta satataṃ dhruvam || 24.9 abhyāsāc ca bhavanty ete na kadā'py avicintayet | dhyānenaiva hare rūpe kuryāt paricayaṃ sadā || 24.10 tato'sya vardhate bhaktis tataḥ sneho'sya jāyate | anapāyī bhavaty eva devadevasya pādayoḥ || 24.11 pūjakaḥ sarvakāleṣu cyavate sthānato'nyathā | mantrair āvartyamānais tu viṣṇupādasamāśritaiḥ || 24.12 svarūpaṃ lakṣyate buddhau bhaktir asya tathā[to?] bhavet | bhaktyarthāḥ sarvamantrās tu bhaktyarthaṃ nityam arcanam || 24.13 dhyānaṃ ca praṇidhānaṃ ca sarvaṃ bhaktyartham iṣyate | yadyasya hṛdayaṃ tīvraṃ sahasā bhajate harim || 24.14 apriye vā priye vāpi sa bhakta iti kīrtyate | priyāṇi cintayed yas tu devadattāni mānavaḥ || 24.15 na svaśaktyaiva labdhāni sa bhaktaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ | mama pūrvakṛtaiḥ pāpair etad apriyam āgatam || 24.16 ity apriyeṣu yaḥ paśyed viṣṇubhaktaḥ sa sammataḥ | evaṃ bhaktinivṛttyarthaṃ [vivṛddhyarthaṃ?] vidvāṃso'pi janārdanam || 24.17 rūpavantam upāsīran nānyathā siddhikāmyayā [māpnuyuḥ?] | avyaktādyāś ca ye bhāvā dehāntāḥ kathitā mayā || 24.18 tān atītya sthitopy eṣo devaś cintya śarīravān | tasya yogamayaṃ vidyād ākāraṃ sarvavastukam || 24.19 bhaktānām anukampārthaṃ na tu satyena niṣṭhitam | āyudhābharaṇopetaṃ sāṃśukaṃ dorbhir ujvalaiḥ || 24.20 satyarūpam iva dhyāyet prathamaṃ puruṣottamam | karmamadhye viśeṣeṇa vartamānasya dehinaḥ || 24.21 idam eva hare rūpaṃ dhyātavyaṃ nānyad anvaham | yad vā nivṛttaḥ karmabhyaḥ saṃyate ramate manaḥ || 24.22 tadā sūkṣmaśarīraṃ tu pūjayet puruṣottamam | śaktayaḥ sādhukāro[vā] vijñeyā bāhavo diśaḥ || 24.23 dyaur uttamāṅgam ākāśaṃ jaṭharaṃ pṛthivī padam | dṛṣṭiḥ sūryo manaś candraḥ prāṇaṃ cāsya śarīriṇaḥ || 24.24 nityaḥ sarvagataḥ sthāṇuḥ pūjanīyo manīṣibhiḥ || 24.25 yat kṛtaṃ paramaṃ rūpam anirdeśyam alakṣaṇam | na tasya puruṣaḥ pūjām icched vibudho'pi san || 24.26 devaṃ dhyātvā paro[raṃ?] dharmaḥ[rmaṃ?] praṇavādyaiḥ paraiḥ paraiḥ | dhyāyan parokṣaṃ tad iti āvṛtteta sa paṇḍitaḥ || 24.27 yadā yadā tu labhate prasādaṃ buddhigocaram | tadā tadā vapuḥ sūkṣmaṃ dhyāyed devasya saṃyataḥ || 24.28 vedavedāṅgavidyānāṃ pāragaḥ subahuśrataḥ | saṃśayenaiva kāryeṣu dhruvaṃ sīdati padmaja || 24.29 āgamārthaṃ dṛḍhaṃ kuryāt sarvavidyābhir ātmavān | vivekena ca śuddhena nāgamasyaiva viplavam || 24.30 vinirdhūtāgamo hy eṣa dehayantravaśe sthitaḥ | aprāpya śaraṇaṃ kiṃcit kvāvasīdati buddhimān || 24.31 sūkṣmāt sthūlam idaṃ jātaṃ śarīraṃ hy asya sādhanam | devo'pi sadṛśas tasya sādhyo bhavitum arhati || 24.32 tataḥ sthūlakrameṇaiva sūkṣmam arthaṃ hareḥ katham | tathā hi vapur apy asya jāyate janmabhiḥ śubhaiḥ || 24.33 yas tu vidvān upāsīta śrīkāmaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ | vidhānaṃ tasya vakṣyāmi saṃkṣepeṇa pitāmaha || 24.34 hemaprākārasaṃvītaṃ prāsādaṃ hemanirmitam | dhyātvā ratnamayīṃ bhūmiṃ devatābhir adhiṣṭhitām || 24.35 tasya madhye tu vaikuṇṭhaṃ raktapadme sukhāsitam | caturbhujam anudhyāyet suprasannamṛdusthitam || 24.36 dvārapālāsthitair dvāraṃ caturbhis toraṇojvalaiḥ | āsannān anugṛhṇantaṃ kāmadānena pūjakān || 24.37 pūjakān parivārāṃs tu pūrvam eva mayeritān | acireṇaiva kālena śriyaṃ prāpnoti susthirām || 24.38
iti śrīpāñcarātre paramasaṃhitāyāṃ vidvatpūjā nāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
atha pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
brahmā ye narā jñānayogena na śakyās tvām upāsitum | sarvadā bhaktiyuktāś ca kiṃ teṣāṃ paramaṃ hitam || 25.1 paramaḥ teṣām adhigamo dharmo vihitaḥ kamalāsana | tīrthānāṃ śuddhihetūnāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca vartmanā || 25.2 jñāninām aviyuktānām icchatāṃ dharmam uttamam | abhigamyāni tīrthāni pāvanāni samaṃtataḥ || 25.3 yatra deśe prasīdanti karaṇāny asya dehinaḥ | tattīrtham iti vijñeyaṃ narāṇāṃ pāpanāśanam || 25.4 yathā teṣām abhigamād dharmavṛddhir bhaviṣyati | tathā te kathayiṣyāmi lokānugrahakāmyayā || 25.5 tīrthāny ekāhasādhyāni dvyahaḥsādhyāni vā na ca | pāvanāni bhaviṣyanti tryahātprabhṛti pāvanam || 25.6 daśabhyo yojanebhyor vā'ṅna tīrthaṃ saphalaṃ bhavet | kāle deśe'pi vṛdhyaiva phalavṛddhir vidhīyate || 25.7 deśe kāle tu dīrghe'pi yadi kāryāntare cchayā | krīḍayā vā bhavet tīrthaṃ na mohād bahumanyate || 25.8 prasaṅgānuprasaṅgena gacched anyena vā bhṛtaḥ | yas tīrthāni naro mūḍhaḥ tasyāpi na phalaṃ bhavet || 25.9 bhajamāno'pi yat tīrthaṃ na mohād bahumanyate | nāstikyena vivṛddhena tasyāpi na phalaṃ bhavet || 25.10 tasmāt buddhiṃ samāsthāya tyaktvā kāryāntare spṛhām | abhigacchen naras tīrthaṃ svatantraḥ sthiramānasaḥ || 25.11 śaktaḥ svam annam aśnīyād aśakto bhaikṣam ācaret | naimittikāni yāni syus tāni bhuñjīta na kvacit || 25.12 kāyasyānupaghātena vṛttir asya vidhīyate | kṛcchram evaṃ hi martyānāṃ tīrthābhigamanaṃ viduḥ || 25.13 nadyaḥ samudragās tīrthaṃ sindhunadyoś ca saṃgamaḥ | vāpyaś ca mṛdubhir juṣṭāḥ parvatāyatanāni ca || 25.14 sthānāni devatānāṃ ca durgāṇi gahanāni ca | āśramāṇi ca siddhānāṃ cihnāni ca divaukasām || 25.15 bhāgīrathyāś ca tīrthāni sarasvatyāś ca sarvaśaḥ | āsamudrān manuṣyāṇāṃ pāvanāni viśeṣataḥ || 25.16 kurukṣetre ca tīrthāni sālagrāma saras tathā | śrīparvate ca tīrthāni kumārī tīrtham eva ca || 25.17 setubandhaś ca rāmasya tīrthaṃ gokarṇam eva ca | śūrpārakaṃ tathā tīrthaṃ puṣkaraṃ naimiśaṃ tathā || 25.18 sthānaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ mukhyaṃ tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ matam | evam ādīni tīrthāni naraḥ prāpya mahāmatiḥ || 25.19 trirātram ekarātraṃ vā pūrvaṃ kuryād abhojanam | aśaktau bhaikṣam aśnīyāt kandamūlaphalāni vā || 25.20 japayajñaṃ sadā kuryān maunī dhyānaparāyaṇaḥ | snātvā'camya śucir bhūtvā tīrthatoyena mantravit || 25.21 yogapīṭhaṃ jale dhyātvā devam āvāhya cetasā | pādyam ācamanaṃ cārdhyaṃ datvā tenaiva vāriṇā || 25.22 tatpādān niḥsṛtāṃ dhārāṃ dhyātvā mūrdhani cātmanaḥ | avagāheta maunena tīrthaṃ bhāgavato naraḥ || 25.23 pañcopaniṣadā prokṣya sahasraṃ śatam eva vā | kṛtvā snānavidhiṃ sarvaṃ tarpayitvā ca devatāḥ || 25.24 datvā dravyaṃ yathāśakti gṛhṇīyāt tīrthamudrikām | tayāmṛttikayā nityaṃ deham ālipya śudhyati || 25.25 tīrthatoyaṃ ca saṃhṛtya prokṣayed ātmanas tanum | ekarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā vaiṣṇavaḥ śuddhikāmyayā || 25.26 itihāsāṃś ca tīrtheṣu yatnataḥ śṛṇuyād budhaḥ | pāraṃparyeṇa ye tatra vartante bhaktihetavaḥ || 25.27 siddhānāṃ cāpi pūrveṣāṃ lakṣaṇāny upalakṣayet | devatānāṃ munīnāṃ ca caritāny adbhutāni ca || 25.28 ātmano'ntar bahis tatra cintayet tīrthadevatāḥ | svakarmadṛṣṭyā tiṣṭhanti nānyathā vaiṣṇavā budhāḥ || 25.29 yena kalpena tat tīrthaṃ sevanīyam upāgataiḥ | prāhus tīrthavidhānaṃ ca trastaṃ kalpaṃ na cintayet || 25.30 uttamān vā samānān vā kuryāt tīrtha samaṃ naraḥ | ekaṃ dvau paramas trīn vā nādhikān nāthamāṃs tathā || 25.31 gacchet pravrajitair eva kāmakrodhavivarjitaiḥ | tīrthayātrāṃ naro vidvān kuryāt teṣāṃ ca pūjanam || 25.32 ye narās tyakta sarvasvā muṇḍāḥ kāṣāya vāsasaḥ | vicaranti mahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ te mama priyasattamāḥ || 25.33 tasmāt teṣv eva śuśrūṣāḥ kuryād bhāgavataḥ sadā | teṣām api kṛtā pūjā devasyaiva kṛtā bhavet || 25.34 bhaikṣācaryāśayādīni datvā teṣāṃ tu bhaktitaḥ | vidvān dattopadeśaś ca viṣṇoḥ priyatamo bhavet || 25.35 na kiṃcid apriyaṃ kuryān narāṇāṃ tīrthavāsinām | devatānāṃ ca sarvāsāṃ satvānāṃ cāpi sarvaśaḥ || 25.36 yena kālena yat tīrthaṃ sevitavyaṃ manasvibhiḥ | tena kālena tad gacched aśaktaḥ parvaṇi vrajet || 25.37 dvādaśyāṃ śravaṇāyāṃ vā saṃkrāntiṣu raves tathā | tīrthaṃ mukhyam upāsīta nānyeṣāṃ kālaniścayaḥ || 25.38 athavā viṣṇubhaktānāṃ caratāṃ pṛthivīm imām | yogināṃ tīrthayātrāsu kālaḥ sarvo navājyate[niyujyate?] || 25.39 yat tīrthaṃ samanuprāpya cittamasya prasīdati | tatra tiṣṭhen naro vidvān dīrghakālaṃ dṛḍhavrataḥ || 25.40 yatra gatvā mano nātha prasādam adhigacchati | tatra vā[na ciraṃ?]yuścaran tiṣṭhet tīrthe mukhye'pi vaiṣṇavaḥ || 25.41 āpatsv api ca kaṣṭāsu nityaṃ bhāgavato naraḥ | na tīrthe pratigṛhṇīyād alpam apy alpato dhanam || 25.42 bhikṣām api na yāceta tīrthasthāneṣu buddhimān | bahir gatvā tu yāceta yāvatā dehadhāraṇam || 25.43 mahājanasya sammarde durjanasya ca saṃgame | prāṇavādhāsu cogrāsu kathaṃ cid vṛttir iṣyate || 25.44 japann eva sadāgacched vidvān mantrāṃs tu vaiṣṇavān | kathaṃ ca vaiṣṇavīṃ kṛtvā sakhīnāṃ priyakāmyayā || 25.45 sabhāsthanāni saṃprāpya samṛddhāni varāṇy api | yāvat prayojanaṃ tiṣṭhet na ciraṃ siddhikāmukaḥ || 25.46 ramamāṇo'pi tīrtheṣu krīḍāṃ parihared budhaḥ | āsphoṭakṣvelahāsaś ca dyūtamaithunam eva ca || 25.47 evam ādīniḥ yaḥ kuryāt tīrthayātrām upāgataḥ | tasya tīrthaphalaṃ sarvaṃ haranti brahmarākṣasāḥ || 25.48 dvāv eva vipulau lābhau narāṇāṃ tīrthagāminām | bhaktipratyaya lābhaṃ ca yogajñānaṃ ca puṣkalam || 25.49 yas tu pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryān medinīṃ tīrthayātrayā | saṃprāpnoti parāṃ siddhiṃ na ca pāpena bādhyate || 25.50 labhate ca mahājñānaṃ jātismaraṇam eva ca | vighnānāṃ mupaghātaṃ ca prasādaṃ ca sureśvarāt || 25.51 tasmāt sarvaprayatnena vaiṣṇavaḥ siddhikāmyayā | tīrthayātrāṃ niṣeveta tad eva paramaṃ hitam || 25.52
iti śrīpāñcarātre paramasaṃhitāyāṃ yātrā nāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
atha ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
brahmā saṃsārasya tu kiṃ mūlaṃ kim agraṃ madhyamasya kim | vistareṇa tadācakṣva tathyena puruṣottama || 26.1 paramaḥ saṃsārasya paraṃ mūlaṃ tvam eva kamalodbhava | brahmalokaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya tatoyaḥ prathame mahān || 26.2 tasya madhyam ime lokā narakaṃ cāgram iṣyate | ūrdhvamūlam imaṃ vṛkṣaṃ madhyaśākhām adhaḥśiraḥ || 26.3 saṃsāravidhiyantraite[yatraite] saṃsaranti śarīriṇaḥ | tasya lokāḥ smṛtāḥ śākhāḥ saptabhūmimayāḥ pṛthak || 26.4 pṛthivī cāntarikṣaṃ ca svarmaharjana eva ca | tapaḥ satyaṃ ca saptaite lokās te kathitāḥ kramāt || 26.5 adhastāt punar eṣāṃ proktā narakabhūmayaḥ | tatra pūrvam imāṃ bhūmiṃ vakṣye tava pitāmaha || 26.6 āyām avistāropetāṃ lakṣaṇair vividhair yutām | saptadvīpāḥ smṛtā bhūmer valayākṛtayaḥ sthitāḥ || 26.7 dviguṇaṃ dviguṇāyāmā nānā jananiketanāḥ | samānāyāmavistārair veṣṭitā varuṇālayaiḥ || 26.8 varṣāṇāṃ parvatānāṃ ca bhedābhedena lakṣitāḥ | jambūdvīpaḥ sthito madhye śākadvīpas tataḥ param || 26.9 kuśakrauñcau tato dvīpau śalmalī dvīpa eva ca | gomedaḥ puṣkaraṃ ceti sapta dvīpā ime kramāt || 26.10 kṣārodaḥ sāgaraḥ pūrvaṃ paratrekṣurasodakaḥ | surā dadhi ghṛtodāś ca kṣīrasāgara eva ca || 26.11 svādūdakaṃ ca saptaite sāgarāḥ dvīpavat sthitāḥ | eṣu dvīpeṣu madhyasthā nānāśṛṅgā mahocchrayāḥ || 26.12 āsamudrāyatā śailā vijñeyā varṣaparvatāḥ | teṣāṃ madhye tu varṣāṇi nānā janapadās tathā || 26.13 nagaraṃ grāmanadyaś ca śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ | jambūdvīpasya madhyetu merur nāma mahāgiriḥ || 26.14 nānāratnamayaiḥ śṛṅgaiḥ sthitaḥ kāñcana vigrahaḥ | krīḍā bhūmiḥ sa devānām anekāścaryasaṃyutaḥ || 26.15 tasya jambū nadīnāma mūlam āveṣṭya tiṣṭhati | tasya dakṣiṇapārśveṣu jambūvṛkṣo vyavasthitaḥ || 26.16 atyucchṛtaḥ suvistīrṇaḥ sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ | meroḥ samantād vistīrṇaṃ viddhi varṣam ilāvṛtam || 26.17 tatra jambū phalāhārā jñeyās tadvarṣavāsinaḥ | meror uttarato jṇeyā yatra te varṣaparvatāḥ || 26.18 nīlaḥ śvetas triśṛṅgaś ca kiṃcid ūnāḥ parasparam | ramyakaṃ prathamaṃ varṣaṃ hairaṇyaṃ tadanantaram || 26.19 uttarā kuravaś ceti trīṇi varṣāṇi padmaja | meror dakṣiṇato'py evaṃ varṣaśailās trayaḥ sthitāḥ || 26.20 niṣadho hemakūṭaś ca himaśailaś ca te trayaḥ | harivarṣaṃ kiṃ puruṣaṃ bhārataṃ varṣam eva ca || 26.21 sthitāni trīṇi varṣāṇi kiṃcid ūnany anukramāt | pūrvasyāṃ diśi meros tu parvato gandhamādanaḥ || 26.22 ānīlaniṣadhāyāś ca paścimāyāṃ tu mālyavān | bhadrāśvaḥ ketumālaś ca varṣe dve paratastayoḥ || 26.23 yojanaprayutāyāmo dvīpo'yaṃ madhyamo bhavet | asya varṣeṣu jīvanti nānābhū[rū]pās tu mānavāḥ || 26.24 āyuḥsatvabalādīni teṣāṃ bhinnāni padmaja | varṣaśaileṣu jīvanti yakṣapannagarākṣasāḥ || 26.25 bhārataṃ dakṣiṇaṃ varṣaṃ navadhā khaṇḍitaṃ sthitam | kṣārodasya samudrasya toyenāntaḥprasarpiṇā || 26.26 teṣām eva ca bhedena śailāḥ sarita eva ca | na śakyāḥ parisaṃkhyātuṃ brahman varṣaśatair api || 26.27 kṣārārṇavasya madhyasthā bahavaḥ pakṣiṇo nagāḥ | kṣudradvīpāś ca bhūyāṃs aste smṛtā mlecchagocarāḥ || 26.28 śākadvīpādiṣu punaḥ ṣaṭsu dvīpeṣu parvatāḥ | varṣāṇi saritaś caiva śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || 26.29 teṣu jīvanti manujā dharmaśīlāḥ sthirāyuṣāḥ | paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaś caiva kravyādāś ca sarīsṛpāḥ || 26.30 dhārmikā bhūmipālāś ca dayāśīlasamanvitāḥ | nopaghāto mithas teṣāṃ kāmakrodhādibhiḥ kvacit || 26.31 dānādhyayanaśīlāś ca [na para?] svaniratāḥ prajāḥ | nāpakāreṣu vartante pareṣāṃ vyasaneṣu vā || 26.32 vṛkṣauṣadhyā bahuphalāḥ sarvakāmasamṛddhayaḥ | tatra gāvaḥ payasvinyaḥ prajā nirvyasanās tathā || 26.33 puṣkaradvīpamadhye tu parvato mānasottaraḥ | lokapālāḥ sthitās tasmin diṅmukheṣv indrapūrvakāḥ || 26.34 sāgareṣu tu jivanti satvāḥ salilayonayaḥ | makarāstimayo nakrāḥ kūrmā nāgāś ca dantinaḥ || 26.35 satvebhyaḥ sthalacāribhyo bhūyāṃso jalacāriṇaḥ | samudrasalilāhārā jīvanti niravagrahāḥ || 26.36 svādūdāt parato brahma lokālokas tu parvataḥ | veṣṭayitvā mahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ paritas sopatiṣṭhate || 26.37 arvācīne tu tasyārdhe caranti ravir aśmayaḥ | parārdhārdhakṛto nityaṃ lokālokas tat astu saḥ || 26.38 ity eṣā kathitā bhūmiḥ prathitā dhātupeśalā | śubhāśubhāni karmāṇi yatra kurvanti dehinaḥ || 26.39 bhuvanātvantarikṣāc ca vāyavīyaṃ prakurvitam | uparyupari tiṣṭhanti marutas tatra saptadhā || 26.40 tatra medhyā gṛhāstārā nakṣatrāṇi maharṣayaḥ | taijasena śarīreṇa tiṣṭhanti nirupaplavāḥ || 26.41 yakṣavidyādharāś caiva gandharvāḥ kinnarās tathā | kāmacārā nirābādhās tatra jīvanti nirvṛtāḥ || 26.42 saptaskandhaṃ tu tat tatra vāyucakraṃ samonnatam | bhramayaty upari sthitvā dhruvonāma mahāmuniḥ || 26.43 tṛtīyas tejaso lokaḥ svargaloka iti smṛtaḥ | vasanti vibudhā yatra modamānāḥ sahasraśaḥ || 26.44 vimānaiḥ kāmasaṃcārair apsarobhiḥ samanvitāḥ | tatra devagaṇā brahman nivasanti sahasraśaḥ || 26.45 ādityā vasavo rudrā sādhyā ṛbhava eva ca | kiṃkarāḥ karma devāś ca pitaraś ca pṛthagvidhāḥ || 26.46 cakramaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ pibantaḥ paramāmṛtam | jīvanti vividhās tatra vāsavenābhirakṣitāḥ || 26.47 tejomayena vapuṣā dīpyamānāḥ samantataḥ | kalpamātrāyuṣo devā jīvanti sthirayauvanāḥ || 26.48 gāvaḥ kāmadughās teṣāṃ kalpavṛkṣāś ca sarvadā | cintāphalāni ratnāni pūrayanti manorathān || 26.49 evam ete trayo lokā labhyante karmabhiḥ śubhaiḥ | karmakṣayena jīryante ye mayā kīrtitās tava || 26.50 catvāras tu pare lokā jñānasādhyāḥ pitāmaha | vasanti yogino yatra yogābhyāsena niḥsṛtāḥ || 26.51 caturthe maharākhye tu daśakalpāyuṣo narāḥ | saṅkalpasiddhās tiṣṭhanti viṣṇubhaktā jitendriyāḥ || 26.52 pañcame tu jane loke śatakalpāyuṣo narāḥ | dhyānāhārāḥ pramodante vaśe sannihitendriyāḥ || 26.53 ṣaṣṭhe tapasi loke tu mahābhūta jayaiṣiṇaḥ | sahasrakalpāyuṣaḥ siddhā nivasanti samāha(hi)tāḥ || 26.54 saptame satyaloke tu pradhānā vaśino narāḥ | ayutakalpāyuṣaḥ siddhā nivasanti nirutsukāḥ || 26.55 atraiva vasati brahmā lokasṛṣṭivicakṣaṇaḥ | tenāyaṃ brahmalokaś ca yatra tvam adhitiṣṭhasi || 26.56 ete lokās tu gatayaḥ śubhakarmavipākajāḥ | pāpasya tu gatir nīcair lokānām iti niścayāḥ || 26.57 adhastāt kṣitilokasya mahānarakabhūmayaḥ | nānārūpāḥ piśācānāṃ ṣaṭkāstiṣṭhanti duṣkṛtāḥ || 26.58 rauravaḥ prathamas teṣāṃ mahārauravam eva ca | narakaṃ kālasūtraṃ ca pañcakaṣṭam anantaram || 26.59 tāmisram andhatāmisram ity etāni pitāmaha | etāni samanuprāpya tīvrayātrānvitāni vai || 26.60 duṣkṛtānāṃ phalaṃ ghoraṃ bhuñjate sarvadehinaḥ | athastāt punar eteṣām avīcirnām aviśrutā || 26.61 nivāso dānavendrāṇāṃ nāśitānāṃ gatāhṛtā | evam uddeśataḥ proktā sṛṣṭir eṣāṃ pitāmaha || 26.62 bahiraṇḍakapāt vedhā racayitvaiva tiṣṭhati | aṇḍasyāpi bahir yo'yaṃ buddhir bahiḥsthitā || 26.63 buddhes tu bahir avyaktam avyaktāt puruṣaḥ paraḥ | pañcaśaktimayo viṣṇur vāsudevaḥ sanātanaḥ || 26.64 naiva tasmāt paraṃ kiṃcid āstikatvaṃ pitāmaha | sa tv anādir anantaś ca parimāṇavivarjitaḥ || 26.65 tadicchayā sṛṣṭir ayaṃ vikāsam adhigacchati | tadicchayā ca saṃhāraṃ kalpānte pratipadyate || 26.66 iti yeyaṃ tava proktā lokasṛṣṭir aśeṣataḥ | evam anyāś ca bhūyaś ca sṛjyante tena sṛṣṭayaḥ || 26.67 parasparaparokṣās tāḥ pratyakṣās tasya yoginaḥ | asaṃkhyeyā sthitālokāḥ sarva lokodayātyayāḥ || 26.68 nānākārā vikārāś ca krīḍārthaṃ tena nirmitāḥ | yathā vṛkṣasya śākhāsu phalāni subahūny api || 26.69 saṃbhavanti tathā tasmin bhuvanānīti dhāraya | nirvikāraḥ parodevo vikārān sṛjati prabhuḥ || 26.70 saṃsārasya gatiṃ dṛṣṭvā krīḍann iva sa tiṣṭhati | ity eṣā sṛṣṭir ākhyātā saṃsārasya mayā tava || 26.71 asyāṃ tu parivartante saṃsāre dehinaḥ punaḥ | kadācid uttamā bhūtvā jāyante madhyamā punaḥ || 26.72 bhavanti cādhamāḥ paścāt karmapāśaiḥ svayaṃkṛtaiḥ | sarvās tu gatayo brahman puṃsaḥ saṃsāragocarāḥ || 26.73 karmakṣayena naśyanti so[no?]ttarā na ca nirvyathā | tatra devakṛtāḥ siddhā manyamānāḥ svayaṃkṛtāḥ || 26.74 āmūlanāśaṃ bhuñjāno na kiṃcit pratipadyate | tatas tu puratodṛṣṭvā duḥravāni viṣamāṇi ca || 26.75 avaśo manyate devaṃ kartāraṃ jagataḥ prabhum | nāvaiṣṇavasya saṃsāra dviṣado vinivartate || 26.76 nāvaiṣṇavasya martyasya saṃsāre'pi sthiraṃ sukham | indriyāṇāṃ vaśaṃ gatvā saṃsārān nātivartate || 26.77 teṣām api virodhena saṃsāram ativartate | teṣām api virodhotthaṃ devadevaṃ janārdanam || 26.78 sarvakālam upāsīta tena siddhir bhaviṣyati | paśūnāṃ manujānāṃ tu devānāṃ yogināṃ tathā || 26.79 viṣṇubhaktā viśiṣyante sarvalokeṣu niścayaḥ | mānavānāṃ yathā devā devānāṃ ca yathā hariḥ || 26.80 yogināṃ ca yathā siddhāḥ siddhānāṃ ca yathā hariḥ | lokasthitim imāṃ dīrghaṃ viśālām atidustarām || 26.81 paśyann āste parodevaḥ paramavyomni nirvṛtaḥ | yathāhastasthitān akṣān paśyanti puruṣāḥ sukham || 26.82 evam eva paro devaḥ saptalokān sa paśyati | brāhmāyur bhavet tāvad yāvat tu jagataḥ sthitiḥ || 26.83 tasyāyuṣi samāpte tu jagat sarvaṃ pralīyate | svaṃ svaṃ kāraṇam ṛcchanti sarvā'pi kṛtayaḥ sadā || 26.84 avyakte tā nilīyante tatpunaḥ paramātmani | ṣaḍbhir ūnaṃ sahasraṃ tu yugānāṃ brahmaṇo dinam || 26.85 rātriś ca tāvatī tasya saṃkalpa iti saṃjñitaḥ | saṃvatsaro narāṇāṃ tu devānāṃ nādhikā bhavet || 26.86 dvādaśaiva sahasrāṇi tena mānena vatsaraḥ | yuge yuge pravartante kalpāmanvantarāṇi ca || 26.87 yadā tu tena mānena śatāyuḥ sṛṣṭikaṃ bhavet | tadā sṛṣṭiṃ tu saṃhṛtya svayam āste paraḥ pumān || 26.88
iti śrīpāñcarātre paramasaṃhitāyāṃ loko nāma ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
atha saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
brahmā vyāmiśreṇa tvayoktānāṃ tatra tatra tu karmaṇām | saṃgrahaṃ mama deveśa vaktum arhasi sarvaśaḥ || 27.1 paramaḥ hanta te kathayiṣyāmi karmaṇāṃ saṃgrahaṃ tava | nityanaimittikānāṃ ca kāmyānāṃ cāpi sarvaśaḥ || 27.2 śayanād utthitaḥ pūrvam uktvā nārāyaṇaṃ punaḥ | vāgyataḥ prāṅmukho bhūtvā kuryād rakṣāṃ tathātmanaḥ || 27.3 manasā sṛṣṭimārgeṇa sarvam eva vicintya ca | baddhayogapuṭaṃ dhyātvā śarīrāntaṃ yathākramam || 27.4 paścād bhūmim avaṣṭabhya bahir niṣkramya pūrvavat | kṛtvoccārādikaṃ karma śuddhimārgakrameṇa ca || 27.5 kṛtvādbhiś ca mṛdācāpi hastapādamukhāny api | śodhayitvā yathānyāyaṃ ghrāṇākṣiśravaṇāni ca || 27.6 saṃbhakṣya dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca kṛtvā niṣṭhīvanāni ca | ācamya vidhivat paścāt pītvonmṛjya sakṛnmukham || 27.7 bhūya eva tathācamya prokṣyātmānaṃ yathāvidhi | ātmānaṃ pariṣicyātha visṛjet salilāñjalim || 27.8 sandhyām uddiśya bhūyo'pi pāṇī prakṣālya vāriṇā | pañcamantrajapaṃ kṛtvā devasyāpi pradakṣiṇam || 27.9 saṃbhāṣya bhūsuraiḥ paścān maune dīkṣāṃ visarjayet | maṅgalāny ātmano nityaṃ daridro'pi nahāpayet || 27.10 gandhapuṣpāṇī mantre dve śikhābandhaṃ ca pauṣṭikam | ādarśam añjanaṃ rakṣāṃ mukhavāsaṃ ca saṃbhavāt || 27.11 āyudhābharaṇādīni tasya tasya yathoditam | evam etad vidhāyādau kāryaṃ laukikam ācaret || 27.12 āsīta kṣitimantreṇa vāyumantreṇa ca vrajet | vyomamantreṇa bhaṣeta rūpaṃ paśyec ca tejasā || 27.13 jalaṃ ca jalamantreṇa sarvakālam upaspṛśet | laukikeṣv api kāryeṣu siddhim icchan naro budhaḥ || 27.14 yāgakāle tu saṃprāpte dravyāṇāṃ saṃgrahe kṛte | mālāṃ visṛjya snātvā ca tarpayitvā ca devatāḥ || 27.15 yāgasthānaṃ samāsādya bhūtvā mantramayaḥ svayam | sthānaṃ ratnamayaṃ dhyātvā pātrāṇi vividhāni ca || 27.16 prāsādaṃ cāpi sauvarṇaṃ tīrthajāny udakāni ca | nirmālya sthānam uddiśya bahirāvaraṇād bahiḥ || 27.17 pūrayitvā jalair ekaṃ pātram anyac ca pūrayet | pādyā[pānīyā?]camanam ekena snānam anyena kārayet || 27.18 ardhyaṃ pādyaṃ tathaivānyad ardhyadravyaiś ca pūrayet | sarvārthaṃ tv aparaṃ pātraṃ mahat toyena pūrayet || 27.19 gandhādīni ca pātreṣu sthāpayet staṃbhanenavā[tsaṃbhave nava?] | vahner dakṣiṇataḥ kṛtvā homopakaraṇāni ca || 27.20 pīṭhaṃ kṛtvā punaḥ samyak vihārāv araṇāni ca | sugandhakusumaṃ haste saṃgṛhyāvāhayet param || 27.21 pīṭham āsanam uddiśya saha puṣpeṇa nikṣipet | yāgādyāgāvasānaṃ tv arthasānnidhyam arthayet || 27.22 tataḥ pūjāṃ yathāyogaṃ kuryād ātmanivedanām | svaḥsthāna eva deveśaṃ pratyarpya pralayakramāt || 27.23 sthānaṃ viśodhya pātrāṇi baliṃ datvā bahis tathā | viṣvaksenāya nairmālya pūjayitvā nivedya ca || 27.24 ācamya vaiṣṇavaiḥ sārdhaṃ bhuñjītānyaiś ca śaktitaḥ | agnir bhūtvānnam aśnīyāt somarūpam avasthitam || 27.25 ācamya hastapādeṣu śuṣkeṣu manasā smaret | indriyāṇi ca bhūtāni spṛśed vā mantrapūrvakam || 27.26 spṛśed anyāni bhūtāni nāśucir dravyam eva vā | devasyaiva kathābhistaṃ dinaśeṣaṃ samāpayet || 27.27 dharmakarmāviruddhāni kṛtvā karmāṇi vā budhaḥ | sandhyākāle tu saṃprāpte sandhyopāsanam ācaret || 27.28 stotrāṇi ca japed vidvān bhuktvācamya yathāniśi | hṛdyākāśe pratiṣṭhāpya pūjayitvā paraṃ punaḥ || 27.29 pralayakramam āsthāya śayītaśayane sukham | evaṃ bhāgavatānāṃ hi gṛhasthānāṃ vidhir matam || 27.30 anyeṣām api tulyo'yaṃ saṃgrahaḥ saṃbhavaḥ smṛtaḥ | nāgnikāryaṃ tu śūdrasya na sandhyopāsanaṃ tathā || 27.31 kevalaṃ puṣpayāgasya saṃgrahaḥ kathitas tava | anyeṣām api vakṣyāmi saṃgrahaṃ tava padmaja || 27.32 dīkṣākāmas tu tantrajñaṃ sādhumanyaṃ dayānvitam | abhigamyārcayitvā ca śrāvayet kāryam īpsitam || 27.33 ācāryo'pi viditvā ca śīlam ācāram eva ca | samayaṃ śrāvayet pūrvaṃ likhitvā cakramaṇḍalam || 27.34 ekānte vimale sthāne tatrāvāhya paraṃ prabhum | kṛtvā yāgaṃ ca manasā tataḥ śiṣyaṃ ca saṃharet || 27.35 punar mantramayaṃ kṛtvā sṛṣṭimārgeṇa mantravit | maṇḍalaṃ darśayitvā ca śrāvayet bhaktimagrataḥ || 27.36 ācāryaṃ samayaṃ cāpi dharmaṃ ca vividhaṃ punaḥ | śrāvayec ca punar mantraṃ guruḥ pūrvaṃ kramāgatam || 27.37 śrāva[lekha?]yitvā rajobhis tu granthadīkṣāṃ prayojayet | upadeśaṃ tato dadyād arcanākramam eva ca || 27.38 kārayet puṣpayāgaṃ ca japaṃ ca niyamāṃs tathā | tatra dīkṣāṃ prayuñjīta mantrahomasamanvitām || 27.39 bhūyaḥ śabdaiś ca karmāṇi homenāpi samācaret | dīkṣādhivāsane home pūrvaṃ saṃrakṣaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ || 27.40 dvi[tṛ?]tīyā vistareṇaiva visarge ca sakṛt sakṛt | evaṃ dīkṣāṃ tridhā bhinnām uttarottarabhayasīm || 27.41 prayujya labhate siddhiṃ vaiṣṇavaḥ susamāhitaḥ | sthāpanaṃ kartukāmas tu sārvakālikam uttamam || 27.42 prāsādaṃ kārayed agre yathāvibhava vistaram | śilabhir iṣṭakābhir vā kāṣṭhair vā lakṣaṇānvitam || 27.43 sthāpanasya tu nakṣatram āsannam avadhārya ca | satkṛtya śilpino'rthena kṛtvā prasādam ātmanaḥ || 27.44 dravyāṇāṃ saṃgrahaṃ kuryāt sthāpanārthāya sarvaśaḥ | ādau śilpi sakāśāt tu gṛhṇīyāt pratimāṃ navām || 27.45 dhanadānena satkṛtya prītidānena ca svayam | ācāryaṃ varayec caiva suvṛttaṃ tantrapāragam || 27.46 kuśalaṃ bhaktimantaṃ ca pālayitvā dhanādibhiḥ | anyāni ca navāni syur dravyāṇi vividhāni ca || 27.47 tāni sarvāṇi saṃhṛtya śudhayitavyā ca medinīm | nayanonmīlanaṃ kuryāt pratimāyā vidhānataḥ || 27.48 jaleṣu śāyayet paścād rakṣayec ca samaṃtataḥ | athādhivāsanaṃ kuryād yathāva dvidhipūrvakam || 27.49 sthāpayec ca tato vidvān nakṣatre śobhane harim | sthāpayitvā tu sarveṣām arthinām aviśeṣataḥ || 27.50 vastrāṇi bhojanaṃ caiva dadyād aharahaḥ kramāt | vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ paṇḍitānāṃ ca sarvataḥ || 27.51 bhṛtyānāṃ śilpināṃ caiva pūjāṃ kuryād yathākramam | yojakānāṃ ca kartuś ca yājakānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ || 27.52 anyathā hi mahān doṣaḥ sthāpakasya bhaviṣyati | caturthe divase prāpte kṛtvā snapanam uttamam || 27.53 tīrthayātrāṃ tataḥ kuryād devasyotsavasaṃyutām | samāpya pratiṣṭhāpya kārayen nityam arcanam || 27.54 trikālam ekakālaṃ vā baliṃ kuryād dine dine | avasānam idaṃ viddhi sthāpanasya pitāmaha || 27.55 evaṃ tu sthāpanaṃ kṛtvā kṛtakṛtyo bhaviṣyati || 56
iti śrīpāñcarātre paramasaṃhitāyāṃ saṃgrahaṃ nāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
athāṣṭaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
brahmā āpatkāle tu saṃprāpte nityayāgasya yo vidhiḥ | naimittikasya kāmyasya sarvam etad bravīhi me || 28.1 paramaḥ śaktibhir muktipālaiś ca saṃyutaḥ pīṭhamantrakaiḥ | vijñeyaḥ kṛtayāgo'yaṃ nityayāgaḥ sa uttamaḥ || 28.2 pīṭhenaiva samastena bahirāvaraṇair vinā | mantrapūrvaṃ kṛtoyāgo nityayāgaḥ sa madhyamaḥ || 28.3 kevalenaiva padmena mahābhūtamayo nayaḥ | kāryeṇa haviṣā caiva bhūṣaṇaiś ca samanvitam || 28.4 dravyaśuddhisamāyuktam uttamaṃ pūjanaṃ bhavet | agnikāryaṃ vinā yat tu kālapakvaṃ nivedya ca || 28.5 upacārair yutaṃ sarvair madhyamaṃ pūjanaṃ bhavet | vastrālaṃkāraśobhādi varjayitvā pṛthagvidham || 28.6 kevalaṃ puṣpayāgas tu kaniṣṭhaṃ pūjanaṃ smṛtam | dhāraṇādisamāyuktaḥ pralayodayasaṃyutaḥ || 28.7 sarvamantrakṛto jñeyo dehanyāsaḥ sa uttamaḥ | pralayodayamātreṇa madhyamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 28.8 .....ṣaḍaṅganyāsena kaniṣṭho nyāsa ucyate | pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ pradhānaṃ syāt sarveṣv eva yathākramam || 28.9 śaktibhaktisamāyogāt prayogas tv aparismṛtaḥ | puṇyadeśe ca kāle ca yāgo naimittikaḥ smṛtaḥ || 28.10 sa punas trividho jñeya uttamādhamamadhyamāḥ | kṛtopavāsas teṣu syāt vratacārī ca yatnataḥ || 28.11 madhyamas tu payobhakṣaḥ phalamūlāśano'paraḥ | annapānādisaṃyuktaṃ mukhyanaimittikaṃ bhavet || 28.12 yāgasākalyamātreṇa madhyamaṃ parikīrtitam | vratopavāsarahitam kaniṣṭhaṃ parikīrtitam || 28.13 anyena yājana.........vyāptau vā saṅkaṭe'pivā | yājakasya guṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā yājanaṃ madhyamaṃ bhavet || 28.14 aiśvaryād ātmano..ẏaṃ kaniṣṭhaṃ yājanaṃ kramāt | upavāsaṃ ca yāgaś ca bhojanaṃ dānam eva ca || 28.15 etasminn eva divase mokṣakāmasya śasyate | kṛtvopavāsaṃ pūrvedyur arcaye................ || 28.16 .....c ca bhojayec cāpi phalakāmaḥ pitāmaha | ...........ṃahāntaṃ yatnam ācaret || 28.17 kālena mahatā............................. | parimāṇam avekṣaiva karmaṇā................ || 28.18 ...............ṇaḥ kramād yogaḥ kāmyayā | gatir yat tasya kṛśatvam adhamasta..........ṣaḥ || 28.19 ................ẏāgasya kaivalyam īpsitam | ...............ḍanyais tatra vidbhir yathākramam || 28.20 .........ḍhanena..ḍahāt sakāreṇa priyeṇa ca | artha dhātu[arthaṃ dātu?] maśakto'pi kārayed devapūjanam || 28.21 śuśrūṣā priyavākyaiś ca tat sarvaṃ paripūrayet | pūjāmārgamajānaṃs tu pūjakāt pūjaye.............. || 28.22 ............ṣābhiḥ prayuktābhiḥ pūjādravyaṃ prajāya ca | devā........ṣthānāya dhanaśodhanaiḥ || 28.23 gandhapuṣpādi....ṇaiḥ kāntikarmabhiḥ | utsavā..........śāntikarmabhir eva ca || 28.24 deve yāgaḥ...................paraḥ smṛtaḥ | asāmānyata.........................ṇavaḥ || 28.25 vaiṣṇavaḥ śruṇuyāt tatra tasyāpi vi........... | .............vañcayitvā ca corayitvā ca puṣkalaḥ || 28.26 tatra pā.............viṣṇu dharmabahiṣkṛtaḥ | tasmād īpsita sidhyarthaṃ tasmin kāle'pi sādhakaḥ || 28.27 ācāryam adhigamyaiva tantram ādātum arha........... | uttamaḥ paricaryābhir arthadānais tu madhyamaḥ || 28.28 ācāryaṃ toṣayet............ṣṭa priyakarmabhiḥ | āpatkāle vinācāryaḥ......................... || 28.29 pradadyāt paramaṃ tantraṃ vidyā................ | bhaktimān dharmaśīlaś ca paropadravanispṛhaḥ || 28.30 jñānārthaṃ siddhikāmaś ca śiṣyāḥ pātra....... | pātre vidyāṃ tu nikṣipya kevalaṃ dharmakāraṇāt || 28.31 prāpnoti mahatīṃ siddhim ācāryo nānyathā kvacit | siddhikāmaḥ paraḥ śiṣyaḥ śrīkāmo madhyamaḥ smṛtaḥ || 28.32 kṣudrakāmo jaghanyas tu yatra śiṣyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | āpady api tu kaṣṭāyāṃ bhīto vā durgato'pi vā || 28.33 pūjayen naiva vṛ[tyarthaṃ?] devadevaṃ kadācana | parvatāgraṃ paraṃ sthānaṃ nadītīraṃ tu madhyamam || 28.34 adhamaṃ grāmadhyasthaṃ sthānam evaṃ trilakṣaṇam | saṃgṛhya guruvidyāṃś ca manu..ṭriṣu dṛḍhavrataḥ || 28.35 antarāyair adhṛṣyaś ca sādhako....ucyate | anutiṣṭhan parikleśaṃ madhyamaḥ sādhakas tu saḥ || 28.36 evam eva tu vijñeyā sarveṣāṃ trividhā gatiḥ | śaktānām uttamās tasya......... ................ || 28.37 ..............r̤ā pakvā..........parāv ubhau | kaniṣṭhaṃ sarvadā pakṣaṃ na samarthaḥ samācaret || 28.38 bhaktir aham apy atra bhaktair bhavati lāghavam | āpatkāle sakṛtkṛtvā pramāde saṃkaṭe'pivā || 28.39 dvitīyaṃ na punaḥ kuryād eṣa śāstrasya nirṇayaḥ | yat kṛtaṃ guruvākyena yat kṛtaṃ vyādhipīḍayā || 28.40 na tad doṣakaraṃ jñeyaṃ punaś cec chubham ācaret | etad uddeśamātreṇa vidhānaṃ proktam āpadi || 28.41 āpadāṃ bahulatvāt tu vistāro nāntam ṛcchati | durbhikṣaṃ rājavādhā ca vyādhir agnibhayaṃ tathā || 28.42 dasyupīḍāpahāraś ca vijṇeyāḥ paramāpadaḥ | etāsām āpadāṃ yoge samayaṃ laṅghayann api || 28.43 na duṣyati punaḥ kṛtvā kiṃcid eva śubhānvitam || 28.44
iti śrīpāñcarātre paramasaṃhitāyāṃ anugrahaṃ nāma aṣṭaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
athaikonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
brahmā karmaśeṣās tvayā noktās tantre'smin santi[yadi]kecana | tad idānīṃ samācakṣva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 29.1 paramaḥ athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi karmaśeṣān aśeṣataḥ | sa teṣāṃ karmaṇām eva yathāyogaṃ pitāmaha || 29.2 yogapīṭhaṃ vinā kuryān mudrayā padmamāsanam | śaktiś ca padmamālāṃś ca kesareṣu daleṣu ca || 29.3 kalpayitvā punaḥ kuryāt dikpālān bahir āśrayān | bījasthāne tu ye bīje devatānām anāmni ca || 29.4 mūlamantre tu vinyasya tena yāgaṃ samācaret | āmanaḥ[tmanaḥ] kāryam uktvā tu mūlamantraḥ samāpyate || 29.5 pradhānadevatām eva hṛdayādiṣu kalpayet | ṣaḍaṅganyāsasidhyarthaṃ kāmyayāgeṣv ayaṃ vidhiḥ || 29.6 pūjāraṃbhe bhayasthāne kāntāreṣu nadīṣu ca | prāṇāntikeṣu durgeṣu ṣaḍaṅganyāsam ācaret || 29.7 arcane bhojane stutye snāne cācamane hute | mūtroccāravisarge ca sandhyāyāṃ ca prapūjane || 29.8 śarīranyāsakāle ca namaskāre ca tarpaṇe | maunaṃ kuryāt prayatnena bhaven niṣphalam anyathā || 29.9 sauvarṇo rājatas tāmraḥ khādiro vā sruvo bhavet | ādyam aiśvaryasidhyarthaṃ rājataṃ kīrtivardhanam || 29.10 tāmraṃ śāntikaraṃ proktaṃ khādiraṃ vasuvardhanam | dvādaśāṅgulamāyāmaṃ kūla[mūla?]viṣkaṃbhamaṅgulam || 29.11 viṣkaṃbhāt dviguṇaṃ vṛttaṃ viṣkaṃbhasya dalaṃ guṇe | yavamānāv ubhau gartau gartavṛttau pṛthak pṛthak || 29.12 viṣkaṃbhāt pādahīnaṃ syāt garbhasīmāya vā dalam | gopucchasadṛśaṃ daṇḍaṃ nāsikāpuṭamatpuṭam || 29.13 sruvasya kārayed vidvān sruvaś ca samam āyatam | viṣkaṃbhāt dviguṇaṃ vṛttaṃ viṣkaṃbhāt dviguṇaṃ galam || 29.14 bhāgān kuryāt punaḥ pañcadvibhāgas tv ānanaṃ bhavet | daṇḍamānaṃ bhavec cheṣaṃ gartaṃ vittaṃ mahādalam || 29.15 ubhoṣṭhasadṛśaṃ tv agrau mantram aṣṭākṣaraṃ japet | uktvā paramahaṃsaṃ ca śuddhabhūmau hi dāpayet || 29.16 dadyāc cheṣaṃ vidhānena tena naśyati kilbiṣam | upasthāya rasenānnam abhimṛśya tathāṃbhasā || 29.17 vāyumantraiś ca bhuñjīta pañca prāṇāhutīr budhaḥ | prāṇo'pānas tathā vyāna udānaś ca samānavān || 29.18 vāyubījena vijñeyāḥ pañcamantrāḥ svanāmabhiḥ | bhuktvā toyaṃ pibet tena hastaśuddhiṃ ca kārayet || 29.19 arcayitvā paraṃ devaṃ nityam avyagrayā dhiyā | stutikāle tu saṃprāpte stotram etad udāharet || 29.20 jitaṃ te puṇḍarīkākṣa namas te viśvabhāvana | namaste'stu hṛṣīkeśa mahāpuruṣa pūrvaja || 29.21 devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca sāmānyam adhidaivatam | sarvadācaraṇadvandvaṃ vrajāmi śaraṇaṃ tava || 29.22 ekas tvam asi lokasya sraṣṭā saṃhārakas tathā | adhyakṣaś cānumantā ca guṇamāyāsamāvṛtaḥ || 29.23 saṃsārasāgaraṃ ghoram anantakleśabhājanam | tvām eva śaraṇaṃ prāpya nistaranti manasvinaḥ || 29.24 na te rūpaṃ na cākāro nāyudhāni na cāspadam | tathā'pi puruṣākāro bhaktānāṃ ca prakāśase || 29.25 naiva kiṃcit parokṣaṃ te pratyakṣo'si na kasyacit | naiva kiṃcid asidhyante na ca siddho'si kasyacit || 29.26 kāryāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ pūrvaṃ vacasāṃ vācyam uttamam | yogānāṃ paramā siddhiḥ paramaṃ te paraṃ viduḥ || 29.27 ahaṃ bhīto'smi deveśa saṃsāre'smin mahābhaye | pāhi māṃ puṇḍarīkākṣa na jāne śaraṇaṃ param || 29.28 kāleṣv api ca sarveṣu dikṣu sarvāsu cācyuta | śarīre ca gatau cāpi vardhate me mahadbhayam || 29.29 tvatpādakamalād anyan na me janmāntareṣv api | nimittaṃ kuśalasyāsti yena gacchāmi sadgatim || 29.30 vijñānaṃ yad idaṃ prāptaṃ yad idaṃ sthānamārjitam | janmāntare'pi me deva mābhūdasya parīkṣayaḥ || 29.31 durgatāyāṃ vāpi jātāyāṃ tvadgato me manorathaḥ | yadi nāśaṃ na vindeta tāva tāsmin kṛtī sadā || 29.32 na kāmakaluṣaṃ cittaṃ mama te pādayāḥ sthitam | kāmaye vaiṣṇavatvaṃ tu sarvajanmasu kevalam || 29.33 ity eva manayā stutyā stutvā devaṃ dine dine | kiṃkaromīti cātmānaṃ devāyaiva nivedayet || 29.34 pūjādravyaviśeṣeṇa pūjayed ātmanas tanum | pūjāpīṭhanikṛṣṭe tu svayam āsīta viṣṭare || 29.35 yathā rājānam utkṛṣṭaṃ yathā vā paramaṃ gurum | ārādhayati yatnena tathā devaṃ samarcayet || 29.36 agnikārye tu homasya trīṇi dravyāṇi padmaja | samidho havir ājyaṃ ca tair nityaṃ homam ācaret || 29.37 puṣpāṇi lokapālānāṃ diśāsu vidiśāsu ca | vinyasya gandhayuktāni sarvadā homam ācaret || 29.38 kāmye naimittike cāpi pakvahomo vidhīyate | idhmahomaṃ ca nānyatra na sruvo homam eva ca || 29.39 ekaika samidhaṃ kṛtvā sarvamantrair yathākramam | sruveṇa juhuyād ājyaṃ hastena juhuyād dhaviḥ || 29.40 saṃgṛhya samidhāṃ bhasma homānte jalamiśritam | ālimped ātmarakṣārthaṃ pāpanāśārtham eva ca || 29.41 śikhālalāṭakaṇṭheṣu hṛdaye bhujayos tathā | nābhau ca caraṇāgre ca naśobhārthaṃ kadācana || 29.42 vahnimantreṇa kurvīta bhasmanā lepanaṃ budhaḥ | gadārūpānurūpā syād ekā sarvatra nādhikā || 29.43 ācāryaṃ na tu kurvīta nikṛṣṭaṃ janmanā naraḥ | utkṛṣṭam api durvṛttaṃ siddhikāmas tu vaiṣṇavam || 29.44 bahūnām ekadā dīkṣām ācāryo yadi kārayet | eka eva prayogasya sarvasādhāraṇo bhavet || 29.45 śiṣyasaṃskārayuktaṃ ca ubhe naiva samācaret | sthāpane mūrtipālānāṃ dvādaśānāṃ krameṇa tu || 29.46 mūrtipā na juhuyuḥ pakvam ācāryas tu hunet svayam | mūrtīnāṃ dvādaśānāṃ tu śaktīnāṃ cāpi sarpiṣā || 29.47 vāsudevādikānāṃ ca homaṃ kuryād yathākramam | adbhiḥ kṛtvā samāṃ bhūmiṃ[śaṃkuṃ]śaṃkuryāt prayatnataḥ || 29.48 sarvatra samaviṣkaṃbhaṃ dvādaśāṅgulam āyatam | likhitvā maṇḍalaṃ bhūmau karkaṭena samaṃtataḥ || 29.49 madhye śaṅkuṃ pratiṣṭhāpya sarvataḥ samam añjasā | pratiṣṭhāmaṇḍale chāyām ante kṛtvā tu cihnitām || 29.50 aparāhṇe tu niṣkrāntām anta eva tu cihnayet | sūtrapātaṃ tayoḥ kṛtvā vidyāt pūrvāpare diśau || 29.51 karkaṭena tayor madhye matsyam utpādayet punaḥ | tasyāṃ tayos tu sūtreṇa jānīyād dakṣiṇottare || 29.52 evaṃ kurvīta diṅmānaṃ devāgārasya sarvadā | maṇḍalasyāpi lekhāyāṃ sūkṣmamānam idaṃ matam || 29.53 anyathā sthūlamānena diśaṃ vidyād vicakṣaṇaḥ | citrāsthānāntarālena madhyamena graheṇa vā || 29.54 puṣpayāgaṃ tu kurvīta brahmacārī samāhitaḥ | saṃbhave kālapakvāni phalāny api nivedayet || 29.55 pakvair api vanāhārair vānaprastho nivedayet | gacchen nākṛtasanyāso grāmād devārcanāya ca || 29.56 japayajñaṃ sadā kurvan dhyānayāgam athācaret | yogāṅgāny anutiṣṭhec ca tīrthāni ca samāśrayet || 29.57 tīrthasthāneṣu mukhyeṣu viṣṇor āyataneṣu ca | cāturmāsyam upāsīta likhitvā cakramaṇḍalam || 29.58 tīrthayātrāṃ ca kurvīta teṣu devaṃ ca pūjayet | tantrāṇi sarahasyāni śruṇuyād gurusannidhau || 29.59 pratyāsanne tu maraṇe yatnavān guhyam āspadam | parikliśyāpi seveta nityaṃ pravrajito naraḥ || 29.60 pradakṣiṇakriyāyāṃ tu devāgārasya vaiṣṇavaḥ | nirmālya dhāriṇaṃ devaṃ cāntareṇa na laṃghayet || 29.61 tāvad gatvā nivarteta prasahya punar āgataḥ | prāsādadvāram āsādya datvā puṣpāñjaliṃ punaḥ || 29.62 nameti kiṃcid āvarto mūrdhnā cāñjalinā tathā | tadbhaktyaiva namaskuryāt parivārāṃś ca sarvaśaḥ || 29.63 dīkṣitasyāyam ācāraḥ kāmamanyasya yoginaḥ | yogaiśvaryādi vinyāsaṃ yogapīṭhasya bāhyataḥ || 29.64 mūrtivinyāsavat kuryāt sarvayāgeṣv anukramāt | viṣyāṃ vīṃścabahu[dikpālāṃś ca bahi]steṣāṃ dikṣu sarvāsu kalpayet || 29.65 dīkṣāyāṃ ca bahis teṣāṃ svādi[su?]dikṣu niveśayet | teṣāṃ tu pūjanaṃ proktaṃ gandhapuṣpādinā pṛthak || 29.66 mahāyāgaḥ smṛto hy eṣaḥ sarvakāmasamṛddhidaḥ | sarvadā na ca kartavyo yāgeṣu nyāsavistaraḥ || 29.67 nimitteṣu viśeṣeṇa saṃbhave ca prayojayet | kāmārtheṣu tu yāgeṣu vistāraḥ sarva iṣyate || 29.68 sarveṣv apy aṅgahīno'yaṃ vidhir iṣṭaṃ na sādhayet | āvāhya pūjayed devam arghyadānena bhaktitaḥ || 29.69 alaṃkārāvasāne ca pūjanānte ca nityaśaḥ | āpaḥ kṣīraṃ kuśāgrāṇi sarpī mardatilāḥ phalam || 29.70 gandhapuṣpādi dūrvā ca sarvapāpakṣayaṃ tathā | pañcāvarāṇām eteṣāṃ saṃgrahād arghyam iṣyate || 29.71 pātrāt pātre gṛhītvārghyaṃ hastābhyāṃ pratipādayet | aṣṭākṣaraṃ japen nityaṃ dvādaśākṣaram eva ca || 29.72 adīkṣito'pi satataṃ viṣṇubhakto dṛḍhavrataḥ | japet paramahaṃsaṃ taṃ na kadācid adīkṣitaḥ || 29.73 praṇavena vināmūrkhā japeyur itarāv api | strībālabadhir ādīnāṃ pūjaye devanirvṛtaḥ || 29.74 bhagavantaṃ sadā vidvān na tantro paramaḥ śubhaḥ | gambhīraparamo devo nācireṇa prasīdati || 29.75 na naśyati kṛtaṃ karma tasmāt tiṣṭhed anākulaḥ | mahājanasamakṣaṃ ca devadevaṃ na pūjayat || 29.76 na kṛtāṃ kīrtayet pūjāṃ noccai stotram udāharet | karmaśeṣam aśeṣeṇa na śakyaṃ vadituṃ mayā || 29.77 bāhulyena tu nirdeśaḥ kṛto'yaṃ kamalāsana | viṣṇubhaktā mahātmānaḥ pañcarātraparāyaṇāḥ || 29.78 yad brūyuḥ saṃśayasthāne tat kāryam aviśaṅkayā || 29.79
iti śrīpāñcarātre paramasaṃhitāyāṃ karmaśe[ṣo?] nāma ekonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
atha triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
bhagavan puṇḍarīkākṣa vaikuṇṭha puruṣottama | jñānam etad aśeṣeṇa tvatprasādān mayā śrutam || 30.1 naṣṭā me saṃśayāḥ sarve pūrvaṃ jātāḥ samaṃtataḥ | kṛtakṛtyam ivātmānam adya manye jagat prabho || 30.2 rahasyam api yadyatra jñānaṃ guhyaṃ bhavet kvacit | tad apy akhilam ācakṣva tatra me paramā spṛhā || 30.3 paramaḥ hanta te kathayiṣyāmi jñānaṃ guhyaṃ pitāmaha | yad anyair na śrutaṃ pūrvaṃ hitānāṃ paramaṃ hitam || 30.4 tantroktena vidhānena nityam avyagramānasaḥ | asamīkṣya phalaṃ kiṃcin mām upāsīta mānavaḥ || 30.5 pūjayitvā tathā pūjā madhye vā pratipūjayet | kiṃkaratvena cātmānaṃ kṛtvāñjalir athomukhaḥ || 30.6 annapānaṃ dhanaṃ putraṃ āyur aiśvaryam āspadam | āpady api na yāceta pūjakaḥ puruṣottamam || 30.7 nāprasanno dadāmy eṣa yācito'pi dine dine | ayācito'pi tat sarvaṃ suprasanno dadāmy aham || 30.8 na kālaḥ kāraṇaṃ tatra nārcanasya ca gauravam | na pūjakasya duḥkhaṃ vā matprasādasya padmaja || 30.9 svayam eva tu jānāmi pūjakasya guṇāguṇān | pūjāyāḥ saṃpadaś cāpi kālasya gamanaṃ tathā || 30.10 svayam eva prasīdāmi saṃpadaṃ prekṣya sarvadā | prasannas tv anugṛhṇāmi tvarayā na kadācana || 30.11 iha janmani na syāc ced anyajanmani tad dhruvam | anyajanmani na syāc cet parajanmani tad dhruvam || 30.12 na tv enam anugṛhṇāmi janmāntaraśate'py aham | sakṛd apy arcayitvā māṃ parivṛttam upāsanāt || 30.13 karmaṇāṃ pacyamānatvād apareṣāṃ parīkṣaye | prakāśayāmi bhaktānām ahaṃ kiṃ madanugraham || 30.14 tatas tu saṃpadenaiṣaḥ puruṣān upatiṣṭhate | mitrāṇi ca vivardhante kṣīyante śatravas tathā || 30.15 phalāni yatnā bhūyiṣṭhaṃ naśyanti vyādhayaḥ svayam | annapāneṣv asaṃkleśo vardhante paśavas tathā || 30.16 dīrghakālaṃ bhavaty āyur jāyante subhagāḥ prajāḥ | praśaṃsanti janāḥ sarve corayanti na taskarāḥ || 30.17 nirupadravam aiśvaryaṃ tiṣṭhati prathate'pivā | aparāntasukhenaiva puṇyakāle bhaviṣyati || 30.18 tato hi labhate janma vaṃśe śreṣṭhe mahātmanām | tatrāpi mām upāsīnaḥ saṃpadbhir abhivardhate || 30.19 tato'bhi[pi]labhate janma tasmād api guṇādhikam | ity evaṃ puṣṭir eva syāt tasya janmani janmani || 30.20 tato'ṣṭaguṇam aiśvaryam akliṣṭam adhigacchati | tatra tiṣṭhati vā dīrghaṃ viharan matparāyaṇaḥ || 30.21 athavā jñānam āsthāya nirvāṇam adhigacchati | madbhakte'pi prasādo me na kadācin na hīyate || 30.22 bhajate yadi mām eva śaraṇaṃ puruṣaḥ svayam | yadi māṃ vismaraty eṣa dūṣitaḥ sukhanidrayā || 30.23 tato'sya vipadaḥ kiṃcid utpadyante samaṃtataḥ | tato'yaṃ viparītena srotasā yujyate pumān || 30.24 tato'sya vividhāḥ kāmāḥ saṃbhavanti manorathe | tatas teṣāṃ prasaṅgena kurute śuṣkapauruṣam || 30.25 tatra pratihataḥ kiṃcit punar anyad viceṣṭate | evaṃ kāryānubandhena saṃsāre kleśam ṛcchati || 30.26 madgatā bhaktir evāsya saṃpadāṃ kāraṇaṃ param | vyāpattasyāṃ tu naṣṭāyāṃ svayam evopatiṣṭhate || 30.27 tasmāj jataiva puṃsas tu madgatā bhaktir anvaham | vardhanīyā viśeṣeṇa sainaṃ nayati ta[sa?]tpatham || 30.28 na kasya[ca]vināyatnair arcanaiḥ svayam apsu nauḥ | pravartate pratisroto nayaty enam upary api || 30.29 evaṃ madbhaktiyogena saṃpadasya vivardhate | hitvā saṃsārajān kleśān kurute cainam uttamam || 30.30 nāvikasyāparādhena yathā naur vinivartate | evaṃ madbhaktyapāyena saṃsāro'sya vivardhate || 30.31 tasmād avikalā bhaktir madgatā dehināṃ gatiḥ | tasyā eva vibhūtyarthaṃ sarvam anyat pitāmaha || 30.32 yaḥ pūjayati māṃ nityaṃ yad udāharati stavam | yo dhyāyati ca mām eva tena bhaktir vivardhate || 30.33 bhaktāv avidyamānāyāṃ prayatnaḥ sumahān api | lokāḍambaram eva syād aphalaṃ pretya ceha ca || 30.34 tasmāt sarvaṃ prayatnena bhaktim eva vivardhayet | sā tu vṛddhā nayaty eva vaiṣṇavaṃ paramaṃ padam || 30.35 tattvadarśanam evāsyāḥ kathitaṃ vṛddhikāraṇam | sarvadā paśya māṃ tattvaṃ mayi bhaktir vivardhate || 30.36 aham ekaḥ prasūto'smi saṃprāpya vapur īdṛśam | asmin kāle yathā cāsmi rūpeṇānena saṃyutaḥ || 30.37 pūrvam apy abhavaj janma viṣaye mama kutracit | uttamaṃ vā'dhamaṃ vā yat samaṃ vā guṇasaṃpadām || 30.38 janmāntaraṃ ca me bhāvi kim apy asti śubhāśubham | tasmād apy aparaṃ janma dhruvam eva bhaviṣyati || 30.39 na ca māṃ jāyamānaṃ va kutaścin mātur āśrayāt | ekākī mriyamāṇaṃ vā kaścid apy anudhāvati || 30.40 mama duḥkhena nānyasya duḥkhaṃ kimapi jāyate | matsukhena sukhī nānyaḥ tasmān na suhṛdo mama || 30.41 eka evāham āyāta eka evāham āsthitaḥ | eka eva gamiṣyāmi dehāntaram api dhruvam || 30.42 yaj jīvāmi ciraṃ kālaṃ yaj jīvāmi ca madhyamam | yaj jīvāmi kṛśaṃ cedaṃ mama nānyasya tatsamam || 30.43 idam anyaiḥ purā bhuktaṃ bhujyate ca mayādhunā | punar apy etad evānyair madapāye'pi bhokṣyate || 30.44 naivāspadaṃ mamaivedaṃ dhanam aiśvaryam eva vā | ete bhṛtyā ime dārā ete putrā ime priyāḥ || 30.45 ete svārthaṃ pravartante naike tu nihitaṃ mama | bādhate mām iyaṃ vyādhir bādhate mām iyaṃ jarā || 30.46 santāpo me paraś ceti mamaiveyaṃ ca vedanā | pūrve saṃvatsare dṛṣṭam asmin paśyāmi vatsare || 30.47 tatra pūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ kāryam atra kartavyatāṃ gatam | atīte divase bhuktam annam adyāpi bhujyate || 30.48 tathaiva kriyate karma tathaivādyāpi supyate | kurvanti paśavaś caiva pakṣiṇo jantavas tathā || 30.49 mama teṣāṃ ca paśyāmi na viśeṣaṃ kadācana | svasyāṃ jātau pramodante viśeṣenāpi jantavaḥ || 30.50 tasmāj janmaśubhaṃ vā syād aśubhaṃ vā samaṃ tu tat | tasmāj jāte na viśvāso mamāsti nidhaneṣu ca || 30.51 na vidyāsu na rūpeṣu na mitreṣu na bandhuṣu | madāyattaṃ na jānāmi madvidheyaṃ na cāparam || 30.52 māmekam eva paśyāmi magnaṃ saṃsārasāgare | adhvagasya yathā mārge mitram annaṃ dhanaṃ gṛham || 30.53 evam evāsya paśyāmi jātāṃ me jīvitām imām | śakuniḥ koṭaraṃ yadvad ātiṣṭhati jahāti ca || 30.54 evam eva śarīre'smin na viśvāsyā mama sthitiḥ | kuto'ham āgataḥ pūrvaṃ kva gamiṣyāmi vā punaḥ || 30.55 kiyad vā viharāmy atra na jāne sarvam īdṛśam | ākrāntam aparokṣaṃ me sarvaṃ viphalam eva ca || 30.56 anāgataṃ tathā sarvam antarāle kim asti me | tasmāc charaṇam icchāmi kiṃcid ekāntisaṃhitam || 30.57 anyathā mama saṃhare[sā?] bhayaṃ vā na nivartate | indriyānām avaikalyaṃ vivekaṃ manasas tathā || 30.58 a[ta?]smin janmany avāptaṃ me diṣṭyā pūrvakṛtaiḥ śubhaiḥ | asmin janmani yatnena[tattena?] kartavyaṃ kuśalaṃ mayā || 30.59 yena me saṃpadāṃ puṣṭir bhaved uttarajanmani | śreyo mārgaṃ na paśyāmi kriyamāṇeṣu karmasu || 30.60 anuvardhī phalaṃ teṣāṃ suduḥkhaṃ jñānanāśanam | karmāṇy eva tu dṛśyante vedaśāstrāgameṣu ca || 30.61 na ca tair mānasaṃ tāpaḥ sarvakāleṣu naśyati | tasmād ālaṃbanaṃ kiṃcit kūṭastham anupadravam || 30.62 eṣitavyaṃ mayā kiṃcid artho hy arthānvito bhavet | na ca viṣṇoḥ paraṃ kiṃcit paśyāmi puruṣaṃ sthitam || 30.63 itihāsapurāṇeṣu lokavedāgameṣu ca | tasmāt tvām eva śaraṇaṃ prapadye bhaktavatsala || 30.64 manasā karmaṇā vācā nirapekṣo dṛḍhavrataḥ | na karomi ca kāmeṣu kadācid api mānasam || 30.65 kiṃ mamaikena kāmena dvābhyāṃ va siddhim īpsitam | tasmāt phalam anākāṃkṣat prapadye śaraṇaṃ harim || 30.66 ekāntadṛḍhayā bhaktyā vyavasāyo'tra me dhruvaḥ | ity evaṃ darśanaṃ kuryād ekānte śubhamānasaḥ || 30.67 vaiṣṇavaṃ siddhim anvicchann abhyasec ca samāhitaḥ | prasanne mānase taṃ ca cintayeta vicakṣaṇaḥ || 30.68 rāgadveṣaparītena viphalaṃ tattvadarśanam | prāpteṣu puṇyadeśeṣu parivrāṭsu ca yogiṣu || 30.69 prākṛtānāṃ ca martyānāṃ manaḥ kiṃcit prasīdati | nidrānte ca vivikte ca paṇḍitānāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 30.70 evam ādiṣu kāryeṣu svayam eva samāhitaḥ | tattvadarśanam ātiṣṭhen nityaṃ bhāgavato budhaḥ || 30.71 tenāsya saṅgatā bhaktir na kadācit tu hīyate | pīḍyate ca na kāmena nirvedo nāpi vā punaḥ || 30.72 bhaktiyuktās tu puruṣo lokatantrān nivartate | nātisajyeta bhogeṣu tvarate na kutūhalāt || 30.73 na durlabham api prepsur labdhena parituṣyati | apriyasya ca saṃyoge viprayoge priyasya ca || 30.74 vipākaṃ karmaṇāṃ paśyan nānuśocati kiṃcana | yuktaṃ nedaṃ idaṃ yuktam ity asau nānuśocati || 30.75 prabhutvaṃ nāṭanaṃ kiṃcid iti paśyann upekṣate | na ghoṣayati kṛtyāni na karoti ca saṃbhramam || 30.76 na kāṃkṣati yataḥ kiṃcid devadevasya pūjanāt | yathāratneṣu dāreṣu kṛtye[putre?] vā mana saṃsthitiḥ || 30.77 evam evāsya deveśe bhaktiyuktaṃ mano bhavet | evaṃ bhaktau tu jātāyāṃ tattvadarśanapūrvakaḥ || 30.78 yatra yatra sthito vidvān muktasaṅgaḥ parivrajet | eka eva punas tatra gacched bhūmiṃ pradakṣiṇam || 30.79 tīrthāni ca niṣeveta sthānāni mama cānvaham | madbhakto madanudhyāyī manniṣṭho matparāyaṇaḥ || 30.80 antyakāle ca māṃ smṛtvā mama sāyujyam aśnute || 30.81 brahmā kim aṣṭaguṇam aiśvaryaṃ viṣṇubhakto yad aśnute | kim etad adhigamyāpi dehī pratinivartate || 30.82 nivṛtter asya ko bhedaḥ sāyujyaṃ kīrtitaṃ bhavet || 30.83 paramaḥ aṇur bhavati rūpeṇa puruṣo yo'vagacchati | mahān bhavati rūpeṇa yāvad icchati pūruṣaḥ || 30.84 laghur bhavati kāmena śuṣkaśalmalitūlavat | sammatenaiva kālena prāpnoti sakalāṃ mahīm || 30.85 āhāreṣu vihāreṣu prakāmaṃ vartate sadā | saṃkalpenaiva bhūtāni vaśaṃ nayati cātmanaḥ || 30.86 abhipretaṃ śarīraṃ ca svayam āviśati kṣaṇāt | etad aṣṭaguṇaṃ proktam aiśvaryaṃ tava padmaja || 30.87 anenaivopalabdhena krīḍanti bahavo janāḥ | prabhur bhavati sarvasya na kimcit pratihanyate || 30.88 na teṣām aparādho'sti nivṛttir vāpi janmani | yathā me vinivartante sarvalokeṣv ime narāḥ || 30.89 yadi māṃ vismaranty ete sukhanidrāvimohitāḥ | tataḥ kālakrameṇaiṣām upadhāto bhaviṣyati || 30.90 madbhaktirakṣaṇād ete sopaghātāḥ samaṃtataḥ | pratisrotaṃ pravartante punaḥ saṃsāravartmani || 30.91 labhante tatra te janmavaṃśe śreṣṭhe mahātmanām | bhajante tatra mām eva te punaḥ siddhikāmyayā || 30.92 aiśvarye'pi sthito yogī yadi mām anuvartate | tato muktavad evāyaṃ sarvalokeṣu modate || 30.93 sāyujyaṃ pratipannās te tīvrabhaktās tapasvinaḥ | kiṃkarā mama te nityā bhavanti nirupadravāḥ || 30.94 teṣāṃ bhaktyaparādhena saṃsāraḥ saṃbhavet punaḥ | anyathā sthitir evaiṣāṃ matprasādena śāśvatī || 30.95 nirvṛttās tu viśiṣyante sarvebhyaḥ puruṣottamāḥ | saṃsāragocarātītā nirviśeṣāḥ sadā mama || 30.96 na teṣāṃ saṃbhavo bhūyaḥ pramādo vāsti kaścana | vedāntair idam evoktaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ padam || 30.97 apavargaś ca muktiś ca nirvāṇaṃ caiva dehinām | etad eva parāsiddhir gatīnāṃ paramā gatiḥ || 30.98 anyās tu gatayaḥ sarvāḥ sapramā[dā]ḥ pitāmaha | puṃsāṃ svabhāvabhedāt tu kasyacit kiṃcid īpsitam || 30.99 tasmād ubhayam evātra puṃsāṃ bhavati saṃmatam | aiśvaryo'pavargo vā viśeṣeṇa pitāmaha || 30.100 madgatā bhaktir evedam ubhayaṃ sādhayiṣyati | samādher vartamānasya vibhāgād guṇakārikāt || 30.101 sa tv aniṣṭhaṃ yadā cittaṃ kevalaṃ kurute pumān | tadā'yaṃ sarvayatnena yogāṅgāni niṣevate || 30.102 teṣu sthitvā tu bhajate mām ekāgreṇa cetasā | tamaḥ kṣarati tenāsya rajo'pi ca vinaśyati || 30.103 tato janmabhir utkṛṣṭair eṣaḥ puṣṭiṃ prapadyate | tataḥ krameṇa yadyasya rajo leśaḥ pravartate || 30.104 cittavṛttau tadaiśvaryaṃ samagram upatiṣṭhate | yadā tu satvam ātiṣṭha[n]na spṛṣṭo rajasā kvacit || 30.105 tato'sya mokṣam eva syād ity eṣā dvividhā gatiḥ | tasmāt tu gatim anvicchan madbhaktaḥ sarvadā bhavet || 30.106 bhaktyāṃ ca vartamānāyāṃ bhavaty evepsitā gatiḥ || 30.107 brahmā kena doṣeṇa puṃsas tu bhaktiḥ kṣarati mānasī | iha loke paratrāpi taṃ brūhi puruṣottama || 30.108 paramaḥ nirvedaḥ saṃśayo'pyā[vyā?]dhir mithyājñānaṃ pravartate | agni[anya] bhaktasya bhogasya sannidhānaṃ priyāgamaḥ || 30.109 vipralaṃbhas tu māyābhir devībhir upajāyate | snehapāśānubandhas tu suhṛdyogāt pravartate || 30.110 kīrtau ca śrūyamāṇāyāṃ hṛdaye jāyate madaḥ | antarāyām imāṃ vidyād yogābhyāsasya vaiṣṇavaḥ || 30.111 eteṣu jāyamāneṣu tattvadarśanam ācaret | tīvravegaṃ na kurvīta śarīraṃ na ca pīḍayet || 30.112 viṣayebhyo'pi yatnena nivarteta śanaiḥ śanaiḥ | annapānaprasaṅge tu na kutūhalam ācaret || 30.113 jaghanendriyasaṅge ca hastacāpalya eva ca | apūrvadarśane caiva lokapālāśrayeṣu ca || 30.114 moghacittaprasaṅgeṣu yogam icchan naro budhaḥ | eteṣu sannivṛtteṣu viṣayeṣu śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 30.115 bhaktir vivardhate puṃsaḥ svayam eva madāśrayā | na ca pūrvam anāsvādya śakyante viṣayā naraiḥ || 30.116 parityaktum aśeṣeṇa tasmāt tān api saṃśrayet | dharmaśāstrāvirodhena mārgeṇa śithilaspṛhaḥ || 30.117 tān bhuktvā guṇavān doṣān (sarvāvasthāsu)... paṇḍitaḥ | duṣkarā bhaṅgurāś caite viṣayāḥ śuddhivarjitāḥ || 30.118 mūlyanāśena bhoktavyā bahupāyāś ca sarvadā | iti buddhiṃ samādāya viṣayebhyo nivartayet || 30.119 tebhyo nivartamānasya śubhaṃ bhavati mānasam | nivṛtter abhyupāyaś ca śuddhir eva parā matā || 30.120 śuddhāv ādīyamānāyāṃ bībhatsā viṣayān prati | jāyate sarvadā citte tayā saṃrakṣyate pumān || 30.121 āhāreṣu ca sarveṣu śayanācchādaneṣu ca | purāṇeṣu nivāseṣu salileṣu ca sarvadā || 30.122 śuddhim eteṣu yatnena paśyan bhāgavato budhaḥ | svayam eva na saṃsargam aśuciṣv adhigacchati || 30.123 aśucīnām asaṃsargāc cittam asya prasīdati | prasāde viṣayākāṃkṣā mandam asya nivartate || 30.124 viṣayebhyo nivṛttas tu madgato bhavati dhruvam | madgato yogam abhyasyed antarāyair adharṣitaḥ || 30.125 pūrvapāpavinirmuktaḥ prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim | iti te guhyam ākhyātaṃ mayā sarvaṃ pitāmaha || 30.126 etac chrutvā naro nityaṃ kṛtakṛtyo bhaviṣyati || 30.127
iti śrī pāñcarātre paramasaṃhitāyāṃ rahasyaṃ nāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
athaikatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
paramaḥ evam etan mayā proktaṃ tatra tatra viśeṣataḥ | nedaṃ jñānaṃ tvayāvācyaṃ niḥśeṣeṇākṛtātmanaḥ || 31.1 avaiṣṇavasya jijñāsor durmater abhimānataḥ | nirṇayaḥ sarvadhā proktas tatra tatra viśeṣataḥ || 31.2 yas tu madbhakta eva syād ekāntena dṛḍhavrataḥ | kulīnaś ca vilīnaś ca tasmai jñānam idaṃ tava[vada?] || 31.3 yādṛśāś ca mahābhāgā munayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ | śvetadvīpam anuprāpya sarvadā mām upāsate || 31.4 mayā vācyam idaṃ tebhyas tad brūhi mama śāsanāt || 31.5 na caite mām upāsīnāḥ prārthayanti phalāntaram | svayam eva tu dāsyāmi jñānam eṣāṃ yuge yuge || 31.6 atas tvam abhigamyainam idaṃ jñānam aśeṣataḥ | tebhyaḥ kathaya tattvena mama ced icchasi priyam || 31.7 ye ca tad dvīpam āyānti matprasādena yoginaḥ | tebhyas ta eva dāsyanti jñānam etat pitāmaha || 31.8 mārkaṇḍeyaḥ evam astv iti taṃ brahmā devadevam abhāṣata | baddhāñjalir adhodṛṣṭiḥ paripūrṇena tejasā[cetasā?] || 31.9 bhagavān api govindas tatraivāntarad hīyata | tad dṛṣṭvā vismitas tatra babhūva kamalāsanaḥ || 31.10 śvetadvīpaṃ tato brahmā prapede hariśāsanāt | atha saṃnihitaṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmāṇaṃ sarva eva te || 31.11 stutibhis toṣayāmāsur vismayena samanvitāḥ | athainān abravīd brahmā prasannenāntarātmanā || 31.12 vākyaṃ śruṇuta bhadraṃ vaḥ siddhāḥ paramavaiṣṇavāḥ | prasanno vaḥ paro devaḥ puṇḍarīkanibhekṣaṇaḥ || 31.13 jñānam icchati dātuṃ vaḥ svayam eva dayānvitaḥ | tebhyo gatvā svayaṃ brūhi jñānam ity abhicoditaḥ || 31.14 āgato'haṃ purastād vas tad yuṣmākaṃ vadāmy aham | ity uktvā brahmaṇā siddhāḥ sarve'pi punar abruvan || 31.15 sanatkumāraḥ sanakaḥ sanandana<ḥ> sanātanaḥ | ete śṛṇvantu catvāraḥ prajñāmedhā viśeṣataḥ || 31.16 śroṣyāmaḥ punar etebhyo vayaṃ bhūyo yathāsukham | yogācāryā bhavatv ete tvatprasādāt pitāmaha || 31.17 iti siddhair anujñātāś catvāras te maharṣayaḥ | jñānahetor mudāyuktā brahmaṇaṃ paryavāsayan || 31.18 sṛṣṭisaṃhārasaṃyuktaṃ muktisaṃhārasaṃyutam | tebhyo jñānaṃ dadau sarvaṃ pañcarātreṇa sarvaśaḥ || 31.19 tatas tasyāvasāne tu pūjitas tair maharṣibhiḥ | svayaṃbhūḥ paśyatāṃ teṣāṃ tatraivāntarad hīyata || 31.20 te'pi tad jñānam āsādya yoginaḥ kṛtabuddhayaḥ | dadyus tebhyo'pi siddhebhyas taj jñānam akhilaṃ punaḥ || 31.21 ye ca tad dvīpam āyānti vaiṣṇavāḥ saṃśitavratāḥ | tebhyo'pi tatprasādena jñānam anye'pi yoginaḥ || 31.22 mayāpy anugrahād viṣṇor dvīpam āsādya taṃ śubham | sanakasya mukhāt prāptam idaṃ tantraṃ tu vaiṣṇavam || 31.21 bhūyaḥ sanatkumāraṃ taṃ siddhām anyāṃś ca vaiṣṇavān | tair dṛṣṭena ca [dṛṣṭvā taddatta?] mārgeṇa nivṛtto'smīha devala || 31.24 nivṛttaś ca yathotsāhaṃ sthāneṣu paramātmanaḥ | abravīt [asmin?]dvīpe nivasyāmi bahūn saṃvatsarān aham || 31.25 gatvā gatvā tu paśyāmi vaiṣṇavān sucirāyuṣaḥ | tebhyaś ca vaiṣṇavān eva tadā śroṣyāmi tadguṇān || 31.26 kacchapendram akūpāraśreṣṭhaṃ dīrghatarāyuṣam | jaigīṣavyaṃ tathā mukhyaṃ pralayeṣv api nirvyatham || 31.27 jāmadagnyaṃ tathā rāmam atrim aṅgirasaṃ tathā | etān anyāṃś ca paśyāmi kāle gatvā tu vaiṣṇavān || 31.28 te'pi tad dvīpam āsādya munayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ | tattvajñānam avāpyaivaṃ babhūvuḥ susamāhitāḥ || 31.29 ekāntino mudāyuktā viṣṇubhaktiparāyaṇāḥ | śraddhayā parayopetā vāsudevam upāsate || 31.30 tvama[tvayā]py evam idaṃ jñānaṃ labdhaṃ devala vaiṣṇavam | vidhūya saṃśayān sarvān ekāntī vaiṣṇavo bhava || 31.31 nātaḥ parataraṃ kiṃcit puruṣasya śubhodayam | ekāntena paraṃ devaṃ puruṣo yat prapadyate || 31.32 na hi sarveṣu lokeṣu sarvakāleṣu vā punaḥ | vaiṣṇavebhyo viśiṣyante puruṣāḥ kecana kvacit || 31.33 teṣāṃ tu saphalaṃ janma saṃsāre'smin na saṃśayaḥ | ekāntena labhante[bhajante?] ye puruṣāḥ puruṣottamam || 31.34 na hi taṃprati [saṃprati?] paśyāmi sarvadeśeṣu devala | yaḥ kāmena vinā bhakto devadeve janārdane || 31.35 na mṛtyurnabhayaṃ tasya na janmāntarasaṃkramaḥ | yasya na cyavate bhaktivaiṣṇave caraṇāmbuje || 31.36 atas tvaṃ vedaśāstrāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ pārago'pi san | satpathe saṃśayāpanna viṣṇubhaktas sadā bhaveḥ || 31.37 tatas tenaiva kālena pratyayo hṛdaye dṛḍhaḥ | svayam eva vinaśyante yena te sarvasaṃśayāḥ || 31.38 anugrahāś ca labhante tatra tatraiva devala | vyavasāyaś ca bhaktasya na vinaśyati jātucit || 31.39 ācāryāś cāpi labhante vinā yatnena sarvataḥ | yebhyaḥ sakalam āpnoti jñānaṃ bhaktisamanvitam || 31.40 anena supathā yātrāṃ ye kecit prasthitā bhuvi | mānyāḥ sarvatra jāyante kīrtanīyāś ca dehinaḥ || 31.41 devadānavagandharvā yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ | viṣṇubhaktasya kurvanti nāpriyāṇi kadācana || 31.42 bhajante ye narā viṣṇuṃ manasā karmaṇā girā | na teṣāṃ durlabhaṃ kiṃcid iha loke paratra ca || 31.43 sthāvarebhyo viśiṣyante ja[ṅgamāḥ svair guṇais sadā?].....ġuṇaiḥ | jaṅgamebhyas tu paśavaḥ paśubhyo mānuṣāḥ parāḥ || 31.44 vaiṣṇavās tu manuṣyebhyo vaiṣṇavebhyo bahuśrutāḥ | vidvadbhyaḥ sādhitajñānā jñānibhyaḥ saṃyatendriyāḥ || 31.45 saṃyatebhyaḥ parāḥ siddhāḥ siddhebhyo'pi maharṣayaḥ | maharṣibhyo gataiśvaryās tebhyo'pica mumukṣavaḥ || 31.46 iti kakṣyāḥ samuddiṣṭāś cetanānām aśeṣataḥ | yāsāṃ jñānād avāpnoti vaiṣṇavaṃ paramaṃ padam || 31.47 īśvaratvaṃ ca devānāṃ jñānitvaṃ ca vipaścitām | vaiṣṇavatvaṃ ca martyānāṃ nāpy anyatamasaḥ [tapasaḥ?] phalam || 31.48 utpattimaraṇe puṃsāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ phalānvite | itareṣāṃ tu martyānām ubhayaṃ tadanarthakam || 31.49 tasmāt tvaṃ devala tyaktvā sarvam anyad viceṣṭitam | bhajasva sarvabhāvena paramātmānam acyutam || 31.50 ity evaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tantraṃ mayā proktaṃ tavānagha | rahasyena ca saṃyuktaṃ karmabhedasamanvitam || 31.51 na caitaṃ paramaṃ jñānaṃ devadevamukhāt cyutam | ajñātamūlabhaktāya dātavyaṃ devala tvayā || 31.52 tisro dīkṣāḥ kṛtā yena vaiṣṇavena tapasvinā | sa eva vaiṣṇavaṃ jñānam akhilaṃ śrotum arhati || 31.53 ye vijñānavato [yetu jijñāsavo?] dhīrāḥ śrotum icchanti devala | na tebhyo guṇavadbhyo'pi deyaṃ jñānam idaṃ tava || 31.54 sarveṣām eva dānānāṃ jñānadānaṃ viśiṣyate | nasaṃkhyā phalasiddhīnāṃ jñānasya ca visarpaṇāt || 31.55 yathaiva pātrasaṃpadbhir jñānaṃ viśiṣyate | evaṃ pātrasya doṣeṇa dātur bhavati kilbiṣam || 31.56 tasmāt pātraṃ parīkṣyaiva dātavyaṃ jñānam uttamam | aśrameṇa mahatpuṇyaṃ jñānadānād yad icchati || 31.57 iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ hitārthaṃ tava devala | pāñcarātraṃ mayā tantraṃ sāram uddhṛtya sarvataḥ || 31.58 etad jñānaṃ dṛḍhaṃ grāhyam anuṣṭheyaṃ ca devala | cintanīyaṃ ca sarvatra tena te siddhyatīpsitam || 31.59 kaccit jñānam idaṃ sarvaṃ dhāritaṃ devala tvayā | kaccit te saṃśayā naṣṭāḥ kaccit te niścitā matiḥ || 31.60 evam uktas tadāvākyaṃ mārkaṇḍeyena devalaḥ | praṇamya śirasā pādaṃ vacanaṃ cedam abravīt || 31.61 devalaḥ etad jñānaṃ mayā labdhaṃ tvatprasādān mahāmune | kṛtakṛtyo bhaviṣyāmi naṣṭaṃ me ḥṛdayaṃ tamaḥ || 31.62 chinnā me saṃśayās sarve samupāttaś ca nirṇayaḥ | śraddhayā sahitā bhaktir adya me bhavati dhruvam || 31.63 yathā jñānam idaṃ labdhaṃ pāvanānāṃ supāvanam | evam eva kariṣyāmi sthito'haṃ vacane tava || 31.64 ity evaṃ devalaḥ prapya vaiṣṇavaṃ jñānam uttamam | mārkaṇḍeyaṃ samāmantrya nirjagāma yathepsitam || 31.65 ya idaṃ śruṇuyāt tantraṃ vaiṣṇavaḥ śuddhamānasaḥ | tasya pāpāni naśyanti janmāntarakṛtāni ca || 31.66 śrutvā ya idaṃ tantram upāste puruṣottamam | acireṇa ca kālena tasya devaḥ prasīdati || 31.67 yaḥ paṭhed ādarād etat tat pāṭhayati vā naraḥ | tasyāpi pāpaṃ kṣarati viśeṣā bhaktir iṣyate || 31.68 tasmād anena mārgeṇa pūjayen madhusūdanam | aiśvaryam apavargaṃ vā nirvyājam adhigacchati || 31.69
iti śrīpāñcarātre paramasaṃhitāyāṃ upasaṃhāro nāma ekatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
